izzyondroid:net.helcel.cowspent.name: Cowspent
izzyondroid:net.helcel.cowspent.summary: Multi-project shared budget manager able to sync with self hosted FOSS services
izzyondroid:net.helcel.cowspent.description:
Cowspent is a shared budget manager able to synchronize with Nextcloud Cospend. It is partially based on MoneyBuster
 What did we change from MoneyBuster ?
 We added more statistics, support for projects marked as archived (hidden by default), added support for custom splits to bills, added a way to add categories to bills missing them. Behind the scenes we migrated the UI and app into Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for a smoother and more modern experience.
 What's different from other shared budget managers?
 You can keep your project local or make it synchronize with Nextcloud Cospend projects. This means you can choose where your data is going and preserve your privacy.
 Features
 Manage projects, members and bills (add/remove/edit)
 Search bills (by payer, name, amount, date)
 Generate and share project statistics and settlement plan
 Dark theme and customizable main app color
 Share/import projects with link/QRCode
 Connect to a Nextcloud account to automatically add projects
 Requirements
 If you want to host a project in Nextcloud Cospend :
 Nextcloud instance running with Cospend app installed
 If you want to be able to create remote projects from Cowspent : enable public project creation on your Nextcloud Cospend instance.
 Alternatives
 MoneyBuster which is FOSS but has older UI and was missing some QoL features. Tricount, Cospender, Splitwise etc... which are not FOSS and force you to give away your private data.

izzyondroid:se.nullable.flickboard.name: FlickBoard
izzyondroid:se.nullable.flickboard.description:
FlickBoard is a keyboard for Android that doesn’t try to correct or predict you. It doesn’t have an opinion on the correct spelling or tone. It certainly doesn’t use any AI. Because it trusts you to write what you meant to write.
 Instead, FlickBoard uses swipes to get away with using vastly fewer (and larger!) buttons than a traditional QWERTY keyboard, helping you build muscle memory, minimize typos, and touch type faster.

 FlickBoard is inspired by MessagEase and Thumb-Key .

fdroid:com.heimdall.app.name: Heimdall
fdroid:com.heimdall.app.summary: On-device, privacy-first SMS spam blocker with custom keyword rules.
fdroid:com.heimdall.app.description:
Heimdall is an on-device, privacy-first SMS spam blocker for Android.
Unlike conventional spam blockers that upload your private conversations and contact lists to remote servers, Heimdall runs entirely locally on your device with zero telemetry, zero analytics, and zero external tracking.
FEATURES
• 100% On-Device Protection: Incoming messages are analyzed strictly on your device. Your messages never leave your phone.
• Silent Spam Interception: When set as your default SMS app, Heimdall intercepts spam broadcasts before they reach Android's system SMS database, preventing spam notifications from waking your screen.
• Automatic Clean Message Sync: Legitimate messages automatically sync into Android's system SMS database and show instant notifications.
• Custom Keyword Rules: Add or remove keywords to your blocklist. Any incoming SMS containing a keyword is silently blocked. Changing keywords re-evaluates your existing messages instantly.
• Message Categories: Tags incoming messages as Bank, Card, Delivery, Travel, or OTP based on common keywords in the message body. This is for visual organization only and does not block anything.
• One-Tap OTP Copying: Actionable notification buttons allow you to copy verification codes and one-time passwords directly with a single tap.
• Minimalist Cyberpunk Terminal UI: Fast, responsive, dark-mode monospace interface built with Jetpack Compose.
• Completely Open Source: Licensed under the Apache 2.0 license. Transparent and auditable.
IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS
Heimdall is designed specifically as an incoming SMS spam blocker, not a full messaging client:
• No Outbound SMS: Heimdall does not compose or send outbound text messages.
• No MMS Support: Incoming multimedia messages (MMS) are discarded and not displayed.
• To send text messages or view MMS, you can temporarily switch back to your primary messaging app.

fdroid:dev.digitalgrease.signet.name: Signet
fdroid:dev.digitalgrease.signet.summary: Verify calls from family, colleagues, sources against deepfake impersonation.
fdroid:dev.digitalgrease.signet.description:
When someone who sounds like your mother calls in a panic asking for bail money, Signet lets you verify it's actually her.
Each paired contact generates a rotating 4-word phrase that only the real person's phone can produce. You ask her to read her phrase aloud; you type what you hear. Green banner: verified. Red banner: something's wrong — hang up and call her back on a number you already trust.
Signet works over any channel. Voice calls, video calls, text, email, in person. The only requirement is that the two of you paired once, in person or over a trusted channel, before the crisis.
Built for a world where AI voice cloning is commodity. Defends against:
* Real-time voice and video deepfakes
* Pre-recorded deepfake voicemails
* Vishing using scraped biographical knowledge
* Compromised messaging accounts where the attacker has chat history but not the paired device
* SIM swaps
* Reflection attacks: the rotating code is direction-aware, so an attacker echoing your own phrase back at you fails
Core properties:
* No server. No cloud. No account. No INTERNET permission.
* No telemetry. No analytics. No ads.
* Hardware-backed secrets via Android Keystore, StrongBox when available.
* Offline-first; airplane mode does not affect any flow.
* RFC-validated crypto (X25519, HKDF-SHA-256, AES-256-GCM, BIP-39).
* Open source, AGPL-3.0.
v0.3 includes in-person pairing, long-distance pairing, lost-phone recovery via paper or file, multi-relationship storage, in-person rekey, bulk backup (every paired relationship in one encrypted file with a single 8-word unlock), a printable challenge-response grid for when the other side can't reach their phone, liveness prompts for video calls, and screenshot blocking on sensitive screens.
Not included: duress codes (gated on an abuse-analysis pass), account recovery (there is no account), cloud backup (out of scope forever).

fdroid:io.github.jrichter24.moldqueen.name: MoldQueen
fdroid:io.github.jrichter24.moldqueen.summary: Drive Mould King building-block RC toys over Bluetooth
fdroid:io.github.jrichter24.moldqueen.description:
Control Mould King building-block RC toys from your phone over Bluetooth: no Raspberry Pi, no network, fully open source.
MoldQueen is a standalone Android app for driving Mould King building-block RC toys. It uses the phone's own Bluetooth radio and serves its control interface on the device, so it needs no Raspberry Pi, no network, and no cloud account. It speaks a reverse-engineered Bluetooth Low Energy broadcast protocol, and follows a "thin transport, smart client" design: the radio just broadcasts the toy's control telegrams, while the on-device client resolves every control to a channel and owns the per-toy mapping.
 Control layouts 
Each toy gets a control surface, and any toy can fall back to a generic one:
 A model-specific Excavator (Mould King 13112) dashboard with left and right tracks, arm, front arm, rotation, and bucket.
 Generic, model-agnostic layouts (a 12-axis controller and a brick-style gamepad) that drive any Mould King MK4 model on these hubs.
 Proportional drag joysticks and press-and-hold buttons.
 Per-channel speed caps, channel inversion, and a RAW channel view for direct control.
 Auto-assign 
Map a new toy's motors to channels in a few taps:
 Pick a motor profile (tracked vehicle, car with steering, or custom) and a motor count.
 The app assigns each motor to a slot and channel; adjust any row by hand.
 Gamepad 
Drive with a physical controller instead of touch:
 Pair a Bluetooth controller (for example a DualSense) and steer with the sticks.
 Touch and gamepad work interchangeably.
 Safety 
Stopping is built in:
 An emergency STOP control that cuts all motion at once.
 Auto-neutral keepalive: every active channel must be refreshed continuously, so a channel that stops being refreshed returns to neutral on its own. A dropped connection or a released control coasts back to a stop instead of running away.
 Languages 
 Six interface languages: English, German, Chinese, Korean, Spanish, and French.
 Open and independent 
 Free software under the MIT License; the full source is on GitHub.
 The Mould King MK4 protocol was reverse-engineered for interoperability with hardware the author owns, for educational and personal use.
 Builds on J0EK3R's MIT-licensed MouldKingCrypt work, ported byte-for-byte and verified against the stock app's adverts.
 A private, independent, unofficial hobby project. Not affiliated with, authorized by, endorsed by, or sponsored by Mould King; "Mould King" is used only descriptively for interoperability.

fdroid:org.crazydan.studio.app.ime.kuaiz.name: Kuaizi IME
fdroid:org.crazydan.studio.app.ime.kuaiz.summary: Kuaizi IME is an efficient and fast Chinese Pinyin input method editor.
fdroid:org.crazydan.studio.app.ime.kuaiz.description:
筷字输入法 (Kuaizi IME) is a system based on the combinatorial features of Chinese Pinyin. It is an efficient and fast input method editor, suitable for electronic touchscreen devices.
筷字输入法 (Kuaizi IME) abandones the traditional method of tapping on virtual keyboard keys one by one, it instead offers a swipe input method for Pinyin, combined with the combinatorial features of Pinyin letters. The key layout is designed to make Pinyin input more accurate and convenient.
筷字输入法 (Kuaizi IME) provides editing support such as cursor movement and text selection for the target editor, thereby eliminating the frustration of being unable to accurately position inputs and text due to the small screen size of mobile devices. This further enhances text input and editing efficiency on small-screen devices.
User-data generated by 筷字输入法 (Kuaizi IME) is stored locally. It does not connect to the internet and will not collect nor analyze user data or behavior habits. Furthermore, it does not support or provide predictive input nor fuzzy matching mechanisms. To some extent, this input method editor aims to enhance the users' ability to recognize and memorize Chinese characters and Pinyin, ensuring that the reliance on digital tools does not lead to the gradual forgetting and eventual abandonment of 「汉字」(Hànzì, Chinese characters), a treasure of Chinese civilization.

fdroid:org.evsyukov.shareding.name: ShareDing
fdroid:org.evsyukov.shareding.summary: Save shared links to linkding, even when your server is offline
fdroid:org.evsyukov.shareding.description:
ShareDing sends links from Android's Share menu to your own linkding server. It stores each link in a local queue before sending, so you can keep browsing when the server is offline or available only through a LAN or VPN.
Features:
* Share HTTP and HTTPS links without opening the main app screen.
* Add a URL, title, description, and tags manually.
* Keep pending bookmarks across app restarts and device reboots.
* Retry in the background when a network becomes available or a server error occurs.
* Review and retry queued bookmarks; remove entries with confirmation.
* Set default tags and bookmark options, with tag suggestions from linkding.
Network connections:
* ShareDing sends bookmarks to your linkding server.
* When a queued link comes from a known URL shortener such as t.co, bit.ly, or vk.cc, background sync asks the shortener where the link leads and sends that address to linkding.
* If you tap Fetch page details in the Add Bookmark form, ShareDing requests the bookmarked page from your device to read its title and description.
The shortener and page requests do not include your linkding API token.
ShareDing requires Android 10 or newer and your own linkding server. Enter its HTTPS URL and API token in Settings. To reach a server through another route, use a VPN on your device.

apple-macos:6777889296.description:
Map Path quietly rewrites map links so they open in Apple Maps.
When a web page links to Google Maps, Waze, Bing Maps, or HERE WeGo — or uses a geo: link — Map Path changes that link so a tap opens the place, address, or coordinates in Apple Maps instead. No copy-paste, no app-switch dance.
It can also find addresses written in the page itself. Tap the Map Path button in Safari's address bar and it lists the addresses it spotted — tap one to open it in Apple Maps.
It runs entirely on your device. No network requests, no tracking, no analytics, no data collection.
WHAT IT DOES
• Rewrites links from Google Maps, Waze, Bing Maps, HERE WeGo, and geo: URIs to Apple Maps
• Finds plain-text addresses on a page and opens them in Apple Maps
• Carries the place, address, or coordinates straight over
• Keeps working as pages update — search results and single-page apps included
• Works on iPhone and iPad
WHAT IT DOESN'T DO
• Doesn't follow or unwrap shortened links (goo.gl, maps.app.goo.gl) — that needs a network request, and Map Path makes none
• Doesn't redirect pages you're already on — it only rewrites links before you tap them
• Doesn't change your default browser or touch any app other than Safari
PRIVACY
Everything happens locally in Safari. Map Path needs access to the pages you visit only so it can find and rewrite map links — nothing leaves your device. Page text is scanned for addresses only when you tap the Map Path button, and is discarded immediately. No accounts, no servers, no third parties. The source is open for inspection.
SETUP
After installing, turn Map Path on in Settings › Apps › Safari › Extensions, and set All Websites to Allow. The app walks you through it — and on iOS 26.2 and later it can take you straight to the right screen.
By CodeCrafted Apps.

flathub:io.github.alper_han.crossmacro.name: CrossMacro
flathub:io.github.alper_han.crossmacro.description:
CrossMacro is an open-source, cross-platform mouse and keyboard macro recorder, editor, and
 automation tool for Linux, Windows, and macOS. Record clicks, movement, scrolling, and keyboard
 input, then edit and replay macros with configurable speed, pauses, loops, repeat counts, delays,
 global hotkeys, or schedules.
 Linux-first Wayland and X11 support provides compositor-aware cursor positioning and daemon-backed
 or direct-device input paths. CrossMacro uses absolute mouse positioning when the active session
 exposes a compatible cursor-position protocol and falls back to relative input when that capability
 is unavailable. It also combines text expansion, screen-reading commands, native PNG image recognition,
 profiles, themes, a GUI, and a scriptable CLI in one application.
 Features:
 Record and replay mouse and keyboard macros with configurable timing and pause/resume control
 Edit macros with undo/redo, action reordering, coordinate modes, variables, loops, conditionals,
 and text input
 Bind macros to global hotkeys with toggle or hold-to-run modes
 Schedule macros at specific times or intervals, including one-time, weekly, custom weekday,
 and randomized intervals
 Expand text from global shortcuts with configurable typing methods
 Read screen pixels and search native PNG templates for image-based workflows
 Control playback speed from 0.1x to 10x, loops, repeat counts, and fixed or randomized repeat
 delays
 Save, load, sequence, and replay .macro files, then switch between profiles
 Customize themes and use the desktop GUI, CLI, or GUI-less runtime on Linux Wayland/X11,
 Windows, and macOS
 Use customizable global controls with F8 recording, F9 playback, and F10 pause as the defaults
 Wayland and X11 support:
 CrossMacro treats Wayland and X11 as first-class Linux targets and selects compositor-aware
 positioning and daemon-backed or direct-device input according to the active session's capabilities.
 On GNOME, a Shell Extension can be installed on first run. A logout/login may be required for
 the extension to take effect.
 If permissions are missing, the app offers Quick Setup on launch. Quick Setup opens a standard
 system authorization prompt to enable direct device access for the current user session. If setup
 cannot complete, use the direct-device troubleshooting instructions in the Linux guide's Flatpak
 On Wayland section, available through the Help link.

fedora-packages:foo2zjs/foo2oak.description: foo2oak is a printer driver for printers that use the Oak Technology (now Zoran) OAKT protocol for their print data, such as the HP Color LaserJet 1500, Kyocera KM-1635 and the Kyocera KM-2035. These printers are often erroneously referred to as winprinters or GDI printers. However, Microsoft GDI only mandates the API between an application and the printer driver, not the protocol on the wire between the printer driver and the printer. In fact, OAKT printers are raster printers which happen to use a fairly efficient wire protocol which was developed by Oak Technology and licensed by some printer manufacturers for at least some of their product lines. OAKT is just one of many wire protocols that are in use today, such as Postscript, PCL, Epson, ZjStream, etc.

firefox-addons:782771.name: Video Plus
firefox-addons:782771.summary: This add-on increases the display size of videos by removing unnecessary padding bars.
firefox-addons:782771.description:
So you want to watch that wide screen video on the entire surface of your 21:9 screen? No such luck if the uploader of the video for some reason decided to add black padding bars, which are not noticed on 16:9 screens. On a wider screen, you are stuck with black bars on all 4 sides of the video. For example a 21:9 video padded to 16:9 on a 21:9 "ultrawide" screen wastes mode than 40% of the screen on black bars — and this is very common for example for music videos on YouTube or older movies.
This extension changes that. While a video is played, it keeps scanning it for padding bars and zooms the video to crop of the edges as far as it is possible without stretching it or pushing content out to the sides. All black bars are effectively removed.
 Technical note :
To do its magic, this extension needs to know the actual dimensions of the video without padding, and the maximum area the video can cover without colliding with other page elements. Both can change without explicit notice, and for the former there isn't even a direct way to get it.
This extension therefore takes considerable shortcuts to keep the CUP usage low:
- The actual video dimensions (ignoring any added padding) have to be read from video frames:
  - Check whether the color is uniform along each edge, and if it is, probe how far inward that solid color goes.
  - This is probed at three places along each edge and the minimum of these probes is seen as padding in that frame and is cropped off.
- That check has to be performed on individual frames and, due to the way video streaming works in browsers, cant be done ahead of time (without considerable overhead and complications).
- As to not rely on a single frame that may not represent the entire video, the check is repeated every 0.3 to 2.5 seconds, depending on the previous rate of changes.
- To prevent stuttering due to frequently changing video zoom levels and positions, a delay of 5 seconds (configurable) is added before fully updating the video size.
- In addition to that, the screen area that is available for the video may change. This is re-evaluated after a number of user <--> page interactions.
 Permissions used :
- "Access your data for all websites", "Access browser tabs" and "Access browser activity during navigation": This extension can be configured (see its options page) to work on every website, so it needs to know when they are loaded and be allowed to access them. It only does that for the pages you chose ( youtube.com by default) and will never send data anywhere.
- "Display notifications to you": Tell you when something goes wrong, (so you should never see this ;) ).

firefox-addons:999243.summary: Easy to use and powerful image downloader for your browser
firefox-addons:999243.description:
Image Downloader is an addon for your browser that enables you to download all images within a webpage with just one click. 
Simply browse to a webpage and then wait for the images to completely load, then click on the toolbar button to open the app UI. Once the app is open, it starts to process the page in order to find all images. 
You can now click on a single image to download or click on the - Select All - button to select and download all images at once. Alternatively, you can select a single image to download. There are several settings to adjust in the app. For example, you can set the minimum and maximum image size, or even the type of the image to capture. 
If you right-click on the toolbar button, you can set the app to open in toolbar popup instead of a new tab. Please note that default option is opening in a new tab.
Please read FAQ page for this addon to get more info on how to work with this addon.

firefox-addons:3024412.name: Web Access Controller
firefox-addons:3024412.summary: Browser Extension to enforce Google, YouTube and Microsoft Access Controller feature from SEQRITE Endpoint Protection Console.
firefox-addons:3024412.description:
Web Access Controller
SEQRITE Endpoint Protection is introducing a new extension, Web Access Controller for the browser.
The Web Access Controller extension supports the following Features: 
Google and Microsoft Access Controller: This extension ensures that Users in your organization can sign into the Corporate Google or Microsoft Accounts on the Endpoint's browser only for specified domains. These domains will be configured by the Administrator to implement compliance and avoid abuse.
YouTube Access Controller: This extension ensures that Users in your organization only watch YouTube videos on the Endpoint's browser only of specified Category, Location, Channel, Publisher or Video ID.
The reports of allowed or blocked Google/Microsoft logins and YouTube videos browsed will be visible to the SEQRITE Endpoint Protection Administrator.
Features of Web Access Controller
• Allows Corporate Google/Microsoft Account as per the domains shared by the Endpoint Protection Administrator for log-ins.
• Blocks log-in to Personal Google/Microsoft accounts.
• Reports of allowed or blocked Google/Microsoft Account logins are generated and visible to Administrator.
• Controls enforced Google login for the following: direct login, sign-in with Google to any third-party website, popup for sign-in with Google, and signing into any Google service.
• Controls enforced Microsoft login for the following: direct login, sign-in with MS office to any office 365 apps, Microsoft Login to its service like Azure, OneDrive etc or third-party website, popup for sign-in with Microsoft.
• Allows or blocks the playing of YouTube videos as per the configuration shared by Endpoint Protection Administrator based on Video Category, Location, Channel, Publisher, and ID.
• Endpoint Protection Administrator can provide extension configuration centrally from the Endpoint Protection console.
How does it work?
1. The Web Access Controller Extension is installed by SEQRITE Endpoint Protection under ExtensionSettings Firefox Policy. On the EPP console, on the Web Security policy page, "Google Access Controller", "YouTube Access Controller" and "Microsoft Access Controller" settings are available.
2. After installation, if the Google Access Controller policy is enabled, all existing Google logins are signed out and further logins are monitored.
3. The extension is configured automatically from SEQRITE Endpoint Protection and does not have any options inside the browser or on an Endpoint for the User to edit. This extension must be used with SEQRITE Endpoint Protection; cannot be used independently.

firefox-addons:2912066.name: LanguageTool Website Spellcheck - LTWS
firefox-addons:2912066.summary: LanguageTool Website Spellcheck - LTWS is a convenient Firefox extension that allows you to check any text on web pages for spelling, grammar, and style issues using the powerful LanguageTool service.
firefox-addons:2912066.description:
Main Features: 
 Simple Text Checking : Select any text on a web page, right-click and choose "Check spelling" or use the hotkey CTRL+Q 
 Handy Sidebar : Clear presentation of all detected errors with correction suggestions
 Flexible Language Detection : Automatic language detection or manual selection from over 30 supported languages
 Smart Word List : Create a personal list of ignored words that you can import and export
 Two Checking Modes : Connect to a local LanguageTool server or use the public API
 Customizable Design : Choose between light, dark, or automatic theme (based on your system settings)
 Multilingual Support: 
The extension supports a wide range of languages, including:
Arabic, Asturian, Belarusian, Breton, Catalan, Chinese, Crimean Tatar, Danish, Dutch, English, Esperanto, French, Galician, German, Greek, Irish, Italian, Japanese, Khmer, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swedish, Tagalog, Tamil, Ukrainian
It automatically detects the language of the selected text or lets you manually select the desired checking language.
 Privacy and Public API Notes 
 The public API is rate-limited (20 requests/minute, 20KB/request)
 Text is sent to external servers when using the public API
 See the LanguageTool Privacy Policy 
 All communication with the LanguageTool API is done via HTTPS for security
 Installing a Local LanguageTool Server (optional): 
For maximum privacy and control, you can run your own LanguageTool server locally. This is especially useful if you want to check sensitive texts or avoid using the public API.
 Download LanguageTool from languagetool.org and extract the archive.
 Start the server with the gui (languagetool.jar) or in the extracted directory with:
 java -cp languagetool-server.jar org.languagetool.server.HTTPServer --port 8081
 For more details and advanced options, see the official guide: LanguageTool HTTP Server Guide 
 Who Will Find This Extension Particularly Useful? 
- Students and academics who need to produce error-free texts
- Bloggers and content creators who want to polish their online content
- Non-native speakers who need help with correct spelling
- Anyone who values correct spelling and grammar in their online communication
 Permissions: 
The extension requires certain permissions to function properly:
- Access to tabs and website content: To read and check the selected text
- Context menu access: For the "Check spelling" option in the right-click menu
- Storage access: To save your settings and list of ignored words
- Connection to LanguageTool servers: To perform spell checking (either locally or via the public API)
 Privacy: 
When using the public API, your text is sent to LanguageTool servers for checking. If you have privacy concerns, you can alternatively set up and use a local LanguageTool server.
Improve the quality of your texts on the web today with our handy spell checking tool!
 Legal Notice: 
This Firefox extension is a personal project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by LanguageTool or its developers. It is intended for educational and personal use only. The author does not claim any ownership of the LanguageTool brand or its associated trademarks.
 Disclaimer: 
This Firefox extension is provided 'as is', without any warranty, express or implied. Use entirely at your own risk. The author accepts no liability for any damage or loss arising from its use.

firefox-addons:2994389.name: CDD Stoichiometric Table Tools
firefox-addons:2994389.summary: Practical helpers for CDD Vault: sample panel, one-click copy, printable stoichiometry sheets, inventory and plate tools.
firefox-addons:2994389.description:
CDD Stoichiometric Table Tools adds small, practical helpers to the CDD Vault pages you already use. It began as a floating sample panel for ELN stoichiometry tables and has grown into a set of shortcuts for the ELN, Inventory, Search and Registration pages. Everything runs locally in your browser — except the optional AI write-up, which you switch on yourself.
 ELN entries 
 A floating panel lists every sample in the entry's reaction tables, grouped by reaction. Click any value to copy it; concentrations come out in CDD-ready units.
 Choose which fields to show — location, purity, density, MW, batch, owner, your vault's custom fields. Low-purity and depleted samples are flagged.
 Print a clean A4 stoichiometry sheet per reaction: scheme, masses, volumes, equivalents, yield.
 Work out the HPLC injection volume in the panel, and keep phrases you type often.
 Register a product straight from the entry — the form fills itself in and the batch gets the entry ID as its Internal ID.
 Optional AI write-up (off by default): dictate in Slovak, Czech or English, or select text, and get polished English back from the CERIT-SC language models — checked against the stoichiometry table, with compounds as CDD mentions, ready to copy.
 Inventory and plates 
 Pick Location: create several samples at once from empty wells, hover a well to see its structure, colour wells by sample-ID prefix.
 The location picker opens as a folder tree with search and arrow-key navigation. Scan a shelf of racks into a location with a barcode scanner.
 See where a plate physically lives, add a Location column to the Plates tab, export plate locations to CSV. Hover a plate-map well for its synonym and structure.
 Search and tables 
 The Filter and Keywords field pickers open as wide, searchable multi-column popovers instead of one long dropdown.
 Column Manager gets search, category chips and type badges.
 Sensible filter defaults ("has" for text, "from" for dates), Copy Link on saved searches, one-click copy on molecule and batch fields.
 Registration and dose-response 
 Entity-type lists in your order, defaulted to your last choice — in the Create Entity form and in bulk registration.
 Easy Override for dose-response curves, right in the search results.
 Settings 
Click the extension icon, or open CDD Plugin options from CDD's user menu. The basics work out of the box; newer helpers are switched on there.
 Not a CDD product 
This is an open-source extension written by CDD Vault users. Collaborative Drug Discovery does not build, endorse or support it. If something in CDD looks wrong, disable the extension, reload the page and check again before contacting CDD support. Report problems on GitHub .
 Privacy 
Runs only on CDD Vault pages. No accounts, no backend, no analytics — nothing leaves your browser, unless you switch on AI write-up: then the text you ask it to polish (and dictated audio) goes to CERIT-SC ( llm.ai.e-infra.cz ) under your own API key, only when you click. Structures are never sent. Full policy .
 What changed in each version

firefox-addons:7924.name: Tabhunter
firefox-addons:7924.summary: Find tabs in Mozilla-based browsers easily
firefox-addons:7924.description:
This extension lets Firefox (and Chrome) users easily juggle dozens of tabs at a time. Enter a search string (actually a standard JavaScript regex), highlight the URL you want to bring up, and press return or double-click it. Tabhunter will even bring up minimized windows containing the target tab.
Most web sites no longer play audio on load, but in case you hear sounds coming from your browser but don't know which of the 500 loaded tabs is the culprit, press the "Audio Only" checkbox to find it.
See the prefs to change font size.
The "More" section has more functionality: 
* manipulate the "Discarded" status of tabs, or avoid showing any discarded tabs
* move tabs to selected window
* bookmark selected tabs (firefox only)
Apart from fetching favicons associated with tabs that are currently loaded in your browser, Tabhunter does not transmit any information to other computers. It saves some innocuous usage-related preference information in the browser's local preference cache, and if other users have access to it, either use a better password or speak to the person who set up your machine. If you're unsure about this, find yourself another tab hunter, or go watch some old 1960s beach movies.

bluejetty:00029875:ios.description:
Take a cruise, go fishing, get treasures and much more! My City: Boat Adventure is where you can do whatever you want. Create your own stories, feel the excitement of going through the port control to board your favorite boat. Experience life on an isolated island, enjoy life on the Caribbean party island create your own adventures and stories. You are the captain and you make the rules in this game!
Over 100 million kids have played our games worldwide!
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
Think of this game as a fully interactive dollhouse in which you can touch and interact with almost every object you see. With fun characters and highly detailed locations, kids can role-play by creating and playing out their own stories.
Game features:
- This game has 8 new locations for kids to explore, role-play and layout their own stories.
- Fun puzzles to solve and hidden locations to discover.
- Lots of fun activities. Be the captain of your ship, live on a stranded island, create awesome parties and more!
- 20 Characters included in this game, feel free to take them to other games. The options are endless!
- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe
- Connects with other My City games: All My City games connect together allowing kids to share characters between our games. More games, More Story options, More Fun.
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: Easy enough for 4-year-olds to play and super exciting for 12 years to enjoy. My City games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room.
TO CONNECT THE GAME TO OTHER MY CITY GAMES:
Please ensure that all your My City games are installed and updated in your device.
PLAY TOGETHER
We support multi-touch so kids can play games together with friends and family on the same screen!
WE LOVE CREATING CHILDREN GAMES!

Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. bluejetty:00064182:ios.description:
Sudoku Master: A Mind-Engaging Puzzle Adventure!
Dive into the world of Sudoku Master, the ultimate game for both puzzle beginners and Sudoku savants! Whether you're seeking a mental workout or a relaxing pastime, Sudoku Master provides an immersive experience, replicating the classic joy of paper-and-pencil Sudoku in a sleek digital format.
Embark on a journey through various levels, from beginner-friendly puzzles to mind-bending expert challenges. With millions of Sudoku grids across four difficulty settings – easy, medium, hard, and expert – there's a puzzle for every mood and skill level.
Sudoku Master is crafted with exceptional features to enhance your gameplay. Opt for helpful guides like auto-tracking, automated controls, and duplicate highlights, or embrace the thrill of solving puzzles unaided in our manual mode. The choice is yours – tailor the challenge to your preference!

* Auto-Error Detection or Manual Mode for self-spotting mistakes

* A vast library of puzzles across varied difficulty levels
* Note-taking functionality to strategize and track possible solutions
* Easy Undo feature for stress-free corrections
* Supports 4x4 Mini Sudoku – perfect for beginners
* Share puzzles with friends to spark a friendly competition
* Leaderboards and achievements to see how you rank globally
* Sleek, user-friendly interface for seamless gameplay
* Save and load features to pick up right where you left off
Transform your device into a brain-boosting puzzle hub with Sudoku Master. Available for play anytime, anywhere – challenge your intellect and unwind with a grid today!

The Wonderlic test is a popular cognitive ability
bluejetty:00037356:ios.description:
Helping you pass your Wonderlic test is our primary goal. Study and prepare for the exam with a professional mobile app that will boost your confidence in passing the exam on the first try!
The Wonderlic test is a popular cognitive ability test used by employers to assess the aptitude and problem-solving skills of job candidates. It is often utilized as part of the hiring process, particularly for roles that require strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
Our application helps you to prepare for Wonderlic test with the required domain knowledge. The details are given below:
- General Knowledge
- Math
- Logic
- Verbal Reasoning
With our mobile apps, you can practice with systematic testing features and you can study with specialized content created by our exam experts, which will help you prepare to pass your exams more efficiently.
Key Features:
- Practice using more than 700 questions
- Choose the topics you need to focus on
- Versatile testing modes
- Great looking interface and easy interaction
- Study detailed data for each test.
- - - - - - - - - - - - -
Purchase, subscription and terms
You need to purchase a subscription to unlock the full range of features, topics and questions. The purchase will be automatically deducted from your iTunes account. Subscriptions are automatically renewable and billed according to the subscription plan and rate you choose. The auto-renewal fee will be charged to the user's account no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term.
After you purchase a subscription, you can manage your subscription and cancel, downgrade, or upgrade your subscription at any time in your Account Settings in iTunes. Unused portions of the free trial period (if provided) will be canceled when the user purchases a subscription to the publication, if applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://www.iprep.pro/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.iprep.pro/terms-of-use.html
Disclaimer : 
We provide practice questions and features for demonstrating the structure and wording of Wonderlic exam questions for learning purposes only. Your correct answers to these questions will not earn you any certificates, nor will they represent your score on the actual exam.
Legal Notice:
We are not affiliated with any testing organization, certificate, any trademark or exam name. All registered trademarks are the property of the respected trademark owners.

bluejetty:00083056:ios.summary:
UPS Employees can enjoy the convenience of performing the delivery and pickup functionality for usage on the road on their personal device.
The intuitiveness of the application guides you through the steps for completing the activity.
The
bluejetty:00083056:ios.description:
UPS Employees can enjoy the convenience of performing the delivery and pickup functionality for usage on the road on their personal device.
The intuitiveness of the application guides you through the steps for completing the activity.
The employee that is planned within the system will be provided with a manifest of their stops with ability to use navigation using their local maps.
On each stop the employee is provided stop details with any specific unique accessorials (COD, Signature Required, Adult Signature Required) or notes associated to that stop (Beware of Dog). Based on those accessorials the application will guide you through the best way to complete the delivery process.
Can’t complete the delivery? No problem the application also has the exceptions you would need to properly status for the customer.
Also, employees can enjoy the ability of building a manifest within the application by scanning the packages they will be servicing and through the integrated technology pull those stops into their manifest.
Completing pickup functionality can also be performed from within the application.
Two way communication between the local center and you allows for engaging on updates as necessary.
The use of this application is available in full when the UPS employee signs up through the BYOD process.

bluejetty:00096420:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00096420:ios.description:
Push to Victory!
Step into Chess Rumble, where chess meets PvP card battles.
Collect cards, build powerful decks, unleash combos, and fight global players.
A unique strategy experience combining chess-like tactics and card battle excitement.
[A New Kind of Strategy Card Game]
- Every match feels like a battle of minds with turn-based mechanics.
- Anticipate your opponent’s move and counter with smart card plays.
- Outsmart rivals by linking skills into powerful combo chains.
- Each turn matters, and every decision shapes the outcome.
[Build and Upgrade Your Deck]
- Collect more than 60 cards featuring heroes, minions, and spells.
- Upgrade cards to unlock stronger abilities and better strategies.
- Experiment with combinations to create your ultimate deck.
- Choose between aggressive attacks or defensive plays to suit your style.
[Thrilling Combos]
- Connect character skills to trigger powerful combo chains.
- The bigger the combo, the more overwhelming the victory.
- Decks built with combo synergy can completely dominate battles.
- Show off your creativity and timing with unique strategies.
[Chess-Inspired Movement]
- Move heroes across the board to control the battlefield.
- Use the push mechanic to disrupt enemy formations.
- Protect your hero or open attack lines with smart movement.
- Just like chess, a single move can decide victory or defeat.
[Spells That Change the Game]
- Cast spells to recover, boost, or disrupt the opponent.
- A well-timed spell can flip the match in your favor.
- Spells add depth to strategy and make battles dynamic.
- Every spell card gives you new ways to adapt in PvP.
[Global Arena Battles]
- Join real-time battles with players from around the world.
- Climb the ranks and unlock new arenas as you rise.
- Earn rewards and strengthen your deck through victories.
- Compete against new rivals and prove your mastery.
[Clans & Community]
- Join a clan and team up with allies.
- Participate in clan-exclusive events and content.
- Share strategies and enjoy rewards together.
- Connect with a global community of strategy players.
Chess Rumble blends chess-inspired tactics with card battle intensity.
Build your deck, master combos, and climb the global arena.
Download now and experience a strategy card game unlike any other!

bluejetty:00122896:ios.description:
Get rich or dine trying with Liven, a simple way to earn huge rewards every time you eat out.
Buy now and eat more later to grab up to 30~100% bonus food in advance with Brandollars or earn 5~30% loyalty rewards back every time you pay your bill. 
Join over 700,00 foodies who pay at over 1,000 restaurants, cafes and bars in Sydney, Melbourne, and now Brisbane, including fan favourites Din Tai Fung, Gelato Messina, CoCo Fresh Tea and Juice, NeNe Chicken, Roll'd, MoVida, Maha and China Bar, Gotcha who all accept LivenPay.
***** "Got my free meal after my first payment and I gotta say It's like Amex but way better in every way since it cost me nothing to join!"
***** "So simple. Helped me pay for my meal and I earned enough back for my next visit. Already got 5 of my mates on it and have been eating free all month."
***** "I've saved over $100! Being rewarded after the meal makes such a big difference - I feel like a VIP, not like those deal and discount apps where I get treated terribly in store."
HOW DOES IT WORK?
- Browse amazing restaurants
- Order your meal
- Pay for your meal with the Liven app
- Earn amazing rewards when you pay with Liven
- If you like, buy a venue's Brandollars. These are food credits, purchased in advance to lock in even bigger bonuses to feast through the years ahead. 
As a new user, get rewarded with 100% of your first bill back in Liven Rewards when you pay for your first transaction. See T&C's for details.
DISCOVER
Browse over a thousand of the best restaurants, bars and cafés in the country handpicked and curated just for you.
BRANDOLLARS
Buy credits with your favourite foodie spots and get up 100% bonus credits to spend whenever it suits you. Even if you take years to eat through it, we guarantee that your purchased Brandollars are protected. There’s no expiry, so go nuts with your future social calendar, birthdays, anniversaries, parties, gifts or even hoarding up as part of your apocalypse plan. You do have a plan right? 
PAY
Make instant payments at the register with your phone! Simply select the merchant you're paying with, tap "Pay now", and then watch the rewards roll in. 
EARN REWARDS
Earn up to 30% of your total bill! Whether you're feeling like a quick pickup meal, order takeout, dining in or just grabbing a coffee, you can easily score $30 when grabbing the bill.
SAVE OR SPEND
Rewards you earn are stored securely in your Liven wallet, ready to spend at Liven venues.
SEND LIVEN REWARDS:
Share Liven Rewards with friends or colleagues with instant peer-to-peer transfer. Use this to send a gift, split a bill, settle a debt, or just to be nice. Just enter their unique @handle, specify an amount, and hit send.
No matter your preference in food we have you covered!

bluejetty:00156046:ios.description:
Meest – International Shipping, Parcel Delivery & Package Tracking
Send parcels worldwide with ease and confidence using Meest. Create shipments, schedule courier pickups, track packages in real time, and manage international delivery directly from your mobile device.
Whether you're sending gifts to family, fulfilling business orders, or handling regular cross-border shipments, Meest makes parcel delivery simple, affordable, and reliable.
Ship to 200+ destinations worldwide, including Ukraine, Poland, India, Canada, the USA, the UK, and countries across Europe, Asia, South America and beyond. From express shipping and courier delivery to larger freight shipments, Meest offers a complete international logistics solution in one easy-to-use app.
Create Shipping Labels in Minutes
Generate shipping labels, customs documentation, and parcel declarations directly from the app. Prepare domestic and international shipments quickly, reduce paperwork, and manage all your shipping information in one place.
AI-Powered Parcel Content
Easily add your parcel contents with AI-powered categorization, voice input, and helpful alerts about shipping restrictions.
Non-Standard Packaging
Easily indicate special packaging requirements when creating your shipment.
Schedule Courier Pickup
Book a courier pickup from your home or office whenever it's convenient. Avoid unnecessary trips and let your shipment begin its journey directly from your doorstep.
Find Nearby Drop-Off Locations
Locate the nearest Meest branch, partner location, or parcel drop-off point using the integrated map. Access thousands of convenient shipping locations, including more than 10,000 partner drop-off points across Canada, the USA, and the UK.
Real-Time Package Tracking
Track packages and monitor shipment progress from pickup through customs clearance and final delivery. Receive shipment updates and stay informed about the status of every parcel.
Secure In-App Payments
Pay for domestic and international shipping securely within the app. Enjoy transparent pricing, fast checkout, and full visibility into shipping costs before you send.
Worldwide Shipping Network
Meest partners with trusted global courier and logistics providers to ensure reliable delivery around the world. Our network includes leading carriers such as UPS, USPS, DHL, Canada Post, Purolator, Canpar, DPD, Evri, Parcelforce, Royal Mail, FedEx and many others.
Personal & Business Shipping Solutions
Whether you're sending a gift to loved ones abroad, managing e-commerce deliveries, shipping business orders, or arranging freight transportation, Meest offers flexible shipping options to meet your needs. Choose from courier delivery, branch pickup, door-to-door shipping, and international parcel forwarding services.
Why Choose Meest?
• International shipping to 200+ destinations
• Real-time parcel tracking
• Fast shipping label creation
• Courier pickup scheduling
• Door-to-door delivery options
• Secure online payments
• Competitive shipping rates
• Business and personal shipping solutions
• Reliable worldwide logistics network
• Regional first-shipment discounts
Meest simplifies domestic and international parcel delivery by combining package tracking, courier services, shipping label creation, and secure payments in a single platform. Whether you're sending a package to Ukraine, shipping a parcel to Poland, delivering gifts to India, or managing shipments across Canada, the USA, and the UK, Meest helps ensure your parcels arrive safely and on time.
Download Meest today and manage your international shipping, parcel delivery, package tracking, and global logistics needs with ease.

bluejetty:00068988:ios.summary:
Are you ready to conquer Chinese characters and accelerate your Mandarin language learning journey? Look no further, Ginkgo Chinese is the ultimate app for mastering Chinese characters with ease!
Our app offers an extensive library of 300
bluejetty:00068988:ios.description:
Are you ready to conquer Chinese characters and accelerate your Mandarin language learning journey? Look no further, Ginkgo Chinese is the ultimate app for mastering Chinese characters with ease!
Our app offers an extensive library of 300 immersive video classes that bring the story behind each character to life, providing you with valuable insights, examples, and mnemonic tips. Dive deep into the etymology, history, and cultural significance of each character, enhancing your understanding and facilitating your memorization of Chinese characters!
Say goodbye to monotony and hello to an interactive learning experience! Our unique teaching methodology intelligently alternates between captivating video lessons and dynamic flashcards, ensuring an optimal balance to keep you engaged and motivated while effortlessly memorizing how to write, speak and read Chinese characters. This dynamic combination keeps your interest piqued and enhances your Mandarin Chinese character retention like never before.
Immerse yourself in the beauty of Mandarin Chinese characters. Each Flashcards is illustrated by a meaningful picture, and each tone has its own color to reinforce your learning through visual cue and repetition. Our 1500 carefully designed flashcards will help you to gradually memorize all the Mandarin vocabulary words from HSK 1 to HSK 4. After a few swipes, you will already start to grow your vocabulary up and improve your Mandarin Chinese skills.
Ginkgo Chinese leverages the power of technology and the latest advances in neuroscience. Our app optimizes the pacing of video lessons and flashcards to match your learning style and preferences. Whether you prefer a faster pace or require more time for reflection, our intelligent learning algorithm adapts to your unique needs, providing a personalized and enjoyable learning experience. You learn Chinese at your own pace and see real progress over time.
In our quest to provide you with the most authentic language learning experience, each flashcard in our app is accompanied by native recordings. You'll hear the precise pronunciation of each Chinese character, ensuring that you develop accurate speaking skills and a natural accent. With every touch of a flashcard, you'll be immersed in the sounds of Mandarin language as if you were conversing with a native speaker.
Embarking on your Mandarin journey might seem daunting, especially when it comes to conquering Chinese characters. However, the truth is far from the perceived complexity if you use the right tools. With just 30 minutes of dedicated learning per day, you'll be amazed at how swiftly you can master your first 150 characters and reach the level HSK 1 in a mere two weeks. See how easy it is to learn Chinese Mandarin with our app!
Ginkgo Chinese is here to accompany you every step of the way through HSK 1, HSK 2, HSK 3, and HSK 4 levels, unlocking new depths of language proficiency. You’ll also delve into invaluable topics like Chinese radicals, Mandarin classifiers, or the Pinyin alphabet, expanding your linguistic horizons. No matter where you are on your Mandarin language journey, our app is your ideal companion. Beginners can build a solid foundation, while advanced learners can fine-tune their Chinese skills and re-discover Chinese hanzi in a new and exciting way.
Navigating through our app is as effortless as saying hello. With a simple swipe to the right if you recall a character or to the left if you need a refresher, you seamlessly engage with our flashcards. The app's intelligent algorithm works its magic, automatically introducing new Chinese characters when you're ready and scheduling reviews to reinforce your learning. Before you know it, your vocabulary expands, and your Chinese skills flourish.
Embark on a fascinating journey to unlock the secrets of Chinese Characters. Download Ginkgo Chinese now and learn Chinese characters faster than ever!

Invest in private markets and pre-IPO companies through StartEngine — the platform where everyday investors access deals once reserved for venture capitalists and institutions.

Trade shares of private companies on StartEngine's secondary marketplace. Build your position or get liquidity without waiting for an IPO.

Connect with over a million investors and founders. Ask founders questions directly, follow company updates, and stay informed as your investments develop.
With the StartEngine app you can:
- Browse pre-IPO companies and secondary market listings
- Buy and sell shares in private companies
- Invest in startup equity crowdfunding campaigns
- View SEC filings, team details, and company updates
- Follow companies and track campaign milestones
- Monitor your full investment portfolio in one place
"StartEngine" refers to StartEngine Crowdfunding, Inc. StartEngine operates 4 wholly owned subsidiaries, StartEngine Capital, LLC, StartEngine Primary, LLC, StartEngine Secure, LLC, and StartEngine Assets, LLC. Unless otherwise indicated, Regulation Crowdfunding offerings are offered through StartEngine Capital LLC, an SEC-registered funding portal and FINRA member; brokerage services, including Regulation A+ offerings, Regulation CF offerings, Regulation D offerings, brokerage accounts, and securities trading through StartEngine Secondary (a SEC-regulated alternative trading system, operated by StartEngine Primary, LLC), are offered through StartEngine Primary, LLC, a broker-dealer registered with the SEC and FINRA/SIPC; and transfer agent services are offered through StartEngine Secure, LLC, an SEC registered transfer agent. StartEngine Assets LLC is an asset manager for StartEngine Collectibles Fund I LLC which offers Regulation A+ offerings in collectibles (e.g., fine art, wine) through the StartEngine platform.
Raise amount includes $760M in funds raised as of May 9, 2023 via Reg. CF and Reg. A+ combined through StartEngine's funding portal and broker dealer, StartEngine Capital, LLC and StartEngine Primary, LLC respectively, as well as StartEngine's own raises. Also includes $470M in funds raised previously through offerings conducted on www.seedinvest.com outside of the StartEngine platform. In May 2023, StartEngine acquired assets of SeedInvest, including email lists for SeedInvest's users, investors and founders seeking to raise funds. User count of 1.8 million is determined as the number of unique email addresses in StartEngine's database as of 10-6-2023.

bluejetty:00161319:ios.summary:
Make room for the photos, files, and memories that matter.
Cleaner AI helps you organize your iPhone with practical cleanup tools for photos, videos, contacts, and more. Scan your library, review smart suggestions, and decide what to keep
bluejetty:00161319:ios.description:
Make room for the photos, files, and memories that matter.
Cleaner AI helps you organize your iPhone with practical cleanup tools for photos, videos, contacts, and more. Scan your library, review smart suggestions, and decide what to keep, archive, compress, or remove.
PHOTO CLEANUP
• Find similar photos and burst shots
• Keep the best photo from each group
• Spot blurry and low-quality photos
• Organize screenshots in one place
• Review photos before removing them
• Swipe through photos to keep, archive, or review later
VIDEO AND MEDIA CLEANUP
• Find large videos taking up valuable space
• Review video groups before deleting
• Create smaller copies of supported videos
• Choose between detail-focused and space-saving compression
• Convert Live Photos to still images
• Keep originals until you confirm their removal
PRIVATE VAULT
Move selected photos into a private space protected by your passcode. Review, restore, export, or permanently remove private items when you choose.
CONTACTS HEALTH
Keep your address book easier to manage.
• Find possible duplicate contacts
• Review similar contact groups
• Identify contacts with missing names or contact details
• Preview changes before cleaning
• Create local contact backups
• Restore missing contacts when needed
• Undo supported cleanup actions
CLEANING PROGRESS
See the results of your cleanup over time.
• Track photos cleaned
• Track space reclaimed
• View monthly progress
• Build a cleaning streak
• Revisit memories from previous years with On This Day
• Create a yearly cleaning summary
WIDGETS AND SHORTCUTS
Check your cleaning progress, storage status, and next action from your Home Screen. Use supported Shortcuts and app actions to check your latest scan and cleaning progress.
MORE DEVICE TOOLS
Cleaner AI also includes simple tools for everyday device care:
• Network speed test
• Speaker care
• Water eject assistance
• Microphone check
• Hearing and frequency exploration tools
DESIGNED WITH PRIVACY IN MIND
Photo and contact matching are designed to run on your iPhone. Your photos and contacts stay on your device during cleanup, and nothing is removed without your confirmation.
Cleaner AI is made for a crowded camera roll, too many screenshots, blurry memories, large videos, duplicate contacts, and the everyday clutter that builds up over time.
Clean up with confidence—and keep more of what matters. 
Subscription terms：
For unlocking all features and content, Premium Membership offers auto-renewable subscription options:
Weekly & year payment subscription options.
Auto-Renewing Subscriptions:
Payment is charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation.
Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your account settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a 
subscription.
Privacy policy: https://appsresouce.guohuiapps.site/PrivacyPolicy/cleaner/PrivacyPolicy.html
Terms of use: https://appsresouce.guohuiapps.site/TermsofUse/cleaner/TermsofUse.html

STARFISHTM Smart lighting connects life and home together helping enhance convenience, security, atmosphere and wellness. The STARFISHTM app synchronizes your
bluejetty:00044952:ios.description:
Satco’s STARFISHTM app brings you a simple, scalable, smart lighting solution!
STARFISHTM Smart lighting connects life and home together helping enhance convenience, security, atmosphere and wellness. The STARFISHTM app synchronizes your life and home using mobile and activated devices.
Transition daily routines, add light for safety, color the atmosphere, STARFISHTM connects your home and life.
COMPATIBILITY
The STARFISHTM app integrates with Hey Google, Siri, and Alexa for voice control. STARFISHTM is also compatible with SmartThingsTM for total home integration.
CONNECT ANYONE
Your STARFISHTM home allows for secure multi-device and multi-user access. The whole family can connect, set scenes and personalize their space. When you have guests they can enjoy the freedom of smart light control and you can set the parameters. Allow for control of a room through "device" selection, or give them control of the entire home. Guests can operate STARFISHTM without disrupting your settings or you can allow them to create their own settings—it's up to you. 
CONNECT ANYWHERE
Access your home through the STARFISHTM app with your secure login anywhere in the world. You will never be out of touch.
SECURITY
Whether lighting your way for a sure-footed path or gaining peace of mind while you’re away, STARFISHTM adds that extra layer of security though automations and control of your home using voice activation and mobile technology.
ATMOSPHERE 
Create the mood. Dynamic scene setting with millions of colors strike up just the right atmosphere. Tone the room, dim the lights, own that personal space! Combine color changing products, light settings, groupings and electronics to personalize the moment.
CONVENIENCE
Set up your home to transition with your daily activities. Adjust the intensity of light to coincide with a task. Make certain your lights are off when you leave. Schedule your light so you return in the evening to a safe and well-lit home. You can voice activate lighting in an emergency. 
WELLNESS 
When you wake, set your lighting to gently follow the sleep/wake cycle, correlate color temperatures to adjust with natural daylight, match your lighting to seasonal patterns. Natural and human centric lighting are thought to enhance wellness and positivity.

Welcome to TidyUp: Satisfying Games, the ultimate sanctuary for those who find peace in perfection and joy in organization. If you love the feeling of a clean room, a perfectly sorted drawer, or the soothing sounds of ASMR, this is the oddly satisfying game you’ve been looking for.
In TidyUp, your mission is simple yet deeply rewarding: transform chaos into harmony. From sorting colorful items by size and color to fitting objects perfectly into tight spaces, every level is designed to melt your stress away and satisfy your inner perfectionist.
Why you’ll love TidyUp:
Oddly Satisfying Gameplay: Experience the "just right" feeling as you click, snap, and slide items into their rightful places.
Relaxing ASMR Sounds: Immerse yourself in high-quality haptic feedback and soothing sound effects that make every move feel incredibly real.
Zen Organizing Puzzles: Challenge your brain with clever sorting puzzles that are easy to play but hard to put down.
Stress Relief & Calm: Escape the daily grind with a game designed to help you relax, focus, and find your zen.
Minimalist Aesthetic: Enjoy clean visuals and beautiful 3D graphics that make tidying up a visual treat.
Whether you are a fan of organizing games, sorting puzzles, or simply looking for a satisfying escape, TidyUp offers a cozy atmosphere to unwind. It’s more than just a game—it’s a digital therapy for your mind.
Can you tidy it all? Download TidyUp: Satisfying Games today and start your journey to a more organized, peaceful life!

bluejetty:00043826:ios.description:
eDryv – Transportation as a Service
At eDryv, we’re on a mission to transform urban mobility. Our fully electric transportation-as-a-service platform is all about smart, safe, and sustainable journeys. With a fleet of modern electric vehicles, professionally trained drivers, and state-of-the-art charging infrastructure, we’re here to provide transportation services that are not only premium but also eco-friendly.
Why Choose eDryv?
100% ELECTRIC FLEET 
Enjoy a smooth, quiet ride in our cutting-edge EVs. Every journey is powered by clean energy, backed by dedicated maintenance and charging facilities.
YOUR SAFETY IS OUR PRIORITY
We’ve built eDryv with your security in mind. Our multi-layered safety approach includes:
Real-time trip monitoring to track your ride for added security.
Thorough driver verification, ensuring only trained and professional drivers are behind the wheel.
24/7 customer and IT support, so help is always just a tap away.
Emergency assistant features within the app, offering quick access to help when needed.
STAY CONNECTED ON THE GO
Need to catch up on work or just want to stay connected? We offer complimentary in-car WiFi along with interactive entertainment on our in-vehicle screens.
EARN AS YOU RIDE
With our unique Green Coin rewards program, every ride you take helps offset carbon emissions. It’s our way of thanking you for joining us on the path to a greener future.
TURN RIDE TIME INTO EARNING TIME WITH ADS
Our in-vehicle advertisement platform lets you watch, create, and share ads; Making your ride not just comfortable, but also a chance to earn or promote your ideas.
BOOK FOR OTHERS
Need to send a ride for a friend, family member, or colleague? Our proxy ride feature lets you seamlessly book a trip on their behalf, ensuring they get to their destination safely and on time. Perfect for businesses, parents, or those assisting elderly relatives.
PLAN RIDES AHEAD
Avoid last-minute rushes by scheduling your rides in advance. Whether you have an early morning flight, an important meeting, or a planned outing, secure a guaranteed pickup at your chosen time.
FLEXIBLE RENTALS 
Need a vehicle for a few hours, a full day, or even longer? With eDryv Rentals, you get:
A fleet of electric vehicles available for flexible rental periods.
Personal or business use options.
A better alternative to traditional car ownership or leasing.
Questions? Get in touch at https://edryv.io
Follow us on Social media for updates, discounts, and offers!
Facebook – eDryv Mobility
Instagram - edryvmobility
Tiktok – edryv.mobility
X (formerly Twitter) - @eDryvmobility

bluejetty:00033637:ios.summary: - IPC360 provides home users with 360 extraordinary experience as staying home when they are away from home. With the establishment of worldwide stream servers, users can easily feel home on their phone or tablet by watching, listening and
bluejetty:00033637:ios.description:
- IPC360 provides home users with 360 extraordinary experience as staying home when they are away from home. With the establishment of worldwide stream servers, users can easily feel home on their phone or tablet by watching, listening and talking.
-When a Pan&Tilt camera is added, you can create panoramic navigation picture，with which you can simply rotate the camera exactly to the direction you want just by a “tap”. You can set maximum 3 sets of shooting angels via panoramic navigation picture.
-With a simple tap on your mobile phone, you can initiate a 2-way conversation with your family remotely. Its specially designed microphone and speaker ensures loud and clean voice quality.
-By simply panning your mobile phone left and right, a complete panoramic view will be displayed to provide a better viewing experience. The gyroscope support, integrated in the App, is able to follow the mobile phone orientation, making it easier to see every corner being monitored.
Functions：
 -The IPC360 camera uses wide-angle lens to produce bright and crystal images. With FHD/HD resolution (1920x1080/1280x720), it delivers excellent image quality even if your enlarged to view small details.
-IPC360 camera always keeps an eye on things that is important to you. With built-in high accuracy motion detection technology, the camera sends notification to your mobile phone detailing when, where, and what movement was detected so you always stay on top of things that you care about. As additional function, there are some kinds of camera have PIR sensor, which can detection the invisible radiation from human body.
-Support up to 128GB SD card, it stores video and audio of special moments, worked with two mode: continue(real time record) or trigger(best storage capacity optimization) mode.
-Our adaptive streaming technology automatically adjust to the optimal viewing quality based on your network conditions.

bluejetty:00174192:ios.summary: Sound Oasis is the world leader in sound therapy systems. We take tinnitus therapy seriously and it is our hope that this application will provide relief for your tinnitus symptoms. This app was designed to complement our BST-100-ADCO Sound
bluejetty:00174192:ios.description:
Sound Oasis is the world leader in sound therapy systems. We take tinnitus therapy seriously and it is our hope that this application will provide relief for your tinnitus symptoms. This app was designed to complement our BST-100-ADCO Sound Therapy System to provide our military service men and women with even greater tinnitus relief at home or while traveling.
This app provides the following features:
- 30 “made for tinnitus therapy” sounds.
- A unique 12-band audio equalizer.
- A white noise overlay sound that you can add to any sound track on this app.
- Information on how Sound Oasis and other resources can help you manage tinnitus more effectively.
How Does This APP Work?
The sounds in this app can be an effective tool to manage your tinnitus using sound therapy and sound masking to make tinnitus symptoms less noticeable. This masking effect can be particularly effective at night when the surrounding environment is quieter. By listening to pleasant sounds, particularly sounds close to the frequency level of your tinnitus symptoms, your brain will predominantly hear the pleasant sound instead of the annoying tinnitus noise.
SESSION TIMER
- 5 to 120 minute session timer with continuous therapy option.
12 BAND GRAPHIC EQUALIZER WITH INDIVIDUAL SOUND MEMORY
- Control precise frequency levels of sound playback with exclusive 12 band graphic equalizer.
- Tune each sound to your personal frequency levels.
- Automatically save up to 2 of your favorite equalizer settings for each sound.
WHITE NOISE OVERLAY
Allows you to add an adjustable level of white noise to each sound track for even greater tinnitus therapy.
SOFT-OFF VOLUME MANAGEMENT
- Full volume control with soft-off volume management.
FREE ACCESS TO ALL NEW SOUNDS
- Free access to new sounds and features with regular application updates offered through the App Store.
Disclaimer: this application is not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. We assume no liability for any personal harm or injury sustained as a result of using this application.

bluejetty:00095354:ios.description:

Pounce into a magical merge journey with adorable kitties today!

Merge cute ingredients into meow-gical recipes and build a cozy cat share house for your whiskered friends!

Are you ready to dive into one of the cutest cat games ever? 
Merge ingredients, cook tasty recipes, and build a dreamy cat home.
Collect cats and enjoy simple mini-games as your cozy world grows. 

If you love cat games, merge games, cooking, and decorating, this is your perfect escape. It's one of the top cat games among the merge games out there! 

▶ Cats & Soup : Magic Recipe features: 
- Merge & Match: Collect ingredients, merge items to unlock magical recipes. 
- Collect Cute Cats: Meet 100+ adorable cats and dress them in charming outfits.
- Renovate & Build: Grow your cats' magic tree house.
- Claim Daily Rewards: Join daily missions and limited-time events to earn exclusive prizes.
- Uncover the Story: Discover the mystery behind the enchanted cat forest.
- Cozy & Relaxing Mini-Games: Take quick, fun breaks in your cat-filled world! 

Do you enjoy relaxing cat games like Cats & Soup, Squishmallows Match, Neko Atsume, Office Cat, or Animal Crossing? 
Or merging games like Merge Cooking, Tasty Travels, Gossip Harbor, Merge Studio, Merge Inn, Hello Kitty My Dream Store, or Travel Town?
Then this will be your next favorite merge & cat game!

Start merging, cooking, and building the coziest cat world today.

bluejetty:00166089:ios.name: AI Storyteller: Fairy Tales
bluejetty:00166089:ios.summary:
Stories Teller is the ultimate bedtime app for parents who want to create magical, educational, and personalized storytelling experiences for their children.
Combining the power of artificial intelligence with classic fairy tales and moral
bluejetty:00166089:ios.description:
Stories Teller is the ultimate bedtime app for parents who want to create magical, educational, and personalized storytelling experiences for their children.
Combining the power of artificial intelligence with classic fairy tales and moral stories, this app is designed to help children learn important life lessons while making bedtime unforgettable.
Why Parents Love Stories Teller:
- AI-Powered Personalized Stories: Choose your child’s name, appearance, and the moral you want to teach. Every story makes your child the star, sparking their imagination and helping them learn valuable life lessons like kindness and bravery. Whether they’re exploring enchanted forests, fantasy kingdoms, or distant galaxies, each story is crafted with love and care to match your selections.
- Teach Valuable Life Lessons: More than just entertainment, each story is designed to help you instill values in your child. Whether you want your kid to learn about honesty or compassion, our wide selection of moral stories helps turn bedtime into a meaningful moment of learning.
- Classic Fairy Tales and Editorial Stories: In addition to personalized stories, Stories Teller offers a library of timeless fairy tales and biographies of great historical figures retold as enchanting stories. From Cinderella to stories of real-life heroes, there’s something for every child to enjoy. These stories not only captivate young imaginations but also inspire and educate.
- Beautiful Illustrations & Custom Songs: Every story, whether classic or personalized, is brought to life with vibrant, colorful illustrations that captivate your child’s imagination. Additionally, you can customize soothing bedtime songs to match the mood of each story, ensuring your child has a peaceful, immersive experience that helps them drift off to sleep.
- Record Your Own Voice: Make bedtime even more personal by recording your voice reading the stories. Your child will feel comforted as they drift off to sleep listening to you.
- Save and Revisit Stories: All your personalized stories are saved in the app’s library, allowing you to revisit your child’s favorite adventures anytime.
Stories Teller isn’t just about telling bedtime stories; it’s about making bedtime a special, educational, and emotionally rewarding experience for both parents and children. With AI-powered personalization, moral lessons, and innovative features like customizable illustrations and songs, this app is the perfect tool for parents who want to nurture their child’s imagination and character development from an early age.
Download Stories Teller today and turn every bedtime into a magical adventure. Perfect for parents who want to combine fun, learning, and the joy of storytelling into a unique and memorable good night experience.

bluejetty:00134530:ios.description:
Ensure the safety and security of your children with Phone Locator 360, designed with family protection in mind. With this app, you can effortlessly keep tabs on your loved ones' whereabouts, ensuring they're always safe, all with their voluntary consent for tracking.
Features of Phone Locator 360:
- Kid-safe tracking: Easily locate your children using just their phone number.
- Voluntary consent-based: Peace of mind for both parents and children, as tracking requires mutual agreement, respecting everyone's privacy and autonomy.
- Uncompromised privacy: Your family's private data remains secure with our app's high-security standards, so you can focus on what's important.
With Phone Locator 360, you're not just connected, you're protected! It's more than an app, it's a commitment to keeping your family safe. Whether it's ensuring your kids are safe on their way home from school or locating your device, Phone Locator 360 brings convenience, security, and peace of mind together. 
Keep your family close and safe with Phone Locator 360.
Subscription conditions:
- After you subscribe, you can manage your account and turn off automatic renewal in Account Settings.
- Your subscription is renewed automatically if you do not cancel it within 24 hours before its expiration date.
- When you purchase the app, your iTunes account is billed.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Automatic renewals will cost the actual price shown in Subscription conditions section.
- Any unused time left on your trial subscription will disappear if you upgrade to the paid version.
- Your personal data is stored securely.
- Privacy Policy: https://phonelocator360.com/privacy-policy
- Terms of Use: https://phonelocator360.com/terms-of-use

*** Over 5 million players have joined the Word Wow community. 
" (5/5) Big City was worth the wait! I'm enjoying it even more than Word Wow and those are some big shoes to fill." - Rosalee M.
Word Wow BIG CITY is here! The worm is back for another adventure and this time the race has moved to the city.
Challenge your word making skills to help navigate Worm down buildings of death defying heights. Puzzle your way down and around obstacles, before time runs out.
Think strategically to earn bonus points and stars. Your live worldwide rank will be revealed at the end of each level.
You'll be equipped with letter-clearing bombs along the way, but be sure to earn more to use in a pinch.
Collect all of the hidden gems to unlock secret bonus levels where you can really rack up the points!
The bigger the word, the more points you'll earn. Try and make enough points in each level to earn all three stars.
Word Wow BIG CITY will sharpen your brain as well as your reflexes. Help a worm out!
FEATURES
• Leave the dirt behind, there are buildings to climb!
• Hundreds of challenging levels to hone your word making skills and sharpen your brain.
• Adorable character and bright, colorful graphics transport you to the city.
• Over 215 hidden bonus levels for those that are dedicated.
• Earn boosters along the way.
• Live Ranking for each level among other Word Wow BIG CITY Players.
• Daily bonuses to help you when you need it.
** Word Wow REVIEWS **
5/5 “Highly Addictive!!! Can't get enough of Word Wow! Fun and easy to play!"
5/5 “This is a lot of fun and the worm is so cute!”
5/5 “Keeps your brain really sharp! Once you get started you just can't put it down.”
