bluejetty:00159213:ios.description:
Looking for an easier way to grocery shop, save money and manage your weekly grocery list? The JayC app makes grocery shopping simple with Delivery, Pickup and In-store options, digital coupons, weekly ads and personalized savings.
Download the JayC grocery app to shop groceries online and find the best deals all in one place.
Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Pickup (where available) or Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout
 • Use Kroger Pay for fast checkout in-store
 • Add your Plus Card Card to Apple Wallet
 • View purchase history and quickly reorder favorite items
Helpful Everyday Tools
 • Refill and track JayC Pharmacy prescriptions
 • Use the store locator to find the nearest JayC store or fuel center
Improving Your Experience
To provide and personalize our offerings, make recommendations, detect and prevent fraud, and improve our services, we use tools that collect and record your data, which may include your searches for and purchases of health and wellness products. We also may share non-sensitive data with third parties, such as advertising and analytics vendors, social networks, technology providers, and research providers. By continuing to use our websites and apps and shop our store, this means you consent to these practices and accept our Terms (https://www.jaycfoods.com/i/terms/website-and-app) and our Privacy Policy (https://www.jaycfoods.com/i/privacy-policy).
To use the JayC app, you need a JayC digital account. You can create a digital account and link your JayC Rewards ID through the app. Don't have a Rewards ID? You'll get one when you create your digital account and enroll in JayC's Rewards Program. You must be 18 to register for an account or join our rewards program (to obtain a Rewards ID). Terms apply: https://www.jaycfoods.com/i/terms/website-and-app.

Welcome to Perspective A.I. your ultimate AI-powered companion offering tailored guidance across all areas of life!
With Perspective A.I., you get four unique AI personas to help you navigate through various challenges:
• Mentor: Academic and career advice to help you reach your full potential.
• Librarian: Helps you discover useful information, inspires reading, and encourages learning new things.
• Hobby Instructor: Discover new hobbies or enhance your skills with personalized recommendations.
• Energy Booster: Keeps you motivated with tips for staying active and achieving small daily victories
Each persona in Perspective A.I. is equipped with its own unique, specially trained knowledge base, ensuring that you receive advice tailored to the specific area you’re engaging with.
With Perspective A.I., you’ll experience intelligent, conversational chats, where the AI adapts to your needs and provides accurate, reliable information in real-time. Whether it’s about personal growth, lifestyle, or hobbies, our chatbot has all the answers.
Key Features:
• 4 specialized AI assistants in one app.
• Tailored responses across a wide range of topics.
• User-friendly interface with real-time support.
• Evolving AI that keeps up with the latest trends and information.
Subscription Terms:
• “$7.99 per week” for unlimited chats with all four AI personas.
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation.
• Subscription auto-renews unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends.
Download Perspective A.I. now and unlock the power of personalized AI assistance like never before!

This app is not a substitute for professional medical advice. It does not provide professional medical, treatment, or fitness advice. Always consult a doctor, healthcare provider, or professional fitness instructor before making any decisions.

bluejetty:00068986:ios.name: Monitor Your Weight HD
bluejetty:00068986:ios.summary:
iPad version of 'Monitor Your Weight' - the Award Winning Weight Tracker App developed as a tool mainly to help motivate a person following a diet and/or exercise program to reach their desired target weight within a predefined period. 
*
bluejetty:00068986:ios.description:
iPad version of 'Monitor Your Weight' - the Award Winning Weight Tracker App developed as a tool mainly to help motivate a person following a diet and/or exercise program to reach their desired target weight within a predefined period. 
* Best App developed in Kuwait - Annual Informatics Awards *
* Winner of 7th Annual Best App Ever Awards under Health Category *
As the name indicates, you will be able to enter your weight on a regular basis and monitor your progress accordingly through means of statistics and graphs. You may also enter and track multiple profiles as well - monitor the progress of your family members, spouse, friends, colleagues - or simply create more than 1 profile for yourself to set partial targets until you reach your ultimate goal. 
This app will also suggest your ideal weight and recommend the amount of time needed to reach that target based on your current weight, height, body frame, gender, and age. You may, of course, choose to alter the suggested targets based on your own plans. 
Main Features: 
- Tracks single or multiple profiles 
- Track Body Measurements in addition to weight
- Option to synchronize your data between multiple devices or backup to our server
- Measurements may be represented in Kilos, Pounds, Stones, Meters or Feet 
- Calculates ideal weight based on age, height, gender and body frame 
- Full screen graph that shows your overall weight loss progress over time 
- BMI (Body Mass Index) calculated 
- Calculates daily calorie intake 
- Calculates percentage body fat 
- Total Weight Loss calculated 
- Remaining amount of weight calculated 
- Average Daily Loss calculated 
- Average Weekly Loss calculated 
- Overall progress calculated 
- Possibility to enter new weights at earlier dates 
- Displays an indicator to show the quality of your daily progress 
- PIN lock to secure your privacy 
- Show the remaining weight on the App Icon 
- Multiple Language localization supporting over 15 languages
- Possibility to export all your recorded data
- Integration with digital scales: Garmin, Withings, Aria, WiT

bluejetty:00143459:ios.description:
SeLoger is your go-to app to rent, buy or advertise real estate in France – fast, easy, and powered by AI. Whether you are looking for an apartment, house, flatshare, or garage, SeLoger is your reference for a wide selection of properties to rent or buy. Find your ideal apartment, house or flat for rent or sale in France with SeLoger.
Highlights of the SeLoger app:
• Browse a wide selection of properties – apartments, flats, houses & more
• Use the map or list and personalise your property search with filters
• Save searches and get instant alerts for new listings
• Collect all your favourites in one place with the memo
• Compare prices and get free property valuations
• List your home in seconds & connect with buyers instantly
• Manage listings and find estate agents
Real estate for rent
Our powerful search engine helps you to quickly find your next flat, house, studio, or room to rent from the largest selection of properties in France. Receive real-time alerts for new properties matching your search criteria and save your favourite listings for quick and easy reference. Detailed descriptions and virtual tours give you a clear view of the properties you're interested in.
Property for sale
Explore the largest selection of homes for sale in France, including houses, flats, land, offices, shops and garages, with our advanced search engine. Whether you're looking for a family home or a modern flat, find your ideal property in just a few clicks. Save your favourite listings, create personalised alerts and make your property purchase easier. Use our home loan calculator to estimate your monthly payments and make well-informed decisions about your property investments.
Sell your property
List your property for sale in seconds and connect with potential buyers through the SeLoger app. Manage your listings effortlessly, communicate with buyers, and close the deal quickly using our dedicated AI-tools.
Evaluate property prices
Quickly assess the value of your property and get advice on how to sell better with our free online valuation tool. You'll get an accurate estimate based on the location, size and features of your property. Compare recent sale prices for similar properties in your area to refine your estimate. Explore the improved My Owner space, where you can track, manage and receive advice on your project. Rent and sell your property for free on SeLoger today.
Ready to find your next home in France? Download SeLoger and start your search now!
Follow us on social media for the latest updates and property news:
• Facebook: @SeLoger
• Twitter/X: @SeLoger
• Instagram: @seloger
SeLoger, MySeLogerPro, Immowelt, Immonet, Immoweb, Meilleurs Agents, Belles Demeures, LogicImmo and Yad2 are part of the AVIV Group, one of the largest digital real estate technology companies in the world, with a strong presence in Europe.
Please share your experience with us by leaving a review on the Apple App Store. If you have any further questions, please contact us at mobile@seloger.com

bluejetty:00164780:ios.description:
"Prison Real Simulator" - Ready to Become the Prison Emperor?
Shape the future of your prison and rise to become a globally recognized prison empire! "Prison Empire" is an addictive simulation game that will test your strategy, management, and leadership skills.
Key Features:
Manage Inmates:
Take charge of your prison, meet the basic needs of your inmates, and make the right decisions to ensure security. Prevent riots, stop escape attempts, and provide your prisoners with a peaceful environment.
Upgrade Your Facilities:
Start with a small prison and develop every aspect, from security to comfort. Expand the yards, upgrade cells, improve kitchens, and build areas to meet inmates' social needs. Every investment you make will increase the efficiency of your prison.
Manage Your Staff:
For your prison to run smoothly, manage every department, from security guards to maintenance personnel. Direct each worker correctly to maximize the security and efficiency of your prison.
Increase Profitability:
Grow your prison through good management and earn profits. By making smart investments, you can open larger and more secure prisons. Boost your reputation to unlock larger projects and new prison offers.
Casual and Relaxing Gameplay Mechanics:
Prison management has never been this fun and relaxing! The game offers idle gameplay mechanics that will keep you entertained for hours, allowing your progress to continue even when you're not actively playing.
If you love management games, "Prison Empire: Rule the Dungeon!" offers you a powerful leadership experience. Are you ready to build an empire starting from a small prison?

bluejetty:00014897:ios.description:
Quote, track, invoice and get paid for jobs all within Xero, using Xero Projects - the all-in-one tool to track profitability on every job.
Great Features:
- Estimate job costs
- Breakdown projects by tasks
- Quotes & invoice faster and more accurately
- Track time multiple ways
- Track expenses
- Get paid faster with online payment
- Use timesheet to review time entries at a glance
- Monitor job profitability in real-time
How your business will benefit from Xero Projects:
• Fully integrated with Xero: link your bills and expenses so you know exactly where every dollar was spent.
• Estimate project costs: Build accurate budgets by breaking down projects into tasks and estimating time and expenses
• Track time your way: add start-end times, use stop-start timer or location-based tracking for more accurate time tracking. 
• Fast, accurate quoting & invoicing: with all your job information in one place, it’s easy to send accurate quotes and invoices from the field or the office and get paid faster with online payments.
• Get quotes accepted in a click: prospective customers can accept the quote with the click of a button
• Get paid faster: Customise and send invoices, then accept online payment to wrap up jobs and get paid faster. You have full control over what your customers see. 
• Turn quotes into invoices in two taps.
• Real time view of profitability: up-to-the-second dashboard views let you monitor and track performance - so you can maximise profitability of current jobs and enhance it on future projects.
ABOUT XERO
Xero is a beautiful, easy-to-use global online platform for small businesses and their professional advisors. It’s cloud-based accounting software that connects people with the numbers anytime, anywhere. And it gives you powerful practice tools to efficiently manage compliance and offer a broad range of advisory services.
We started Xero to change the game for small businesses. Xero is now one of the fastest growing Software as a Service companies globally. We lead the New Zealand, Australian, and United Kingdom cloud accounting markets, employing a world-class team of more than 2,500 people. Xero has 2 million subscribers in more than 180 countries and seamlessly integrates with over 800 apps.
Privacy policy: http://www.xero.com/about/legal/privacy

bluejetty:00074285:ios.description:
Welcome to NovelPack—the ultimate reading app for book lovers worldwide!
Book Genres
NovelPack offers a vast library of captivating stories across genres like romance, fantasy, mystery, sci-fi, and more. From steamy romances to thrilling adventures, our collection has something for everyone. Discover thousands of books, including exclusive titles from renowned authors.
Daily Updates
Stay hooked with daily updates on our bestsellers. Join in-app activities to unlock new chapters and enjoy bonus updates on weekends. Never miss a beat with NovelPack!
Personalized Experience
Customize your reading experience with adjustable font sizes, background colors, and screen brightness. Make NovelPack your perfect reading companion.These personalization options ensure that NovelPack adapts to your individual reading habits and preferences, making your experience as comfortable and enjoyable as possible. Whether you’re reading in bright sunlight or under a dim nightlight, NovelPack is designed to be your perfect reading companion.
Privacy & Safety
Your information is safe with us. We prioritize your privacy and ensure your data is protected. Rest easy knowing NovelPack is a secure reading space.
Ready to dive into endless stories? Download NovelPack now and start your reading adventure!
Subscription Agreement
1. Term: Weekly/Yearly subscription (auto-renewable subscription)
2. Price: $14.99/week, $129.99/year
3. Payment: The purchase fee will be deducted from your iTunes account.
4. Renewal: Apple iTunes account will automatically deduct the fee within 24 hours before the subscription expires, and the subscription will be extended for one cycle after the deduction is successful.
5. Cancellation: You can cancel the subscription at any time 24 hours before the subscription expires.
6. Manage Subscription: You can view and manage your renewal.
7. Privacy: https://www.ireader.mobi/novelpack/privacy.html
8. Terms of Service: https://www.ireader.mobi/novelpack/terms.html

bluejetty:00160654:ios.summary:
**Pass the NCLEX Without Developing New Symptoms of Test Anxiety**
You’ve survived care plans, clinical rotations, and professors who think NCLEX prep is your full-time job. Now there’s just one thing standing between you and your nursing
bluejetty:00160654:ios.description:
**Pass the NCLEX Without Developing New Symptoms of Test Anxiety**
You’ve survived care plans, clinical rotations, and professors who think NCLEX prep is your full-time job. Now there’s just one thing standing between you and your nursing license: the NCLEX.
EZ Prep’s NCLEX Study App is the fastest, smartest, and least mentally draining way to prep for both the NCLEX-RN and NCLEX-PN exams. Whether you’re reviewing during a lunch break, cramming from the breakroom, or stress-scrolling while pretending to relax in the bath, this app goes wherever you do and helps you actually feel prepared.
Built by licensed nurses who passed the real exam and still remember the trauma, our app includes both traditional questions and Next Gen NCLEX case-based formats. Yes, that means bowtie items, cloze questions, partial-credit scoring, and all the other fun new surprises that weren’t in your textbook.
We follow the 2026 NCSBN test plan and cover all eight Client Needs categories. You'll get a personalized learning path, instant feedback, and progress tracking, so you always know where you stand. And the questions actually get harder as you get better, just like the real exam.
**What you’ll cover inside:**
• Management of Care
• Safety and Infection Control
• Health Promotion and Maintenance
• Psychosocial Integrity
• Basic Care and Comfort
• Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies
• Reduction of Risk Potential
• Physiological Adaptation
Whether you’re prepping for RN or PN, the app adjusts to your exam type and your performance. You’ll study smarter, not just longer.
**What’s inside besides caffeine-fueled motivation:**
• Custom onboarding to set your goals, quiz intensity, and preferred level of pain
• Daily streaks and achievement badges to keep you semi-motivated
• Instant feedback with clear explanations, so you actually learn from your mistakes
• A timed exam simulator to get used to the pressure without the cold testing center lighting
• Performance stats that show exactly where you’re killing it and where you need to review
• Built-in Next Gen formats to practice case studies and multi-layered questions before they sneak up on you
**Try it free** with a limited version of the app so you can get a feel for it before you upgrade. When you’re ready, go premium and unlock full-length exams, bookmarks, and missed-question review.
**Pass Guarantee:** If you don’t pass, we’ll refund your money and keep your subscription active until you do. No catch. No fine print designed to trick you. Just an actual guarantee we stand behind.
EZ Prep is here to make sure you walk into the NCLEX with confidence, not blind hope and three half-read review books.
Terms of Use: https://www.eztestprep.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.eztestprep.com/privacy-policy
Contact us at: support@eztestprep.com
EZ Prep is not affiliated with the NCSBN or the NCLEX. We just help you pass their exam without crying in your car after every study session. For official exam info, visit www.nclex.com

bluejetty:00014239:ios.description:
Goodnotes has always been the place to capture your ideas — from quick notes to big plans. Now, it goes further. With powerful AI and new ways to capture information, Goodnotes helps you connect the dots, unlock insights, and turn ideas into action.
*Existing Goodnotes 5 users can continue to use Goodnotes 5 indefinitely or upgrade to the new Goodnotes. Either way, your notes are safe!* 
For professionals: Increase productivity at work
■ Whiteboard + Goodnotes AI: Brainstorm, mind-map, and diagram freely on an infinite canvas that grows with your ideas. Enhanced diagramming tools and real-time collaboration make it easy for teams to workshop & ideate together, while Goodnotes AI helps you capture and organize key takeaways instantly.
■ Goodnotes AI Audio & Meetings: Stay fully present in every conversation while Goodnotes does the work for you. AI-powered transcription and live summarization automatically capture discussions and turns them into clear meeting minutes. After the meeting, merge transcripts with your own handwritten or typed notes to create polished, shareable documents in seconds.
■ Text Documents + AI: Create documents that think with you. Enjoy a superior typing experience with rich inline blocks, build on ideas with external insights, and collaborate seamlessly with teammates. With AI-powered summarization, automated note generation, and transcript support, turn rough notes and meetings into finished content faster than ever.
■ Present your notes, slides, and content directly from Goodnotes when you connect your device via AirPlay or HDMI to an external screen.
■ Use Laser Pointer to guide your audience's attention during your presentation.
■ Export your handwritten and typed notes to email, print, or share them anywhere as PDFs.
■ Send a link to your notebooks to work on the same notes.
■ Import documents by emailing them to your custom Goodnotes email.
For students: Ace your exams with ease
■ Record audio notes that are magically synced to your iPhone or iPad exact moment you write: perfect for lectures, seminars, and presentations.
■ Take handwritten notes that stay fully searchable: instantly find any word across every class notebook, even mid-lecture.
■ Study and practice straight from your notes with study Sets: flashcards built on active recall and spaced repetition.
■ Use AI to summarize, shorten, change the tone of your words, and turn messy handwritten or typed student notes into polished, structured study material.
For planners and journalers: Let your creativity flow
■ Plan your week, month, or year on your iPhone/ iPad with built-in and importable planner templates, fully customizable to match how you plan.
■ Keep a daily journal alongside your planner. Combine handwriting, typed reflections, photos, and stickers on the same page.
■ Use Goodnotes AI to summarize a week's worth of journal entries on your iPhone or iPad into key themes and takeaways.
■ Customize the size and color of your paper templates to create the planner or journal you want.
■ Add, create, or import stickers, stamps, washi tapes, images, and more on your iPad.
Digital notebooks: unlimited notebooks for the price of a single physical one
■ Combine handwriting and typed text on one page, alongside images, stickers, diagrams, and doodles.
■ Create digital notebooks, planners, and journals with customizable paper templates, including Blank Paper, Ruled Paper, Cornell Paper, Checklists, Planners, and more.
■ Navigate long documents with ease. PDF tables of contents are automatically imported, or create custom outlines yourself.
■ Back up all your handwritten and typed notes to Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive, and use iCloud to sync across iPad, iPhone, and Mac — so your notes are always safe.
■ Edit your handwriting by resizing it, changing the text color, or moving it to another spot on the page.
Privacy Policy: https://www.goodnotes.com/privacy-policy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.goodnotes.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00167352:ios.description:
Discover the kawaii universe of the bouncing Biggies in a platform game that will take you to a fun-filled world where you will meet these adorable creatures.
In Biggies, you can complete a new level every day.
You and your friends will complete a new level every day and it will be the same for everyone.
Will you be able to complete it before everyone else?
Use two simple and easy to learn mechanics to reach the top:
With the slingshot, you'll control the direction in which your Biggie jumps and you'll be able to make him bounce off bouncers. You'll also get tickets every time you break one of the bouncers.
With the tap, you can make your Biggie plummet downwards. You can use this mechanic on some bouncers to bounce upwards and save jumps, but be careful! ...it can play tricks.
Biggies has two types of coins: tickets and BiggieCoins.
By making use of the tickets you get from breaking bouncers, you can activate the checkpoints in each section. 
If you don't do this and spend all your jumps, you will plummet downwards and have to start from scratch.
It's up to you whether you like to take a risk and climb to the top faster, or if you prefer to play it safe.
To earn BiggieCoins you have to enter the bonus rooms. These rooms contain small puzzles that give you rewards based on the number of bouncers you break in a single jump - the number of attempts is infinite!
FEATURES
A new level every day: Keep the excitement going and challenge your skills with an exclusive and exciting level available every day - the fun never stops in Biggies!
Collect all the Biggies: Use BiggieCoins (or real money) to unlock the most kawaii and adorable Biggies: Fantasy, Wild, Shinycorns...
Compete your way to the top: Satisfy your collecting spirit by collecting your daily trophy while challenging your friends in exciting competitions for the top ranking - show who's the best in the world of Biggies! 
Solve the puzzles: Solve the puzzles in the bonus rooms in exchange for exciting rewards.
WARNING
Biggies requires an internet connection to function properly.
Download Biggies now and join the fun!

bluejetty:00173174:ios.summary:
Start your own personal journey in the Hades Galaxy, or continue guiding the Empire you started in Hades' Star.
DARK NEBULA is the next evolution of the Hades galaxy. With familiar but well-refined activities, as well as brand new activiti
bluejetty:00173174:ios.description:
Start your own personal journey in the Hades Galaxy, or continue guiding the Empire you started in Hades' Star.
DARK NEBULA is the next evolution of the Hades galaxy. With familiar but well-refined activities, as well as brand new activities, building a Space Empire has never been more rewarding.
Create and grow your space Empire, in a persistent galaxy that constantly evolves.
EXPLORE AND COLONIZE YOUR VERY OWN YELLOW STAR SYSTEM
As the most stable star type, the Yellow Star offers a perfect setting to establish your permanent presence and plan your Empire's long term economy. All new players start in their own Yellow Star system and over time expand to discover and colonize more planets, set mining patterns, establish trade routes and neutralize the mysterious alien ships found throughout the Hades galaxy.
As the owner of a Yellow Star system, you have complete control over what other players have access to it. By establishing diplomatic relations, you can allow any other player to send ships to your system, and dictate your own terms for mining, trade or military cooperation.
COOPERATIVE PVE IN RED STARS
Very early in the game, every player will build a Red Star Scanner, a station that allows them to jump ships to detected Red Stars. These stars have a small lifetime and will go supernova after 10 minutes.
The goal in the Red Star is to co-operate with any other players that have ships in that star system, defeat the NPC ships, retrieve Artifacts from the Red Star planets, and jump back before the Supernova. Artifacts can be researched in the home star and will yield necessary resources for trade, mining and combat advancements. Higher level Red Stars offer more challenging enemies and better rewards.
TEAM PVP IN WHITE STARS
Players can organize in Corporations. Besides helping each other, Corporations can also scan for White Stars. A White Star sees 20 players from two Corporations battle in the same star system for Relics, a resource that can be retrieved to upgrade the Corporation and give each member additional benefits.
Time passes by very slowly in White Stars: every match lasts for 5 days, giving Corporation members time to talk and coordinate their strategy. The Time Machine can be used to plan future moves, communicate them to other Corporation members, and see potential outcomes of future combat.
EXCITING PVP IN BLUE STARS
Blue Stars are short lived combat arenas that only last for a few minutes, during which the entire system is collapsing on itself. Each player can only send a single Battleship to the Blue Star. The 5 participating players combat each other, using their ship's modules and other NPC ships to destroy the other player Battleships and be the last one alive.
Blue Stars offer the fastest PvP action in the game. Regular participants receive daily and monthly rewards to advance their Empire.

bluejetty:00035043:ios.description:
Perfect your graphic design, logo, and template projects — everything you need to create stunning visuals is in one place. VistaCreate (ex Crello) is a free graphic design platform with thousands of templates, logo makers, and editing features to help you customize your projects. Remove backgrounds, access a huge library of fonts, illustrations, stickers, and effortlessly create professional designs for free.
Our app offers all the tools you need for graphic design, whether you’re creating a logo, social media post, or business template. With VistaCreate (ex Crello), you can bring your creative ideas to life in minutes. Utilize intuitive design tools and pre-built templates to enhance your brand with impactful visuals — ideal for any graphic design, logo, or template endeavor.
VISTACREATE FEATURES:
- 200,000+ professionally designed templates
- 80+ digital and print design formats
- 85,000+ stickers, shapes, illustrations
- 15,000+ animated templates
- 1M+ free premium images
- 760+ free fonts for your text
- 17,000+ animations for any creative idea
DESIGN FORMATS FOR ANY BUSINESS NEED
 Create anything from a printed flyer to a custom logo or digital graphic design project in VistaCreate. Choose from more than 20 design formats in the app. Pick the right template, easily customize it, and impress audiences with your studio-level designs.
FREE AND EASY-TO-USE EDITING FEATURES
 Remove any image background with a single click. Easily resize, crop, or customize your images with thousands of design objects. Whether you’re creating a graphic design, logo, or template, the opportunities are limitless — plus, the app is totally free to download and use.
USE READY-MADE TEMPLATES
 Explore thousands of professionally-made templates for any occasion in VistaCreate. Choose any pre-made design and easily customize it to fit your style. Change the background, upload your own image, play with fonts, and create custom visuals for your needs without a designer.Designed to support all your graphic design, logo, and template tasks.
ACCESS A HUGE LIBRARY OF OBJECTS
 Check out a vast collection of design objects in VistaCreate. Enhance your designs with thousands of free stickers, illustrations, icons, and more. Plus, browse hundreds of fonts to pick the perfect text style for your graphic design, logo, or template.
RESIZE OR CROP YOUR IMAGE
 Crop your pictures, leaving in the most important parts of your design. With VistaCreate, it’s easy to resize your designs — switch between formats in a click and upload it to different platforms: social media, email newsletters, blog posts, and more. It’s perfect for adapting any graphic design, logo, or template for various channels.
ADD SOUND TO YOUR VISUALS
 Explore our collection of licensed tracks and add the right music to your image or video. You can also upload your own music for a personal touch. Find the perfect soundtrack for any mood and elevate your graphic design, logo, or template projects.
DOWNLOAD AND SHARE
 Download your designs in one click, or share them directly to Instagram, Facebook, or other platforms right from the app. Save your projects in PNG or JPG and maintain high-quality visuals with our graphic design tools, whether working on a logo, template, or other creative content.
CREATE TOP VIDEO CONTENT
 Enhance your feed with unique video content! Explore our library of animations and videos to choose the best one for your creative idea. Tap to add a video, and it will immediately be part of your design, ideal for any graphic design, logo, or template work.
We’re constantly adding new templates, logos, and premium media to help you create standout visuals for your business. Stay trendy with VistaCreate — your all-in-one solution for graphic design, logo, template creation and so much more!

bluejetty:00019162:ios.description:
Fly high in Jetpack Jump to reach new places waiting to be discovered!
Tap to Jump on the mark and soar into the sky, make sure you use all your jetpack fuel to go the distance.
Upgrade your jetpack and your running speed to be able to travel further than before and beat your high score.
The further you travel the more money you get!
How far will you get?
Jetpack Jump features:
- Simple and addictive gameplay that will have you flying like an eagle
- Numerous upgrades to keep you travelling
- Colourful design and areas to discover
- Offline earnings to keep you going
SUBSCRIBE TO JETPACK JUMP
Subscribe to Jetpack Jump for all of the following benefits:
* Booster Pet
* Exclusive Hat
* No Ads, which removes non-optional adverts from the game
* Gold Jetpack
* Double Coins
SUBSCRIPTIONS INFORMATION:
Jetpack Jump VIP Membership access offers two membership options:
1) A weekly subscription costing $5.49 per week after a 3 day FREE trial period.
2) A monthly subscription costing $14.49 per month.
After buying this subscription, you will unlock; a booster pet which will give you an extra boost, an exclusive hat to wear in game, a gold jetpack to use in the game, double your coins after ever jump, and no ads, which removes non-optional ads from the game. This is an auto-renewable subscription. The payment is charged to your account after confirmation. The subscription is renewed unless you unsubscribe 24 hours before the period ends. Your account will also be charged for renewal.
The prices notes are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may change and actual charges may be converted to local currency.
End of trial and subscription renewal:
- The payment is charged to your iTunes account after a confirmation of purchase
- The subscription is renewed unless you unsubscribe 24 hours before the end of the current period
- The account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period at the standard cost of the weekly subscription
- The user may manage the subscription and auto-renewal by accessing the user's account settings after purchase in the store
- No cancellation of the current subscription is permitted during the active subscription period
- Any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited when the subscription is purchased
Cancelling a trial or subscription:
- In order to cancel a subscription during the free trial period you need to cancel it through your account in the Store. This must be done at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period to avoid being charged.

bluejetty:00156838:ios.description:
CorpsClash makes it easy to follow competitive marching arts throughout the season, with support for Drum Corps International (DCI), Bands of America (BOA), and Winter Guard International (WGI).
Browse events, schedules, scores, rankings, recaps, and historical results all in one place. Follow your favorite corps, bands, and ensembles, track how scores change throughout the season, and get real-time updates as new results are released.
CorpsClash includes:
• DCI, BOA, and WGI events and scores
• Live score updates during events
• Detailed score recaps and caption results
• Season rankings and score trends
• Favoriting ensembles for quicker access throughout the app
• Event insights and season statistics
• Home screen widgets, notifications, and calendar integration
Whether you're following a full summer of drum corps, keeping up with BOA competitions in the fall, or tracking WGI through the winter and spring, CorpsClash puts the season in one place.
CorpsClash is an independent app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by DCI, BOA, or WGI.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
CorpsClash offers a Season Pass subscription with additional features for $2.99/year. Prices shown are for US customers and may vary in other countries.
Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase. Your CorpsClash Season Pass automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
You can manage or cancel your subscription from your Apple account settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00187759:ios.description:
The new way to manage your expenses with FlexiPurchase
All the FlexiPurchase functions you’re used to are now at your fingertips – making it easy to manage your expenses on the go, as they come up. The new FlexiPurchase App lets you view, code and approve expenses, all on your iPhone or iPad.
Taking care of business
Expenses don’t just come up when you’re at work on your computer, they happen when you’re out and about. And with the FlexiPurchase App, you can take care of cash and card expenses the same way. Using mobile and cloud technology on your device, the App lets you:
* Capture expense data.
* Take photos of your receipts. Powerful Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology then extracts the key data, and links your receipts with your expenses.
* Keep track of your receipts in the image library.
* View your card purchases, as well as any policy or approval rules associated with your expenses – all on the same screen.
* Code, submit and approve expenses.
The App’s backed by a banking-grade security system too, so you can manage everything with confidence.
Already have FlexiPurchase?
Just download the App onto your device, and create your mobile PIN.
Then you’re good to go.

bluejetty:00024649:ios.name: KNKX Public Radio
bluejetty:00024649:ios.summary:
Stay connected across Puget Sound with the KNKX Public Radio App — your trusted source for NPR, local news, jazz and blues in Western Washington.
With KNKX, you can stream our live radio signal, 88.5 FM, broadcasted from our Seattle and Ta
bluejetty:00024649:ios.description:
Stay connected across Puget Sound with the KNKX Public Radio App — your trusted source for NPR, local news, jazz and blues in Western Washington.
With KNKX, you can stream our live radio signal, 88.5 FM, broadcasted from our Seattle and Tacoma studios anytime and anywhere life takes you. Whether you’re looking for in-depth local reporting, national news, or the very best jazz and blues music, our app gives you access to the best KNKX Public Radio has to offer in the palm of your hand.
Features:
 • Listen to live radio — Listen to KNKX live! Tune in for music, news and NPR programming anytime, no antenna required.
 • Northwest Regional News – Listen and read the latest locally produced stories and interviews from our award-winning newsroom.
 • Music Streaming — Enjoy the best in classic and contemporary jazz and blues music from KNKX’s experienced music hosts.
 • NPR News & Shows — Listen to your favorite NPR programs such as Morning Edition, Fresh Air, Jazz Night In America, Wait Wait…Don’t Tell Me! and more. 
 • On-Demand Music — Access your favorite KNKX music shows after they air, All Blues, The New Cool, Tree of Jazz, The Grooveyard and more!
 • Schedules & Playlists — Find information on your favorite shows with our program schedule and what songs have played on the air using our built-in playlist feature.
 • KNKX Studio Sessions — Watch and listen to today’s best jazz and blues artists perform in our Seattle studios and at popular Pacific Northwest venues.
 • Events — Connect with us at KNKX events and discover things to do with the community calendar.
 • Podcasts — Listen to current and past podcasts from KNKX including Studio Session Shorts, The Walk Home and Outsiders. 
 • Alarm & Sleep Timer — Wake up or fall asleep to your favorite KNKX programming.
KNKX Public Radio is a listener-supported service and member of the NPR Network. 
Please support KNKX by becoming a member today!
https://www.knkx.org

bluejetty:00155414:ios.description:
MyStart Plus™
------- HARDWARE PURCHASE REQUIRED FOR USAGE -------
MyStart Plus™ is the fastest, easiest, most versatile and complete telematics system utilizing a smartphone solution to stay connected with your vehicle from anywhere in the world. Using the MyStart Plus™ app, you can control your vehicle doors (Lock/Unlock), remote start or Stop your engine and even find your current vehicle’s location.
PROFESSIONNAL INSTALLATION REQUIRED
In order to use MyStart Plus™ on your vehicle, a MyStart Plus™ device and compatible remote starter must be installed onto your vehicle. To find an authorized MyStart Plus™ retailer, visit https://mystartplus.com/find-a-dealer.html
INTERNET CONNECTION REQUIRED
In order to use the MyStart Plus™ App, it will require a connection to the internet via cellular or WiFi.
OPERATING NETWORK
900 MHz wireless network. The system is being operated using the Otodata Wireless Network, which currently covers a a vast territory in Quebec and Ontario. You will be surprised by how fast the system works compared to traditional remote key fob or cellular based car starters.
KEY FEATURES
• Remote start engine
• Remote shutdown engine
• Keyless entry access
• Trunk release
• Open/Close motorized liftgate (if equipped)
• Factory or Aftermarket Security system Arming/Disarming
• Up to 4 Customizable auxiliary functions
• GPS position*
• Push notifications for remote starter trouble codes
• Push notifications for security alerts
• Low battery condition alerts
• Current vehicle status, Battery level
• Vehicle image selection
• PIN Code feature to prevent unauthorized access to the application control screen
• Multiple vehicles and users.
• 900 MHz wireless network. The system is being operated using the Otodata Wireless Network, which currently covers a a vast territory in Quebec and Ontario. 
*GPS5040 Unit is required for GPS location.
REMOTE STARTER COMPATIBILITY
MyStart Plus™ is currently compatible with the following brands of remote starter and/or security systems:
ADS
• iDatastart HCx
• iDatastart BMx
• iDatastart BZx
• iDatastart VWx
• ADS-AL-CA
• AKX / OEM
ASTROSTART
• AF-D600 (adapter required)
AUTOSTART
• ASD200
• ASD600
COMPUSTAR
• CM-7XXX
• CM-6XXX
• CM-900
• FT-xxx-DC
• FT-DC2
• FT-DC3
DIRECTED
• DBALL 2
• DB3
• 4X10
• 5X10
• DS4+
FORTIN
• Evo-All
• Evo-One
POLARSTART
• PRS-13
• PRS-16
STANDALONE MODE
• A GPS-5040 unit can be used as a standalone device only to get GPS locate functions.
For more details on which product is compatible with MyStart Plus™, visit https://mystartplus.com/find-a-dealer.html
APP OWNER’S GUIDE
Please consult the "Help section" inside our App for a detailed Owners Guide.
SUPPORT URL
https://mystartplus.com/support/

bluejetty:00156523:ios.description:
The highly anticipated sequel to ElectroMaster has arrived!
CRITICS:
"A truly original game built around an authentically fresh mechanic." -AppAdvice.com
Delica and her talking cat Saten are hungry! Lucky for them they know how to turn the monsters that infest the nearby forest into fruit. Your goal is to survive long enough to collect enough fruit to feed yourself and the locals.
The controls are simple: hold your finger on the screen and Delica moves towards it. To turn monsters into fruit start a swipe on her and drag across any nearby monsters. This pixie dust trail you create will freeze any monsters you select, and upon your release will turn them all into fruit! If you ever get into danger you're only a two finger tap away from summoning a spell to clear the screen (It'll cost you though). When you've collected enough to satisfy a home's quota drop by a nearby house, it's that easy.
With over 100 missions in the story mode and a Time Attack mode in which to hone your skills, you won't be able to put it down.
*Features Game Center support including Achievements and Leader boards.*
Unlock achievements and get hidden items!
Character Design, Illustration: Hanikura
Character Voice: Yukako

bluejetty:00132007:ios.name: Sputnik!
bluejetty:00132007:ios.summary:
Sputnik! is an easy to use tool for predicting when the International Space Station will pass by your location or when a bright satellite will be visible in the skies above.
Sputnik! features:
- Predictions of satellite and ISS sightings
bluejetty:00132007:ios.description:
Sputnik! is an easy to use tool for predicting when the International Space Station will pass by your location or when a bright satellite will be visible in the skies above.
Sputnik! features:
- Predictions of satellite and ISS sightings accurate to the second.
- Detection of Starlink satellite trains.
- Second by second countdown to the satellite sighting.
- Set reminders of upcoming satellite sightings.
- Displays compass direction and elevation for your device to easily find the part of the sky where the sighting will occur (requires capable device).
- Rotate your device to landscape orientation to show exactly where the satellite will pass in the night sky.
- Share sightings via Twitter, Facebook, Mail, Messages and others.
- Automatic download of up to date satellite orbital data.
- Offline calculations, no need to be connected to the internet once orbital data has been downloaded.
- Input your location automatically by GPS, select from a map or enter coordinates manually.
- Save your favorite places for easy access.
- Audio cues for the last seconds before the satellite passes by.
Sputnik! on Apple Watch:
- Easily find the next and last sighting at your current location.
* Sputnik! is ad-supported *

bluejetty:00068399:ios.description:
Leo's Road Adventures is a continuation of our famous learning games for toddlers with cars. Favorite characters, bright design and developmental elements are waiting for your child.
The colorful and fun game develops the child's hearing, attention, spatial thinking and fine motor skills. There are 14 different cars and 6 dynamic tracks in our toddler games for 2 5 year olds!
Our toddler games consist of sequential steps. The kid drives cars - they drive along the tracks, divided into three lanes, and collect parts of objects (other cars, objects) and other resources. Your kid will gain new skills and a lot of positive emotions with the help of these car games for kids, because it is impossible to make a mistake or lose!
Kids car games with Leo - an interesting search for details, they can be repainted or reassembled. With the help of our game the child will learn the names of colors, shapes and car parts - each of them is voiced!
Educational games for toddlers from 2 years old with Leo are great for fans of the cartoon, allowing you to control familiar characters. The simple controls, voice acting and animation of your favorite characters and cars will help you to fully immerse yourself in adventure games for kids.
Features of our car game for kids:
- the game was created for children from 2 to 5 years old
- 14 colorful cars and 6 different tracks!
- the child will learn a lot about cars
- original content, voice acting, funny and kind animation, change of time of year and day
- control is switched by buttons or swipes
- lack of text, except for the functionality for parents
- our learning game for toddlers is safe! Settings and purchases are closed by parental controls.
Playing kids car games, your child travels through different play areas, collects details & pieces of puzzles with heroes.
Car games for kids with Leo have many favorite characters: Leo the Truck itself, Loader, Kapu excavator, a Robot on a moped, Leia and other cars from the cartoon. Ride more often, unlock new parts and collect the next characters or building!
Immerse yourself in the world of Leo the Truck and have fun in road adventure games for kids, move along one of 6 bright tracks and learn new things in these toddler games for 3 4 year olds! A summer, autumn and winter road, a beach and the sea, a country road along the river and an autumn rainy road are waiting for your baby. A bonus for your little one is a helicopter flight over the water!
Track.
The player drives along the track, avoids obstacles and collects resources. Obstacles can be trees, stones, etc. Some of these obstacles can cover all three lanes - you need to drive onto the springboard for an automatic jump.
Car constructor.
Assemble a car from the parts you will catch in these educational game for toddlers. When paint the car if you have enough paint. Btw, colors of paints are voiced.
Puzzles.
Beautiful pictures with large images of characters and other objects from the cartoon. Assembling the puzzle is easy - drag and drop the pieces to the desired place in the picture.
Our kids car games are made with love and attention!

Smash fingers with your friends — together on a single phone or tablet!

bluejetty:00063369:ios.description:
Smash fingers with your friends — together on a single phone or tablet!
No second device. No Wi‑Fi. No setup. Just grab your kid, your partner, a classmate, or any unsuspecting bystander and challenge them to a quick, hilarious duel. Finger Fights packs 20 fast mini‑games into one app — soccer, robot battles, racing, puzzles, music and more — with head‑to‑head games for two players and solo games for when you're on your own. Easy to learn, impossible to put down, and fun for every age.
So what are you waiting for? Pick a game, share the screen, and let the finger‑fighting begin!
TWO PLAYERS, ONE SCREEN
• Robots Duel — shoot, take cover, and demolish your opponent in this fast FPS‑style showdown. Now with 3 robots to choose from — Lucky, Tank, and Speedy!
• Finger Soccer — a dead‑simple, wildly fun game of scoring goals. Defend your net and finger‑brawl your way to victory!
• Edge Runner — race a friend along the Himalayan edge and hang on: leap the bottomless chasms, keep your nerve, and whoever drops first loses. (Also playable solo!)
• Chicken Love — race a friend to reach the waiting chicken first, dodging a conveyor full of traps along the way. (Also playable solo!)
• Bouncy Tunes — do you love friendship? Do you love music? If you said yes to both, you'll love Bouncy Tunes!
• Tower Charge — a fast, tactical duel: topple your opponent's tower while defending your own from exploding troops and bolts.
A NEW 2‑PLAYER GAME EVERY DAY
• Spider Bounty — a turn‑based coin grab where you outwit your opponent to collect the most coins while blocking them from doing the same. Like Tic‑Tac‑Toe crossed with checkers, but better.
• Toy Race — a thrilling checkpoint race. Test your reflexes, collect stars, and earn the golden cup!
• Castle Crush — a pure reaction duel: pelt your opponent's sandcastle with water balloons and grab shovels to patch up your own. Watch for the big balloons — they go off with a bang after three seconds!
• Jewel Rush — a fresh twist on match‑3 where you race to scoop up more gems than your rival.
• Moon Spell — a calm game for two: draw magical gestures before time runs out, read your partner, lead when needed, give way when required, and become true wizards together.
NO PARTNER RIGHT NOW? PLAY SOLO

bluejetty:00168296:ios.description:
Are you a fan of supermarket shopping and keeping goods organized? If so, you're in for a treat with the triple matching game ! Dive into the world of puzzle games where you can sort all kinds of stuff, all in captivating 3D cupboards. Unlock more of your favorite products as you master the art of triple matching, and elevate your gaming experience like never before! Welcome to the thrilling realm of sorting challenges with Match Triple: Sort Goods Master! Are you a fan of interesting casual sorting games? If so, step into our world of Goods Sorting!
In this captivating adventure of organizing and matching, Match Triple: Sort Goods Master invites you to immerse yourself in the art of triple-matching and sorting delights. Delve into the intricacies of sort as you combine products in triple matches, experiencing the joy of organizing cabinets and items in 3D.
 How to play Match Triple: Sort Goods Master
1. Embark on your journey through the world of casual organizing games, where controlling the sorting process is a breeze. Match triple goods by aligning identical 3D items on expansive shelves, completing triple matches!
2. Instead of worrying about space limitations, enjoy the freedom of combining products in random cabinets, making the most of the organizing games' mechanics.
3. Uncover hidden treasures in Goods Triple 3D and become a master of match triple goods! Revel in the satisfaction of tidying up products through triple-matching.
Features of Match Triple: Sort Goods Master
Explore hundreds of meticulously crafted triple-matching levels, offering a delightful challenge in the world of sorting games.
Experience simplicity intertwined with truly challenging levels, where completing triple-tile puzzles demands concentration, quick thinking, and strategic planning.
Utilize cunning tactics to overcome intricate puzzles with handy power-ups and elements in 3D triple-matching sort.
Discover the flexibility of matching triple goods, allowing you to develop your unique sorting style in organizing games.
Enjoy the pure pleasure of offline match triple goods, indulging in endless sort anytime, anywhere.
Stay engaged with seasonal events and occasional updates, as Goods Triple holds surprises beyond mere product matching.
If you're a fan of goods sorting and organizing games, dive into the world of Goods Triple. Take on Closet Sort challenges, solve puzzles, and bask in the relaxing ambiance of sorting games. Immerse yourself in the joy of sort and discover the thrill of sorting games!
Prepare to test your intellect with our IQ challenge! Engage in our thrilling triple matching puzzle game, where you'll navigate through a variety of goods to emerge victorious. Are you ready to take on the challenge of Goods Sorting?
Get in Touch
Questions about Match Triple: Sort Goods Master? Don't hesitate to reach out! We're dedicated to enhancing this free goods sorting game for maximum enjoyment and addiction.
Download Match Triple: Sort Goods Master and embark on a laid-back 3D triple sorting puzzle adventure together! Enjoy Goods Sorting! Be the Master of sorting 3D goods!

bluejetty:00063750:ios.description:
Music Instant Rhythm
Your complete music world, simple, powerful, and personal.
Music Instant Rhythm is built for people who want their entire music collection in one place. Whether your tracks are stored locally or synced from iTunes, the app gives you full control to organize, play, and enjoy them with a smooth and modern design.
No clutter, no confusion, just fast access to your music with the tools you need to keep everything organized.
Core Features
1. Local Music Manager
Browse and manage all audio files stored on your device. The app reads metadata, shows proper titles and artwork, lets you rename tracks, and offers full offline playback.
2. iTunes Music Library
Access the songs synced through iTunes. Your synced and local music appear together so you can browse and play everything in one place.
3. Favorites
Save your top tracks for quick access. Favorites load instantly and work offline.
4. Playlists
Create and customize playlists from both local and iTunes songs. The playlist system is rebuilt for version 6.0 for faster and more reliable updates.
5. Smart Search and Categorization
Your music is automatically organized for easier browsing. Search and sorting are cleaner, faster, and more accurate.
6. Music Player
A clean and responsive player with full controls. View track info, artwork, and progress with smooth animations.
7. Audio Visualizer Engine
Watch your music come to life with rhythm based animations. Choose different visualizer styles for a dynamic experience.
8. Visualizer Video Export
Create visual videos directly from your songs and share them anywhere.
9. Audio Extraction from Video
Extract sound from any supported video file and save it into your music library.
10. MP3 and Audio File Converter
Convert audio files into 11 different formats inside the app. This gives you full control over your files and lets you create the format you need.
11. Multi File Import
Import multiple songs or videos at once from Files, AirDrop, or other apps for faster library setup.
12. Web Browser and Download Manager
Find and download media directly from the web. The browser detects downloadable files automatically and lets you manage them with progress tracking and resume support.
13. Video Manager and Player
Organize and watch downloaded videos with smooth playback and full screen mode.
14. Music Listening Statistics
See your most played songs, favorite artists, and total listening time.
15. Music News Feed
Stay updated with curated stories and trends from the music world.
16. Games Hub
Enjoy small music inspired games while listening.
17. Podcasts 
You can now enjoy a full podcast experience directly inside the app, built to be fast, simple, and powerful.
Why Music Instant Rhythm
The app is built for listeners who value simplicity and control. Every feature is designed to make managing and enjoying your music smooth, private, and enjoyable. No ads. No distractions. Just your music the way you want it.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

BetsWall is the world’s first and most successful football, basketball, and tennis betting assistant with over 84% win rate, powered by artificial intelligence.
Get daily betting tips from our AI engine before matches start. No need to risk your money to learn – all predictions are 100% free.

• Daily football, basketball, and tennis betting tips 
• Advanced AI prediction engine 
• Home / Draw / Away tips • Over / Under (1.5 to 6.5) tips

• Simple and easy-to-use interface
Virtual Betting System:
• 1000 bwCoins at signup

• Practice strategies without financial risk

bluejetty:00026607:ios.description:
Welcome to APPatient™, the end-to-end patient engagement app created for Modernizing Medicine® patients and providers.
APPatient™ is a mobile, fully-functional patient engagement app that can help both patients and providers save time. Patients can access telehealth and information, and push notifications can keep them up to date on primary medical concerns. Practices with Premium Patient Connect can take advantage of 24-hour online check-in, expediting intake paperwork. It can also help providers treat patients on the go.
APPatient Patient Benefits:
- Chat allows you to communicate with your healthcare team.
- Request prescription refills from your phone.
- Access your medical records on the go.
APPatient Provider Benefits:
- Allows patients to access their healthcare records directly.
- Communicate with patients.
- Access patient information stored in EMA® from your phone.
- Lab and test results can be accessed by patients.
- Use your existing Patient Portal username and password to log in. 
For log in assistance, please contact your physician’s office.

bluejetty:00188193:ios.description:
This app is part of the new Responsive Design interface of Tecnavia's Bluebird interface. 
This app improves the reading experience on any iOS device. It is more enhanced than viewing with the Safari Browser.
Readers can quickly navigate the entire publication using iOS multi-gestures. Swipe to browse pages or sections or tap a live headline or page number to reach your favorite article. A thumbnail view lets you scan all the pages at once. To read a story, just tap to zoom the page image, or tap to article mode and read the whole story, including jumps, in the text window at the font size you prefer. The e-Edition will also let you easily find topics using the section and story index, or find any ad or story via a full text search of words contained in the copy.
Just open the app to get the latest edition for on-line or off-line reading. You can also access back issues that you might have missed.To use, just download the app and select your publication.

bluejetty:00090237:ios.description:
GlucoPal brings your GLP-1 medication, meals, weight, and progress together. Log your shots or pills, track daily nutrition, and see your weight trends alongside dose changes.
From your first dose to your latest milestone, keep a clear record of your weight-loss journey. No account required.
TRACK YOUR JOURNEY WITH GLUCOPAL
• Shots and pills: log doses, keep your treatment history, and set reminders.
• Injection sites: track site rotation with a body-map history.
• Weight: see weekly averages, progress charts, and dose changes together.
• Meals: use photo estimates, barcode scanning, or food search to log nutrition.
• Nutrition: track calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, and water.
• Side effects: record symptoms alongside your dose history.
• Progress photos: browse your timeline and compare photos side by side.
• Apple Health: sync steps, activity, weight, water, and meals.
• GlucoPal Pro: explore estimated medication-level forecasts and create personal PDF reports for appointments.
WHAT'S THE BEST GLP-1 TRACKER?
Choose GlucoPal to keep your GLP-1 journey in one place. Medication tracking, meal logging, weight trends, side effects, and progress photos give you a fuller view of your progress over time.
See our GLP-1 tracker comparison:
https://glucopal.com/blog/glp-1-tracker-app
WHAT'S THE BEST ZEPBOUND TRACKER?
GlucoPal brings your Zepbound doses, injection-site history, weight trends, and side effects together. Dose reminders and daily meal, protein, and water tracking help you stay organized between shots.
See our Zepbound tracker comparison:
https://glucopal.com/blog/best-zepbound-tracker-apps
WHAT'S THE BEST WEGOVY TRACKER?
GlucoPal supports both weekly Wegovy injections and daily Wegovy pills. Track your doses and reminders alongside meals, weight, symptoms, and progress photos throughout your journey.
See our Wegovy tracker comparison:
https://glucopal.com/blog/best-wegovy-tracker-apps
WHAT'S THE BEST MOUNJARO TRACKER?
GlucoPal connects your Mounjaro dose history with weight trends, injection sites, side effects, and daily nutrition. Review your progress over time and share your treatment and progress history with your provider using GlucoPal Pro PDF reports.
See our Mounjaro tracker comparison:
https://glucopal.com/blog/best-mounjaro-tracker-apps
WHICH MEDICATIONS CAN I TRACK?
GlucoPal supports Zepbound, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Ozempic, Saxenda, Victoza, and Trulicity injections, plus daily pills including Wegovy pill, Rybelsus, and Foundayo. You can also log compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide with custom doses and schedules.
IS GLUCOPAL FREE?
GlucoPal is free to download and use. An optional GlucoPal Pro subscription unlocks advanced features, including medication-level forecasts and personal PDF reports. Current subscription options are shown in the app.
DO I NEED AN ACCOUNT?
No account is required. GlucoPal supports private iCloud backup and sync, and your health information is never sold. You control your health data.
Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Czech, and Portuguese.
Learn more: https://glucopal.com
Support: hello@glucopal.com
Privacy: https://glucopal.com/privacy
Terms: https://glucopal.com/terms

This app includes a built-in timer
bluejetty:00090721:ios.description:
MyMinistry is the ideal app for thoses who want to track their ministry time with ease and accuracy. With this app, you can easily keep track of your studies, publications, videos, and set new time goals.
This app includes a built-in timer function that allows you to start and stop your timer as needed. You can use this feature to accurately record your ministry time, even if you are conversing or conducting a study. Additionally, with the ability to set new time goals, you can stay motivated to reach your targets and maximize your ministry time.
One of the best features of MyMinistry is its support for multiple languages. This app is available in six different languages: French, English, Portuguese, Romanian, Polish, and German. This means you can use MyMinistry wherever you are in the world, regardless of your language preferences. You can also easily switch between languages in the app, making it even more convenient to use.
Finally, MyMinistry syncs your data across all your devices with iCloud. This means you can access your ministry records and progress from any device you use, whether it's your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. This feature makes managing your ministry time easier, wherever you are and on any device you use.
In summary, MyMinistry is a very useful app for thoses who want to track the time they spend in preaching. With its easy-to-use interface, built-in timer, language support, and data synchronization capability, download MyMinistry today!
App features:
* Various services available
* Student management
* Current month stats
* Theocratic year stats
* Stats compared to personal goal
* Ability to set a personal goal
* Ability to add a comment or remark on a recorded preaching activity (e.g., a preaching event)
* App available in French, English, German, Portuguese, Polish, Romanian, Hungarian, Russian, Japanese, and Korean (If you wish to translate the app into another language, feel free to contact me through the app)
* Dark mode available
* Widgets available!

bluejetty:00031310:ios.name: Live Santa Tracker
bluejetty:00031310:ios.summary:
Track Santa Claus Live, Enjoy a Christmas Countdown, and Message Santa all in one magical, festive app. It's the perfect way to stay connected to Santa throughout the holiday season.
TRACK SANTRA LIVE: 
Watch Santa travel the world on an i
bluejetty:00031310:ios.description:
Track Santa Claus Live, Enjoy a Christmas Countdown, and Message Santa all in one magical, festive app. It's the perfect way to stay connected to Santa throughout the holiday season.
TRACK SANTRA LIVE: 
Watch Santa travel the world on an interactive map, see his current stop, recent visits, and even his next destination! Toggle different layers on the map to see presents and Santa's previous stops.
MESSAGE SANTA:
Experience the magic of Christmas by chatting 1-on-1 with Santa Claus himself. Get unique, custom responses from Santa in real time, tailored just for you. No limits! Send as many messages as you want to Santa, he’s always ready to chat with you.
NAUGHTY OR NICE QUIZ
Take a fun quiz to see if you’ve made it onto Santa’s Naughty or Nice list this year. Take a fun and reflective quiz designed to show your holiday spirit and kindness level. Watch as your answers are sent straight to Santa and his elves for official review. Download and share an authentic certificate from The North Pole, signed by Santa!
GIFT TRACKING: 
Get delivery-style updates with estimated times for Santa’s arrival at your home. Get an estimate of when Santa will arrive at your house, perfect for the countdown excitement! Follow your gifts as they move through each stage: built, wrapped, and loaded into Santa’s sleigh! Count down the hours until Santa’s magical takeoff from the North Pole.
CHRISTMAS COUNTDOWN: 
Count down to Christmas in festive ways! Countdown in traditional units such as day, hours and minutes. Go crazy and countdown by how many snowflakes are left to fall or songs left to sing!
DAILY BLOGS FROM NORTH POLE:
Read daily updates from Santa, Dasher the Reindeer, and Alabaster Snowball the Elf. Get exclusive details about what happens throughout the year at the North Pole.
SANTAS STATS: 
Check Santa’s speed, altitude, cookies eaten, and even how many chimneys he’s gotten stuck in! Track Santa’s exact speed, altitude, and real-time location as he crosses continents. See all the fun details like cookies eaten, chimneys he’s tackled, and presents delivered! This feature truly comes to life when Santa’s in the air, bringing joy to homes worldwide!
MINI GAMES:
Delve into a world of festive fun with Christmas themed mini games!
Download Live Santa Tracker now to keep the festive spirit alive and enjoy the countdown to Christmas like never before! Note that whilst the app does offer In App Purchases, it is possible to use all the features for FREE by watching an ad and accessing a free demo of the feature.

bluejetty:00077406:ios.summary: Looking for a feature-packed and efficient media player to manage, organize, and play different types of video content? Enter VidHub! As the newest and most popular media player, VidHub serves up more than just the ability to play all types
bluejetty:00077406:ios.description:
Looking for a feature-packed and efficient media player to manage, organize, and play different types of video content? Enter VidHub! As the newest and most popular media player, VidHub serves up more than just the ability to play all types of video formats. With extensive media library management, VidHub promises stable and speedy video playback for an exceptional user experience.
Some of the key features that VidHub offers include:
- Support iOS, Mac, Apple TV platform, data synchronization through iCloud
- Support for a comprehensive range of video formats, including .mkv、.avi、.mp4、.mov、.rmvb、.wmv, and more
- High-quality video playback for HD, 4K, HDR, and various other resolutions
- The ability to enable and disable subtitles, with support for embedded and external subtitle formats such as SRT, SSA, and SUB
- Access your personal media libraries through SMB/CIFS and WebDAV, or connect your authorized accounts from supported cloud storage services, including Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Baidu Netdisk, Aliyun Drive, China Mobile Cloud Drive, and 115.
- Support renaming cloud files, support add character, replace character, regular expression renaming method.
- Support direct-link to Emby, Jellyfin, Plex media server.
- Built-in media library management tools, with an intuitive interface for displaying videos and customizable sorting options by type, date, rating, and more.
All in all, VidHub offers a fully-featured and outstanding media player experience, delivering the smoothest and highest-quality viewing experience for all types of video content, with all the customizations and features one could desire.
Note: The metadata and artwork are sourced from TMDB, a movie and TV show database that is maintained by the community.

“A simple game with a deep meaning.” — INSIDE 
“Experience the role humans play in the ecosystem, and understand that we cannot take whatever we want from Mother Nature without repercussion. Learn how to cherish valuable resources.” — App Store Feature
///// Introduction /////
Desertopia is a relaxing and therapeutic idle simulator where you can spend just 5–10 minutes a day transforming a barren desert island into a vibrant, thriving habitat — all at your own pace. 
Your goal is to care for the island and help restore its wildlife. 
Occasionally, you’ll need to pick up floating trash to keep the environment clean. 
You’ll also make decisions about events triggered by human activity. 
Will you allow a tour group to visit the island? Should you build a resort? 
Every choice you make will directly influence how the island develops.
///// Features /////
・Storybook-style art: Simply watching the animals roam the island can feel therapeutic on its own. 
・100+ animals: Desertopia features over 100 unique creatures and 25+ terrain types. More than 15 legendary species may appear under special conditions — some only during festivals and holidays! 
・Weather and water evaporation: Water evaporation is a unique gameplay mechanic. You’ll need to summon rain regularly to maintain livable conditions for your wildlife. If neglected, the island will gradually revert to a barren desert. 
・Multi-layered music: Enjoy rich, evolving background music that shifts depending on the area and the animals inhabiting it. 
・Events: Cruise ships bring visitors and special events to the island, each with both benefits and drawbacks. How your island evolves is entirely up to you. 
////////////////////

bluejetty:00155767:ios.name: Upstate Curious
bluejetty:00155767:ios.summary:
We love the Hudson Valley + Catskills region! We love exploring every nook and cranny of the mountains and forests and farms and towns - and all the incredible restaurants and shops and art galleries and other places to visit. 
As residen
bluejetty:00155767:ios.description:
We love the Hudson Valley + Catskills region! We love exploring every nook and cranny of the mountains and forests and farms and towns - and all the incredible restaurants and shops and art galleries and other places to visit. 
As residents, we also love (and need!) to know where to find a great dentist, electrician, therapist, or upholsterer, dog groomer, or babysitter depending on the day!
And since one of the best parts about living in or visiting this special area are the people, we think that new ways to meet up online and (eventually!) IRL is also a pretty great idea.
“Upstate Chat” is the main feed where you can share your finds or the view from your backyard (including videos and photos). By using hashtags like #restaurants, #outdoors, #townname, #county, etc., we can make things easy to find - and the section for “Popular Hashtags” will be just that.
“Hotline” is where you go to ask a question you need to crowdsource - from a roofer who turns up on time to the best pizza in Ulster County to an easy hike with dogs. 
You can add searchable interests and a bio to your profile to connect more easily with other members - there’s a DM feature right in the app, but you can share all your social profiles as well.
Upstate Curious was created for residents, visitors, weekenders, and fans - and we cover Ulster, Dutchess, Sullivan, Greene, Columbia, Dutchess, Putnam, Orange, and neighboring countries. The more the merrier!
The Upstate Curious Team members will be posting their finds and tips for #upstateliving - and there are special groups for buyers and sellers to get their own burning questions answered!” 
This app was created by the Upstate Curious Team of Keller Williams Realty Hudson Valley North.

Music DJ automates music playback for ballroom dance events, social dances, weddings, parties, and instructors so you can focus on dancing instead of DJing.
It handles playlist control, smooth transitions, announcements, and music timing from your device music library.
Key Features
Auto crossfade between songs 
Set maximum song duration for dance sets 
Fade in and fade out transitions 
Tempo speed control 
Shuffle and reorder playlists during playback
Dance Announcements
Voice announcements before songs 
Announce dance styles such as Waltz Cha Cha Rumba 
Custom announcements for birthdays or events 
Use text to speech or record your own voice
Playlist Control
Tap or double tap to play instantly 
Swipe to add or remove songs 
Drag and drop to reorder queues 
Manage Requests Playlist and Played history 
Save and load custom DJ playlists

Great for singers and performers
Player Controls
Crossfade and fade transitions 
Skip repeat and background playback 
Music library support DRM free only 
Volume and playback controls
Notes
Uses music stored on your device Apple Music 
DRM tracks are not supported

bluejetty:00119673:ios.name: TickTick:To-Do List & Calendar
bluejetty:00119673:ios.summary: TickTick is a powerful to-do & task management app with seamless cloud synchronization across all your devices. Whether you need to schedule an agenda, make memos, share shopping lists, collaborate in a team, or even develop a new habit, se
bluejetty:00119673:ios.description:
TickTick is a powerful to-do & task management app with seamless cloud synchronization across all your devices. Whether you need to schedule an agenda, make memos, share shopping lists, collaborate in a team, or even develop a new habit, set countdown for birthdays, TickTick is always here to help you get stuff done and keep life on track. 
Key features of TickTick:
• Sync tasks across all devices
• Multiple reminders
• Flexible calendar views
• Integrate with calendar application
• Set flexible recurring tasks
• Create checklists
• Share task lists for collaboration
• Add task via email
• Upload attachments to tasks
• Classify tasks with tags
• Keep track of birthdays, anniversaries with countdown
More functions to help you get focused and boost productivity:
• Use Siri to create tasks faster and easier
• Enable Pomo Timer to stay concentrated
• Set a Goal to develop a Habit
• Instant time & location reminder
• Four priority levels
• Different sort options (by order/date/name/priority)
• Add description/comments to tasks
• Batch edit tasks
• Quick search tasks
TickTick is always free, while you could also upgrade to Premium account to enjoy full access to the most advanced features. 
• More lists and tasks: 299 lists, 999 tasks in each list, 199 subtasks in each task
• Add up to 5 reminders to each task 
• Share a task list to up to 29 members for better collaboration 
• Upload up to 99 attachments every day 
• Subscribe calendars in TickTick 
• Grid view of calendar 
• Custom Smart List 
• Add more than 5 habits
• Add more than 5 countdowns
How TickTick makes you more productive?
• Get all things done
• Never miss a schedule 
• Collaborate more efficiently
• Sync across multiple platforms
• Save efforts for stuff that really matters
About billing of Premium:
Auto-Renewable subscription payment will be charged to your iTunes account as soon as purchase is confirmed. Any unused portion of Premium period you upgraded via other platforms will be forfeited at the same time. Your subscription will get auto renewed unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Please feel free to manage or cancel the auto-renew subscription at any time from the account settings on iTunes after purchase.
TickTick has integrated HealthKit, you can sync your focus time data to Apple Health.
Our Privacy Policy: https://www.ticktick.com/about/privacy
Our Terms of Use: https://www.ticktick.com/about/tos
For questions, feedback, or tips, we're happy to help you at support@ticktick.com 
Connect with us: 
Twitter: @ticktick
Instagram: @ticktickapp
Facebook: @TickTickApp 
Reddit: r/ticktick

bluejetty:00132547:ios.description:
A haunted house, ghosts, an epic adventure quest you won't forget! Survival RPG 4: Haunted Manor is the 4th game of the 2D retro series, it's a Survival RPG (role playing game) adventure. The story begins with the mysterious disappearance of your magical artifact. Your quest is to get it back by exploring the haunted manor and its surroundings, and helping a ghost.
To solve the mystery, you will need to explore a haunted house, lost temples and other dungeons. Fight ghosts, discover hidden objects and treasures, and solve puzzles. Find out who is behind the mystery of the Survival RPG series and who stole your artifact. 
The 2D retro game can also be played offline.
To survive this haunted adventure:
- 7 story chapters that will end the Survival RPG mystery.
- Discover who took your magical artifact and why.
- Explore the haunted house, temples, towers, and islands.
- Discover treasure maps and find hidden objects in houses, dungeons, and towers.
- Fight ghosts and other monsters.
- Craft different tools and objects with recipes that you will unlock during your adventure.
- Solve puzzles and quests offered by RPG characters (NPC).
- 2D retro pixel Survival RPG game.
Enjoy Survival RPG 4: Haunted Manor. A haunted house, a ghost, and an epic adventure quest you won't forget! 
Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/survivaladventurethegame/
