bluejetty:00121498:ios.summary: Get lost in 30,000+ free jigsaw puzzles, with new challenges daily! Dive into captivating Story Book narratives, exciting Thematic Events, or craft custom puzzles from your photos. Whether you're looking for free offline jigsaw puzzles for
bluejetty:00121498:ios.description:
Get lost in 30,000+ free jigsaw puzzles, with new challenges daily! Dive into captivating Story Book narratives, exciting Thematic Events, or craft custom puzzles from your photos. Whether you're looking for free offline jigsaw puzzles for adults to pass the time on your iPhone or free jigsaws for iPad devices, or want to challenge your brain with a fresh daily puzzle, your perfect puzzle awaits! Our hd puzzles and collection of jigsaw puzzles hd images ensure a stunning visual experience.
EXPERIENCE ENGAGING STORIES & THEMATIC EVENTS
Dive into Story Book, a brand-new way to experience jigsaw puzzles! Every puzzle you solve unlocks a new chapter of a captivating story. You'll embark on an immersive narrative journey – a unique blend of relaxation, challenge, and discovery. Join our Thematic Puzzle Events, time-limited activities combining puzzle-solving with educational content (e.g., historical landmarks). For fans of high-quality Veraxen puzzles, these events offer unique new challenges.
EARN COINS & UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE CONTENT
Puzzle Coins – in-game currency earned by completing puzzles of various sizes/difficulty. Earn coins also via rewarded ads or the Coins Gift Chest (every 8 hours). Use coins to unlock exclusive puzzle packs, enhancing long-term progression.
CONFIGURE PUZZLES AS YOU LIKE
Choose from 12 difficulty levels (12 to 440 puzzle pieces). Configure background color and puzzle piece shape. Rotation can be turned on/off. Great for fans of puzzle page formats who enjoy customizability. You can enjoy the full range of options whether you are playing free jigsaw puzzles for iPad or any other compatible device.
CREATE PUZZLES USING YOUR PHOTOS
Use any pictures on your device to create jigsaw puzzles offline. Make puzzles using your family photos, pets, or Internet pictures.
ALL PUZZLES YOU CAN IMAGINE
You will find jigsaw puzzles for any taste in 18 categories. Special puzzle packs appear before holidays: Christmas, Halloween, Easter, Thanksgiving, etc. 
Full list of puzzle categories:
Mystery
Classic
Landscapes
Flowers
Travel
Home
Hobbies
Nature
Animals
Seasons
Hard Puzzles
Food
Art
Children
Transport
Colorful
Assorted
Holidays
The wide range includes options perfect for those looking for free jigsaw puzzles offline playability.
PROGRESS AUTOSAVE
The game saves your progress every time you close a puzzle. You don’t need to think about saving your progress and can do several jigsaw puzzles at the same time.
NEW PUZZLES EVERY DAY
A new jigsaw puzzle appears every day in the Daily Free Puzzle section. On Wednesday there is a big update — several big puzzle packs appear in the game. Small puzzle packs are published on our Facebook page daily: https://www.facebook.com/jigsawpuzzlecollectionhd/
YOUR ACHIEVEMENTS
Track your progress and celebrate your accomplishments in the Awards Screen – a dedicated section displaying all trophies you've earned. Awards are grouped by year and sorted by date, with the most recent shown first. You can earn trophies for completing events or finishing full months of daily puzzles.
NOTE!
While many users search for ad free puzzle games, some ads may appear in our app to help us keep a large number of puzzles available for free. If you prefer an uninterrupted experience, you can switch to a premium subscription that completely removes all ads.
PRIVACY NOTICE TO CALIFORNIA RESIDENT CONSUMER'S ATTENTION:
Before You use the App, please read carefully our EULA and Privacy Statement (links below). Pay special attention to the "California Consumer Privacy Policy" section to be informed of collected personal information and its uses, as well as Your rights and our obligations.
EULA: https://veraxen.com/terms.php
Terms of Use: https://veraxen.com/tos.php
Privacy Policy: https://veraxen.com/privacy.php

bluejetty:00160340:ios.description:
Welcome to Mahjong Voyage, an Exclusive Puzzle Game of Tile Matching. We are thrilled to present a mahjong solitaire game that beautifully combines innovation with classic gameplay. It offers an eye-friendly interface with clear, large tiles, compatible with all iOS devices. Our goal is to provide a gaming experience that's both relaxing and mentally engaging, perfect for everyone seeking a peaceful escape.
At our studio, we specialize in crafting mobile games that bring together relaxation, creativity, and joy. Our unique approach combines traditional tile matching with paradise building, creating an experience that goes beyond classic mahjong solitaire.
How to Play Mahjong Voyage:
Playing Mahjong Voyage is elegantly simple. Match and clear tiles with identical images from the board while building your paradise. Each successful match brings you closer to completing the puzzle and unlocking new elements for your island. As tiles vanish from the board, watch your zen oasis grow!
Exclusive Game Features:
- Classic Mahjong Excellence: Experience traditional gameplay enhanced with paradise building elements
- Island Building Innovation: Transform your matched tiles into beautiful zen structures and gardens
- Eye-Friendly Design: Large, crystal-clear tiles and thoughtfully designed layouts ensure comfortable play
- Paradise Mode: A special gameplay style where each completed puzzle helps expand your island paradise
- Smart Assistance: Helpful features like hints, undo, and shuffle keep your Voyage flowing smoothly
- Daily Rewards: Log in daily to collect special building materials and unlock new puzzle challenges
- Offline Freedom: Enjoy your mahjong adventure anywhere, with no internet connection required
- Universal Design: Optimized for all iOS devices, from iPhone to iPad
Voyage Through Beautiful Worlds:
Each level brings new scenes and layouts to explore. Progress through varied landscapes as you solve increasingly rewarding puzzles and expand your paradise. Collect special tiles, unlock achievements, and watch your personal sanctuary grow with every completed challenge.
Download Mahjong Voyage now and discover why players choose our game for their daily dose of relaxation and creative building. Start your Voyage to paradise today!

listings.name: IFTA Track
listings.description:
IFTA Track is the IFTA mileage tracker and fuel tax log for truckers, owner-operators and small fleets. It records your miles by state with GPS, logs your fuel, and builds your quarterly IFTA summary report for you.

AUTOMATIC GPS MILEAGE BY STATE
• Tracks miles in every US state and Canadian province as you drive
• Records the interstates and highways used in each jurisdiction
• Pause and resume GPS tracking anytime during a trip
• Prefer the odometer? Enter a reading at each state line instead
• Review and adjust the miles for each state before you close a trip

FUEL LOGS AND MPG
• Log every fuel stop: gallons, cost, station, city, state and payment type
• See total gallons, fuel cost and MPG for each trip
• Fuel is tracked by state, ready for your IFTA taxable gallons

QUARTERLY IFTA SUMMARY REPORTS
• Pick a date range and truck, select your trips and export
• For each jurisdiction: total miles, taxable gallons, total gallons, net taxable gallons and fuel cost
• Average MPG, starting and ending odometer, and total trip days (handy for per diem at tax time)
• Export trip sheets and summary reports as PDFs to share or print

TRIPS, LOADS AND INSIGHTS
• Record pickup and drop-off locations for every load
• Starting and ending odometer for every trip
• State Insights: miles, fuel and MPG by state for any date range, exported as PDF or CSV
• Compare average diesel prices by state, adjusted for IFTA tax rates
• Restore deleted trips from Trash
• Dark mode

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Your trips are stored on your phone, so you can start tracking right away. Try IFTA Track free for your first 5 trips.

PLANS
• Basic: unlimited trips on your device, GPS tracking with mileage adjustment, manual odometer entry, drop locations, fuel logs and PDF exports
• Premium, for company accounts: everything in Basic, plus
  – Sync trips across all your devices
  – Manage your fleet: trucks, trailers and driver assignments
  – Add users and manage permissions
  – Create, save and share reports
  – Scan, attach and export fuel receipts

Built for owner-operators, independent truckers and trucking companies that file IFTA every quarter.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00015486:ios.summary:

The
bluejetty:00015486:ios.description:
Monkey Wrench is a fun word find quiz game with a twist that will challenge your brain – you have to use the clues to figure out what the hidden words are! If you like crossword puzzles and wordsearch games, you’ll love Monkey Wrench! 
The answers will be about movies, food, science, sports, music, fashion, history and many other subjects (with lots of fun wordplay) – the 3 difficulty levels and helpful hints will give you just the kind of fun word-searching fun spelling game you’ve been looking for. Words are hidden in a grid, but the monkey wrench in the quiz that will tease and challenge you is that before you can find the words, you need to work out what they are!
Each puzzle consists of a grid of hexagonal tiles with letters. Some tiles are shaded; these are the first letters of the clues that fit into the categories at the top of the screen (swipe sideways to see more categories). Trace or tap a path of connected tiles to select letters and spell out an answer. If your answer matches one of the clues spelling out the word, the tiles disappear and you will find yourself closer to solving the puzzle. Use your brain to hunt for all the clues to clear the tiles and win! 
Monkey Wrench comes with one free bundle of 25 puzzles (with more puzzle packs available for purchase) and the three most recent daily puzzles are also available. Every puzzle has three difficulty levels – find the right one to tease and challenge your brain: 
EASY shows you all the full answers to the clues you need to search for.
MEDIUM shows you only the first letters of each word.
HARD gives you nothing but blanks to fill in. 
You can monkey around between difficulty levels hunting for answers by resetting the puzzle. You may also use the available hints to reveal the vowels of a clue, the last letter, or its location in the grid. Monkey Wrench is a puzzle challenge for all ages with categories to give everyone interesting challenges to solve. The daily puzzles will tease and challenge your brain while you try to hunt for the answers and unravel this fun and entertaining word quiz.
Monkey Wrench is no ordinary word game (crossword, anagram puzzle, wordsearch, etc.) – before you can find the words, you need to figure out what they are by using the clues provided. With three difficulty levels to tease and test you and terms to hunt for from pop culture, science, geography, history and so much more, Monkey Wrench is word-puzzling fun for the whole family!
The Monkey Wrench app comes with a free pack of 25 puzzles, free daily puzzles and more than 1000 additional puzzles available for purchase. Download Monkey Wrench today and play the most creative and interesting spelling quiz game that is as addictive as it is fun.
For more info and other amazing family games, visit:
http://www.blueoxfamilygames.com/

bluejetty:00128215:ios.description:
[ Important Notice ]
With this version (7.0.0), we are ending regular updates for this app.
You can continue using this app, but future development and updates will continue in 'Audio Unit Player', which includes this app's functionality.
'Audio Unit Player' is a free app that supports both speed and pitch adjustment and includes a 31-band equalizer with no band restrictions.
Data Transfer:
File information registered in this app is not transferred automatically to 'Audio Unit Player'. Use the Files app to manually copy any files you need.";
================================================
This app is a music player that can process the following effects in real time.
- Pitch shift (-1 ~ +1 octave)
- 31 band equalizer (required In-App Purchase)
- Reverb
- AUv3 (Audio Unit v3) host
If you play a musical instrument or sing a song, this app should be supported by you higher / lower the pitch.
[Function]
- Perform pitch shift in real time (-12 - +12).
- 31 bands EQ (Hz: 20, 25, 31.5, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100, 125, 160, 200, 250, 315, 400, 500, 630, 800, 1k, 1.25k, 1.6k, 2k, 2.5k, 3.15k, 4k, 5k, 6.3k, 8k, 10k, 12.5k, 16k, 20k).
(Initiality, only 3 bands are available. It's possible to use 31 bands by In-App Purchase.)
- EQ preset (Abundant Built-in Presets / Custom Presets) (required In-App Purchase).
- Reverb: Adjustable decay time (Low freq, High freq) / 13 presets
- Reverb preset (Built-in Presets / Custom Presets)
- Can be used as an AUv3 host.
- A-B loop playback.

Super Farming Boy™ is an exciting mix of ACTION, PUZZLE, and
bluejetty:00080887:ios.description:
** Appstore Awards - Apple TV App of the Year 2025 - Finalist **
** PocketGamer Awards 2025 - Best Indie Game - Finalist **
** Gamescom Latam 2025 - Best Latam Game - Finalist **
Super Farming Boy™ is an exciting mix of ACTION, PUZZLE, and FARMING SIM, heavily relying on CHAIN REACTIONS and COMBOS. 
Story
In Super Farming Boy™, you play as Super, whose mom and friends have been captured by your evil nemesis, KORPO®©TM, who unlawfully hires you to work on your own land, taxing all proceeds for himself! Now, with your friends and mom up for sale, you must harvest your way through challenging adventures, saving enough to buy your mom and friends back!
Gameplay Mechanics
In Super Farming Boy™, there are no tools because you are the tool. With the simple push of a button, you can transform into a shovel, a hammer, a pickaxe, a watering can, and more! Super Farming Boy™ can even FLY! The game's central mechanic revolves around chain reactions and combos. The magical seed creatures in this world, once harvested, trigger specific chain-reaction effects that enable you to optimize your farm in ways never seen before in a farming game. These chain reaction and combo powers also serve as your means of defense against creatures, help optimize your daily stamina usage, and facilitate various actions such as chopping down trees, demolishing boulders, removing weeds, collecting items, defeating bosses, and much more! bluejetty:00149741:ios.description:
Easily Connect and Control your Smart TV with SmartThings app. Please connect both devices to the same WiFi network. Select your TV in the app and, when prompted, please select "Allow" using the physical Remote of your smart TV.
Quick cast and view Photos & Videos one after another in high-definition from your Gallery directly onto your devices with the tap of a button on the dedicated "Cast" Smart things tab.
Features:
+ Intuitive user interface with all buttons with full view.
+ Switch channels, adjust volume, access Settings.
+ Quick access to your favorite apps and channels.
+ Cast feature: Cast media directly from your Gallery.
+ Controlling from any distance (connectivity via wifi network).
How to start mirroring?
- Connect your iPhone/iPad and your TV to the same wifi network
- Open the app and connect the app to your TV
- Allow your TV connect to your iPhone/iPad
- Open the app and click on Start Mirroring to start mirroring on your TV
- To stop mirroring click on top red bar of your iPhone
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
We offer 1 auto-renewing subscription option:
- Subscription Length: Weekly,monthly and Yearly
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- You will be able to access full feature of the app for the duration of the subscription
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original "1 week", "1 month" & "1 Year" unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package (weekly, monthly)
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
- You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Please visit http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information
- You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period
- Any unused portion of a free-trial period, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription
Read our full Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy at

bluejetty:00175254:ios.description:
Time to take a rest! Let’s play Farm Journey TriPeaks Solitaire for fun!
Farm Journey TriPeaks Solitaire is the best casual game for you to kill time! While the rule is quite simple - you just tap any card on the table one higher or lower than the card one the pile to collect it, the gameplay is fun and sometimes challenging - you should decide the order of collecting. If you ever enjoy Klondike, Spider, FreeCell or any other Solitaire card game, you will love this one!
Download and start playing Farm Journey TriPeaks Solitaire NOW!
Farm Journey TriPeaks Solitaire is much more than a classic solitaire card game - there are plenty of extra features to explore!
Highlights of Farm Journey TriPeaks Solitaire
+ Play, Plant & Harvest: As you play, you plant the crops every time you win, which ripen every hour and give you extra coins. Don’t forget to harvest your reward then!
+ Always New Gameplay: Farm Journey TriPeaks Solitaire has unique level design, 4 different modes of level and hundreds of levels currently with more coming soon. There is always something new for you!
+ Win more reward with streak meter: Collect multiple cards on the table without turning the hand card to complete the streak task and get bonus coins, plus-one card or wild card! What’s more, complete the streak with cards of the the same color or same suit to double or triple the reward!
+ Classic Solitaire in your hands: You can play Farm Journey TriPeaks Solitaire without wifi. Enjoy Solitaire anytime anywhere!
Other Features of Farm Journey TriPeaks Solitaire
+ 20,000 welcome bonus and massive Daily Rewards!
+ Easy to start - with the intuitive UI and guidance you will pick up soon!
+ hundreds of different levels, with much more coming!
+ Amazing graphics, easy to read cards and smooth animations!
+ Share with your friends to get rewards every day!
+ Get more coins every hour with every crop planted!
Download NOW and Enjoy Farm Journey TriPeaks Solitaire for FREE!
Your crops are waiting for you to plant and harvest! What are you waiting for? Tap your finger and start playing the best Solitaire card game in the world NOW!

bluejetty:00144816:ios.name: PDF Editor : PDF Reader,Signer
bluejetty:00144816:ios.summary:
PDF Editor is a powerful and user-friendly tool specifically designed for handling PDF files. It integrates a wealth of features that empower you when dealing with PDF files. Here is a detailed overview of its core features:
- Marking & An
bluejetty:00144816:ios.description:
PDF Editor is a powerful and user-friendly tool specifically designed for handling PDF files. It integrates a wealth of features that empower you when dealing with PDF files. Here is a detailed overview of its core features:
- Marking & Annotation
PDF Editor offers a variety of marking tools, including highlights, underlines, strikethroughs, etc., and allows the customization of the color of the markings. You can quickly select text and add markings, or create shapes with custom colors, such as rectangles, circles, lines, arrows, etc. Furthermore, it allows you to insert text boxes and annotations in the PDF, and customize the font size and color.
- Viewing and Printing
You can freely adjust the display size of the PDF. Additionally, it offers a convenient recent file access feature, making opening recent PDF files a breeze. When you need to print PDF files, its intuitive print function can meet your needs.
- Signature
It offers various ways to create signatures, including through the mouse, keyboard, or image files. You can save multiple signatures for quick use when needed.
- Stamping
PDF Editor allows you to freely insert stamps into PDF documents. It comes with a variety of stamp styles, including approval, confidential, final, etc., and supports the customization of stamp content and color.
- Bookmarking:
PDF Editor allows you to view all bookmarks in the PDF document and quickly jump to the bookmark's location. You can also create new bookmarks at any location in the document, and support renaming, deleting, and one-click expanding/collapsing of bookmarks.
- Page Editing:
PDF Editor offers powerful page editing features, including merging and splitting PDFs, adding pages from other PDF files, and adding blank pages at any location. In addition, it supports extracting pages from PDFs, as well as rotating, rearranging, and deleting pages.
- Form Filling
PDF Editor supports filling and saving standard PDF forms, and also supports filling interactive PDF forms, such as text boxes, checkboxes, list boxes, etc.
- PDF Chat
Users can use the PDF chat feature to understand the content of the PDF and perform operations such as text polishing and translation.
In summary, PDF Editor is a comprehensive, easy-to-use PDF processing tool that can effectively help you handle various PDF files.
PDF Editor is free to download and offers 7-days trials for monthly subscriptions. We offer four auto-renewing subscription options:
- 1 month: $4.99
- 1 year: $29.99
- one-time purchase for $39.99
- Offer limited to one 7 day trial per user. After the first 7 days, subscription renews automatically unless cancelled before the end of the 7 day trial. Subscription may be cancelled at any time within the iTunes and App Store Apple ID Settings. All prices include applicable local sales taxes
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

bluejetty:00177794:ios.description:
This is the best camera application out there.
Have you looked for cameras at the Store? 
There are a lot, they are good, they all have something that makes them unique... well... you have ALL those features in this application. 
NOTE: This application is intended to be used for fun. It's not intended to record hidden audio or video or any other thing that may violate other's privacy rights. It's not our intention to promote spying others. 
• Record video and take pictures by just tapping the screen or use one of our smart shooting modes so you don’t miss a scene! Delayed trigger, sequencer and so many other options will blow your mind!
• Our Motion Detector will allow you to save a lot of storage space by recording or shooting only when motion is detected. The Motion Detector is available as a paid feature inside the application. 
• Easy Calc assures that your files will remain PRIVATE by giving you the chance to set a PIN#. You can also customize when you want to be asked to enter the PIN#: at application startup/resume and right after every capture you make. This will prevent that someone that grabs your device while recording can access your files.
• We don't copy, backup or upload your files anywhere. They are totally private and yours. 
• Easy Calc keeps your media files separately from the camera roll for privacy. 
You may export them via eMail or Itunes Share. 
You may also copy your files from the camera roll to our private storage so you don't have to delete those photos or videos that you don't want on the public camera roll. 
• Select the video quality to save storage space. 
Some metrics under normal lightning: 
• Rear Camera: HD Video 1 minute ~ 75Mb / LD Video 1 minute ~ 6Mb 
• Front (face) Camera: HD Video 1 minute ~ 25Mb / LD Video 1 minute ~ 6Mb

bluejetty:00018603:ios.name: Cookpad: Recipe & Meal Planner
bluejetty:00018603:ios.summary:
Not sure what to cook tonight? Cookpad recommends: search by ingredient or by dish across thousands of authentic recipes from a global community of home cooks — all verified by the people who have actually cooked them.
WHAT SHOULD I COOK TO
bluejetty:00018603:ios.description:
Not sure what to cook tonight? Cookpad recommends: search by ingredient or by dish across thousands of authentic recipes from a global community of home cooks — all verified by the people who have actually cooked them.
WHAT SHOULD I COOK TONIGHT?
Tell us what's in the fridge and we'll tell you what to make with it. Chicken, salmon, ground beef, half a box of lasagna noodles: every recipe we put in front of you has already been cooked by someone before you, who left a photo of how it turned out (Cooksnap) and wrote up how it went. It isn't a list of recipes to scroll — it's a recommendation for tonight's dinner, with the proof that it works.
RECIPES VERIFIED BY THE COMMUNITY
Trustworthy recipes, written by the people who cook them every day, not by an editorial team. Every Cooksnap is a photo from someone who made it before you, with comments on how it went: where it goes wrong, whether the measurements add up, how long it really takes. That's how we know what to recommend — no editor decides it, the person who cooked it proves it.
IMPORT FROM ANYWHERE, INCLUDING INSTAGRAM AND TIKTOK
Write your own recipes or import your favorites from any website, from Instagram, from TikTok, from a book or from a handwritten notebook. Build your own biggest recipe collection, all in one place.
Tap Share and the recipe is added straight to your collection — ingredients and steps separated, ready to follow. No more screenshots lost in your camera roll. Save them as drafts and finish them whenever you want.
AUTOMATIC TRANSLATION
Find a recipe in Spanish, Italian or Japanese and read it in English: the translation is automatic.
AD-FREE. ALWAYS.
No ads, not even in the free version. No banner to close with flour on your hands, no video starting up while you're reading the measurements.
YOUR DIGITAL RECIPE BOX, ALL IN ONE PLACE
Your recipe keeper, cookbook and cooking app — all in one. Save cooking recipes from anywhere and find them again in seconds.
• Import & Scan: Import any recipe from a website or a social post in one tap. Snap a photo of a handwritten recipe or cookbook page: AI turns it into a digital recipe.
• Create with AI: Write your own recipes with the AI Recipe Assistant, without forgetting a single step. Save the draft and finish it whenever you have time.
• Organize & Plan: Sort everything into private folders by theme — chicken, desserts, gluten-free, breakfast. Build your weekly menu in a few taps and let your shopping list build itself from your recipes: you only add what's missing.
• Cook What You Have: Cook with what's already in your fridge or pantry. Save money, use your leftovers and reduce food waste.
FOR EVERY TASTE AND NEED
Quick and easy weeknight dinners, chicken and salmon, filet mignon and scallops, soups and chili, breakfast and lunch, baking and desserts — plus cuisines from around the world: Mexican, Italian, Thai, Japanese, Chinese, Indian.
Filters for vegan, vegetarian, keto, gluten-free, dairy-free and baby-led weaning. Tools and methods: air fryer, slow cooker, Instant Pot, bread maker.
SHARE YOUR COOKING
Share recipes with friends, family and the community — or keep them private, just for you. Upload photos of the dishes you've made (Cooksnaps) and tell everyone how it went. Follow home cooks and food creators from around the world and ask for tips whenever you need them.
JOIN A COMMUNITY THAT COOKS EVERY DAY
For everyone — from beginners to experienced cooks — for weeknight dinners or special occasions.
PREMIUM
With Premium you get even more tools to cook your way:
• The most popular recipes at the top of every search.
• Import unlimited recipes.
• Advanced filters to match every recipe to your preferences.
Premium is available in the United States and 22 other countries.
Empty the fridge and find tonight's dinner.
Get in touch: help@cookpad.com

bluejetty:00138376:ios.summary:
In today's connected world, Mobile ID offers a private, secure, contactless way to verify identity, either at home or on-the-go. Everything is on your phone – now your ID is, too!
Intuitive, easy-to-use and highly convenient, New York Mobi
bluejetty:00138376:ios.description:
In today's connected world, Mobile ID offers a private, secure, contactless way to verify identity, either at home or on-the-go. Everything is on your phone – now your ID is, too!
Intuitive, easy-to-use and highly convenient, New York Mobile ID can be used anywhere it’s accepted, in any context a physical ID would be used – with enhanced privacy features. Only your Face ID, TouchID or six-digit pin will unlock the app and access your Mobile ID.
In five simple steps, you can create your New York MiD:
1. Download the app and set permissions
2. Verify access to your phone number 
3. Use your device camera to scan the front and back of your driver license or ID card
4. Follow the steps to capture a selfie 
5. Set up app security and you’re good to go! 
Please note: New York Mobile ID is an official state-issued ID, serving as a companion to your physical ID. As not all entities are able to verify a Mobile ID, you should continue to carry your physical ID.
For more information, please visit: https://dmv.ny.gov/mobileid

bluejetty:00041554:ios.summary: Modamily is where modern families begin. Since 2011, more than 120,000 members in 40+ countries have used Modamily to find the people they'll build a family with — and over 1,000 babies have been born from connections made here. It's also h
bluejetty:00041554:ios.description:
Modamily is where modern families begin. Since 2011, more than 120,000 members in 40+ countries have used Modamily to find the people they'll build a family with — and over 1,000 babies have been born from connections made here. It's also home to the world's largest known-donor network, with 20,000+ donors.
However you want to become a parent, this is your starting point.
THREE PATHS TO PARENTHOOD
• A partner — meet people who are serious about building a family, so the "do you want kids?" conversation happens before the first date, not after a year.
• A co-parent — team up platonically with someone who shares your parenting values and wants to raise a child together.
• A known donor — connect with sperm, egg, and embryo donors and surrogates you can actually know, so your child's story has real answers.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Create a profile built around what matters: your path, parenting style, level of involvement, and timeline.
2. Browse and filter by intentions — not just photos.
3. Match and chat when the interest is mutual.
4. Take it offline and start building your family.
WHY MODAMILY
• Everyone here wants a family. No ambiguity, no wasted years.
• Pioneering modern family building since 2011.
• Every family type: single parents by choice, LGBTQ+ families, couples, and everyone in between.
• A global community across 40+ countries.
PREMIUM
Upgrade to message without time limits, get back expired matches, use advanced filters, and see everyone who likes you. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.modamily.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.modamily.com/en/terms-of-use
Your family starts with the people you choose.

※ Cập nhật các câu hỏi mới nhất 2026, theo bộ 600 câu hỏi của Bộ Công An, Cục CSGT có hiệu lực từ 01/06/2025
※ Chào mừng bạn đến với ứng dụng Ôn thi Bằng lái xe máy hạng A1, A, B1.
※ Ứng dụng gồm đầy đủ bộ câu hỏi mới nhất năm 2025 với 50 câu điểm liệt dùng cho sát hạch, cấp giấy phép lái xe gplx cơ giới đường bộ. Ứng dụng sẽ giúp các bạn chuẩn bị thi bằng lái xe mô tô có thể ôn thi phần lý thuyết một cách nhanh chóng và hiệu quả nhất.
※ Các chức năng chính của ứng dụng bao gồm:
• Bài thi ngẫu nhiên với hàng ngàn đề thi theo cấu trúc ra đề thi của Bộ Công An - Cục CSGT cho các bằng lái xe máy hạng A1 và A.
• Danh sách đề thi bao trọn toàn bộ nội dung của 250 câu hỏi với hạng A1, A; 300 câu hỏi hạng B1 (số lượng câu hỏi tùy theo bằng lái).
• Danh sách 60 câu hỏi điểm liệt được cung cấp riêng.
• Ôn tập với danh sách câu hỏi và theo phân loại câu hỏi.
• Tìm kiếm câu hỏi theo nội dung câu hỏi hoặc câu trả lời.

bluejetty:00119292:ios.summary: Depuis la création du Figaro en 1826, la liberté est notre bien fondamental. Chaque jour, nous vous informons, pour permettre à chacun d'être libre de se faire sa propre opinion, de choisir sa voie et de transmettre, à son tour, la culture
bluejetty:00119292:ios.description:
Depuis la création du Figaro en 1826, la liberté est notre bien fondamental. Chaque jour, nous vous informons, pour permettre à chacun d'être libre de se faire sa propre opinion, de choisir sa voie et de transmettre, à son tour, la culture de la liberté.
Cette liberté, nous la revendiquons, nous la vivons. Et elle vous accompagne au quotidien. Dans notre application gratuite, notre rédaction vous propose chaque jour plusieurs centaines d'articles, d'analyses, de chroniques, de vidéos, d'infographies et de podcasts. Nos équipes de journalistes vous permettent de suivre plus de trente thématiques, de l'actualité politique à l'info France, l'info monde, l'actualité économie, l'actualité sport, l'actualité foot, l'actualité culture et l'info en direct.
Sur l'application du Figaro, vous pouvez aussi :
■ Suivre l'actualité en temps réel avec le Flash info, les directs, les lives vidéo interactifs et les alertes info de la rédaction
■ Commencer votre journée avec la story "Les 5 infos à connaître"pour suivre l'actu essentielle
■ Écouter les podcasts et Le Figaro Radio pour suivre l'actu France, l'actu monde et l'actu politique en audio
■ Retrouver toute la richesse des titres du groupe Figaro: l'actualité au féminin avec Madame Figaro, la télévision avec TVMag et les grands entretiens et reportages du Figaro Magazine et de Madame Figaro.
Choisissez librement vos notifications :
■ Soyez prévenu de tous les grands événements, avec les alertes de la rédaction sur l'actualité France et monde
■ Ne ratez rien sur les thèmes qui vous passionnent grâce aux notifications thématiques : news politique, news sport, news économie, news France et news monde
■ Suivez vos journalistes préférés
Vous pouvez créer votre propre Une en sélectionnant les rubriques qui vous intéressent : actualités France, actualités monde, info politique, info économie, info sport, culture, société et business. Enregistrez certains articles dans vos favoris pour les lire plus tard, et ce même si vous n'êtes pas connecté à Internet. Pour votre confort de lecture, Le Figaro vous offre un mode nuit optimisé. Vous pouvez enfin ajouter un widget pour accéder directement aux informations et aux news en direct depuis l'écran d'accueil de votre téléphone.
L'application vous donne accès à :
■ Toute l'info en continu avec nos lives et directs
■ Des vidéos, reportages et analyses sur l'actu France et monde
■ Le journal numérique et tous les magazines du groupe
■ Des podcasts quotidiens sur l'actualité France et l'actualité monde
■ Le Figaro Radio pour écouter l'info en direct
Libre de s'abonner, libre de se désabonner !
Les articles en illimité, avec une navigation allégée en publicités, et trois niveaux d'abonnement pour tous les usages :
■ Access: 0,99 € le premier mois puis 11,99 € par mois, pour débloquer tous les articles et actualités, et lire les newsletters abonnés.
■ Premium: 0,99 € le premier mois puis 16,99 € par mois, pour débloquer tous les articles et toutes les news, lire les newsletters abonnés, découvrir le journal et ses magazines en avant-première, profiter de trois comptes et des applications Figaro Jeux et Figaro Cuisine.
■ Premium+: 0,99 € le premier mois puis 21,99 € par mois, pour débloquer tous les articles, lire les newsletters abonnés, découvrir le journal et ses magazines en avant-première, accéder au Figaro Histoire, Figaro Hors-Série et Figaro Santé, à l'application Figaro Jeux et partager toute la richesse du Figaro avec le pack famille 5 comptes.
Téléchargez gratuitement l'application Le Figaro pour suivre toute l'actualité en direct, l'info France, l'info monde, les news politique, news économie,sport, culture...
Vos commentaires, remarques et questions sur l'application sont les bienvenus à mobilite@lefigaro.fr.
Mentions légales : https://mentions-legales.lefigaro.fr/le-figaro/cgu-figaro

OKX is the new money app where your money moves at the speed of crypto. It's the world-leading crypto exchange trusted by 100+ million users globally in 160+ countries to buy, sell, and trade Bitcoin, Ethereum, and a wide range of cryptocurrencies with ease and top-tier crypto security. Winner of the 2023 'Most Reliable Tech' award by TradingView.
OKX gives you powerful trading and account tools to monitor and manage all your digital assets. Discover, mint, create, and swap collectibles, Ordinals, and inscriptions, with zero fees for traders and crypto creators. Find the best crypto and bitcoin (BTC) prices across all major marketplaces. Experience blazing-fast swaps and quotes for the market-leading crypto price discovery across 500 decentralized exchanges. Deep liquidity at speed for the best crypto prices on the market, quoted in milliseconds, 24/7.
One app. Many possibilities:
● Buy and sell bitcoin (BTC) and crypto in just a few taps with competitive fees and 100+ accepted currencies.
● Easy token discovery from thousands of digital assets, including bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Ripple (XRP), Tether (USDT), Solana (SOL), Dogecoin (DOGE), BNB and Shiba Inu (SHIB).
● Manage CEX and DEX in one app. Trade offchain and onchain, and track everything from one portfolio.
● Money never sleeps with crypto staking. Earn up to 4.1% APY on 1:1 USD-pegged USDG held on OKX. 
● Simple and advanced trading and charting tools for bitcoin (BTC) and crypto.
● Move money from crypto exchange to your wallet in just a few taps.
● Web3 at your fingertips with DeFi and DAOs.
Funds are Secured on OKX:
● 1:1 Reserves: Every dollar in customer deposits is backed by a dollar in assets (1:1 reserve ratio) so your money is always available.
● Security you can trust: A independently audited, Proof of Reserves verified, self-custody optional, and trusted by 100M+ users globally.
● Advanced Trading Tools: Analyse the markets with detailed technical analysis, live order books, and pro-trader charting tools, all powered by TradingView.
● Automate your strategy: Trading bots run 24/7 — set up Spot Grid and Spot DCA in a few clicks.
Opportunities Unlimited:
● Thousands of spot trading asset opportunities in one app.
● Competitive tight spreads with low, transparent fees.

bluejetty:00062301:ios.description:
This official ICBC app has everything you need to help you prepare for—and pass—the knowledge test for your learner’s (Class 7L) licence in British Columbia.
The app includes:
• ICBC’s practice knowledge test.
• The driving guide: Learn to Drive Smart.
• Licensing office locations.
Take the practice test anytime, anywhere —as often as you need.
How it works
The practice test consists of 25 multiple-choice questions randomly chosen from a database of nearly 200 questions. The questions are based on the information in the ICBC driving guide, Learn to Drive Smart. On the actual test, you will need to answer 40/50 questions correctly to pass.
As you answer questions, the app lets you know if you’re on track and where to look in Learn to Drive Smart for more info.
You can also watch safe driving tips on video and look up the location of your nearest licensing office when you’re ready to book your actual knowledge test.
Got a perfect score?
Share your test results with your friends on Facebook, X (Twitter) or email.
How to pass your knowledge test
Taking the practice knowledge test can help prepare you for the actual one, but to pass, you need to also study and understand the material in the Learn to Drive Smart guide.
About ICBC
At the Insurance Corporation of British Columbia (ICBC) our job is making sure the auto insurance system works for all road users and working towards a safer B.C.. We license and insure drivers and vehicles across the province and work to promote road safety through road improvement projects and awareness campaigns
Find out more on icbc.com.
Legal

bluejetty:00119815:ios.name: iTeacher App
bluejetty:00119815:ios.summary: The iTeacher App offers an exciting and simple new way for teachers to complete their daily classroom tasks. From taking registers to awarding a commendation, viewing timetables and accessing student information, teachers can quickly and ea
bluejetty:00119815:ios.description:
The iTeacher App offers an exciting and simple new way for teachers to complete their daily classroom tasks. From taking registers to awarding a commendation, viewing timetables and accessing student information, teachers can quickly and easily complete key tasks directly from their mobile device or tablet.
Integrated communications including email and SMS allow teachers to communicate directly with students and other teachers in just a few clicks. Helpful system messages and free push notifications also assist with keeping teachers up-to-date with any important student information, school news and timetable changes.
The dashboard is organised across four key tabs offering a quick snapshot of key information relevant to each teacher including their current and next lesson, their timetable, cover arrangements, any student updates, absent and detention lists, off games lists, news, bulletins and calendar events. It also contains a new iFeed feature that highlights any key data changes for students who a teacher has academic and/or pastoral responsibility for.
Valuable key features include:
Taking a register - whether in the classroom, on the playfield or on a trip
Viewing student profiles for quick access to academic, pastoral, medical and emergency contact information
Viewing timetables, including those of other teachers and students 
Accessing cover arrangements
Awarding commendations and managing detentions
Sending emails and SMS
Access to all school news and bulletins, the school calendar and the school directory
There is also the functionality to send emergency broadcasts at the click of a button to all staff, students and parents.
The iTeacher App is a native app downloaded onto teachers’ mobile devices and tablets. This provides enhanced security and quicker access to information.
Please note: The iTeacher App must be installed by your school in order for it to be accessible to teachers and only works in conjunction with the iSAMS Management Information System.

bluejetty:00179257:ios.name: POWERUP 4.0
bluejetty:00179257:ios.summary:
POWERUP 4.0 is the smartest, most intuitive paper plane kit we’ve ever made. It makes it possible to fly with ease and smoothness in a variety of conditions. 
Say goodbye to nosedives and choppy flights. We’ve added a new on-board flight c
bluejetty:00179257:ios.description:
POWERUP 4.0 is the smartest, most intuitive paper plane kit we’ve ever made. It makes it possible to fly with ease and smoothness in a variety of conditions. 
Say goodbye to nosedives and choppy flights. We’ve added a new on-board flight computer and 2 new sensors: gyro and accelerometer, combined with 2 thrust vectoring motors. That means flying POWERUP 4.0 is smoother than ever, and can now do all this:
That’s right. POWERUP 4.0 can auto-loop. So you can master tricks and awesome aerobatics by simply pressing a button.
We’ve added 2 high speed motors to POWERUP 4.0. That means you’ve got double the thrust, additional maneuvering possibilities, and sharper turns. 
And together with the flight assist, you can fly just about anything
Now you can learn to fly like a pro. We’re showing you real-time analytics including heading direction, thrust level and turning angles.
We’ve made it a lot easier and way cooler to fly POWERUP 4.0 at night. Optional LED lights will enable you to light up the night - making for awesome visuals and round-the-clock fun.
2 rear wheels and 1 front wheel give your paper plane more style and make for easier takeoff and landing. They also make it possible to launch off of a surface rather than hand-launching. 
We partnered with the best RC hobby vloggers on the planet – FliteTest! They have put together their incredibly creative minds to develop a foam jet inspired by the F22 for the 4.0. It is made from a special laser cut foam board they created and make in the USA.
Intuitive control makes it easy to fly. Simply tilt your phone in the direction you want your plane to fly. It’s really that easy.
POWERUP is an incredibly helpful tool when it comes to teaching and learning aeronautics. Students can test multiple designs, analyze their work and improve their planes. Through trial and error, they can understand what makes their plane fly smoother, longer and farther- key lessons in airplane design.

bluejetty:00015351:ios.description:
Give your child a confident start to school with SplashLearn – the award-winning learning app for Preschool and Kindergarten kids!
Loved by over 60 million learners and trusted by 1.6 million teachers, SplashLearn helps children build early reading, math, and thinking skills through play-based lessons and engaging games.
Awards and Recognition
• Winner of the Tabby Award for Best Educational App
• Featured as “No. 1 Education App” by Apple
• Winner of the BestAppEver Award for Best Elementary Student App
About SplashLearn
SplashLearn turns structured learning into fun exploration.
Designed for ages 4 to 6, it follows a guided path that introduces essential preschool and kindergarten concepts through colorful games, interactive stories, and creative activities. Kids learn step by step while building confidence, curiosity, and a lifelong love of learning.
What Your Child Will Learn
→ Reading Readiness
• Recognize letters and learn letter sounds
• Trace uppercase and lowercase letters
• Build sight-word vocabulary and reading fluency
→ Math Readiness
• Count objects and understand number order
• Practice basic addition and subtraction
• Explore shapes, sizes, and measurement through play
→ Cognitive and Creative Skills
• Solve puzzles and pattern-recognition challenges
• Boost memory and problem-solving through matching games
• Express creativity with drawing, coloring, and art activities
Why Families Love SplashLearn
• Structured learning path: Gradual lessons designed by educators to prepare kids for school success
• Playful learning: Games, stories, and rewards keep every session fun and engaging
• Independent exploration: Simple navigation lets children learn at their own pace
• Safe and ad-free: A 100% kid-friendly environment parents can trust
Parent Reviews
“My daughter loves her SplashLearn time. She’s learning letters and numbers faster than I imagined.” – Rachel G.
“The app makes preschool learning fun! My 5-year-old is excited to play every day.” – David S.
“As a kindergarten teacher, I recommend this to every parent. It’s structured, safe, and effective.” – Linda T.
Subscription & Free Trial
Try it free! Get full access during your free trial, then choose a flexible plan that fits your family.
Enjoy unlimited learning games, lessons, and rewards with one subscription.
Need Help?
We’re here for you → https://support.splashlearn.com/hc/en-us
Privacy & Terms
Your child’s safety comes first.

MileKeeper operates seamlessly in the background, automatically tracking every mile you drive. Say goodbye to manual logs and paperwork—MileKeeper eliminates the hassle of mileage tracking, making it simple and reliable for small business owners, freelancers, and self-employed professionals.
Designed for accuracy, convenience, and efficiency, MileKeeper lets you focus on your work while it handles the details. Just set your work hours, and the app will automatically classify trips as business or personal—no extra actions required.
Why Choose MileKeeper?
- Smart Mileage Tracker – Automatically records and classifies every trip, so you don’t have to.
- IRS-Compliant Reports – Generate detailed logs that maximize your tax deductions.
- Effortless Trip Categorization – Set your work hours, and the app does the rest.
- User-Friendly Interface – Intuitive, easy-to-use design tailored for busy professionals.
- Start for Free – Track up to 40 trips per month at no cost, then upgrade anytime for unlimited tracking.
- Battery-Efficient – Uses smart tracking algorithms to extend your phone’s battery life.
Key Features of MileKeeper – Your Mileage Tracker App:
- Automatic Mileage Tracking – Captures every mile with precision and accuracy.
- Customizable Work Hours – Set your schedule, and the app sorts your drives automatically.
- Tax-Ready Reports – Export driving logs for tax deductions, reimbursements, and accounting needs.
- Privacy & Security – Your data is encrypted and securely stored.
Simplify Trip Management with an AI-Powered Tracker
Forget complex spreadsheets and manual logs! With MileKeeper’s AI-driven mileage tracker, every trip is recorded, categorized, and stored securely—so you can focus on what matters most.
Maximizing tax savings and claiming reimbursements for your business trips has never been easier. With automatic trip classification, you’ll never miss a single business mile.
Who Is MileKeeper – The AI Mileage Tracker – For?
Our app is the perfect solution for:
- Small business owners who rely on their vehicle for work.
- Freelancers and gig workers who need an easy way to log their drives.
- Self-employed professionals who want IRS-compliant mileage reports.
- Anyone looking to simplify drive tracking and maximize savings.
Want a "set it and forget it" solution? MileKeeper runs in the background and is ready when you need it for tax season.
Get Started for Free:
Try MileKeeper with no upfront cost – track up to 40 trips per month for free, then upgrade anytime for unlimited tracking and advanced features.
Download MileKeeper Today!
Save time, money, and stress while ensuring accurate mileage logs for tax deductions, audits, and reimbursements.
Important: MileKeeper is available exclusively in the United States.

bluejetty:00012443:android.name: TrajectoryTiming
bluejetty:00012443:android.summary: In Spring Pongs, players seek to hit targets, obstacles, or enemies by controlling a bouncing paddle or ball that moves across the screen either vertically or horizontally. Since each bounce or spring must be precisely timed to prevent miss
bluejetty:00012443:android.description: In Spring Pongs, players seek to hit targets, obstacles, or enemies by controlling a bouncing paddle or ball that moves across the screen either vertically or horizontally. Since each bounce or spring must be precisely timed to prevent missing objectives or tumbling off platforms, timing and accuracy are key components of the gameplay. To launch the ball, change angles, or manage movement, players tap or swipe, maintaining constant velocity. Levels gradually add narrow platforms, spikes, and moving obstacles that call for fast thinking and strategic preparation. Power-ups increase variation and difficulty by appearing to improve jumping height, speed, or score. The game rewards players who can sustain momentum, chain hits, and maneuver through increasingly challenging stages for high scores. It places a strong emphasis on rhythm, focus, and hand-eye coordination.

bluejetty:00039545:ios.summary:
قلم المدقق اللغوي الذكي ولوحة المفاتيح
هل تواجه مشكلة في كتابة نص يخلو من الأخطاء الإملائية واللغوية؟
لا تقلق، سيفي قلم بهذا الغرض. وسيساعدك قلم بعدة مهام يؤديها بشكل متسق ودقيق باستخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي. وسيعزز قلم قوة كتابتك العربية، وس
bluejetty:00039545:ios.description:
قلم المدقق اللغوي الذكي ولوحة المفاتيح
هل تواجه مشكلة في كتابة نص يخلو من الأخطاء الإملائية واللغوية؟
لا تقلق، سيفي قلم بهذا الغرض. وسيساعدك قلم بعدة مهام يؤديها بشكل متسق ودقيق باستخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي. وسيعزز قلم قوة كتابتك العربية، وسيجعلها أكثر إبداعاً في كل مكان تكتب فيه على أجهزتك الذكية، والآن أصبح بإمكانك استخدام حسابك نفسه على جميع أجهزتك الأخرى.
جاءت مهمة قلم أن يكون عوناً لكم في التخلص من أخطاء كتابة النصوص العربية، فقلم يعمل عمل المصحح الإملائي والمدقق اللغوي، فهو يدقق القواعد النحوية، ويصحح الأخطاء الإملائية وعلامات الترقيم، كما يقترح تحسين الصياغة عند الكتابة باللغة العربية، بالإضافة إلى توفير خدمة التشكيل التلقائي للنصوص العربية وتدقيق الآيات القرآنية.
مهام قلم:
- تدقيق الأخطاء الشائعة في الكتابة باللغة العربية.
- تصحيح أخطاء الهمزات.
- إزالة اللبس بين التاء المربوطة والهاء.
- تصحيح الإشكال بين الياء والألف المقصورة.
- حذف الأحرف المكررة بشكل عشوائي.
- حذف المسافات العشوائية.
- اقتراح التصويبات الملائمة للسياق.
- تدقيق الأخطاء النحوية.
- تصحيح الأخطاء والقواعد الإملائية.
- التشكيل التلقائي للنصوص.
- تدقيق وتوثيق الآيات القرآنية.
- وغيرها الكثير من خدمات المساعدة اللغوية.
ما الذي يميز لوحة المفاتيح قلم؟
أكثر ما يميز لوحة المفاتيح قلم أنها بنيت باستخدام تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي لتساعد المستخدم على اكتشاف الأخطاء وتنقيحها أثناء الكتابة في التطبيقات التي تتيح للمستخدم كتابة النصوص باللغة العربية. كما تحسن نماذج تعلم الآلة وتطويرها، لنقدم للمستخدمين أكبر فائدة ممكنة من دمج المدقق العربي مع المدقق الآلي.
يمكنك استخدم خدمات قلم بطريقتين:
1- تطبيق لوحة المفاتيح
تفعيل لوحة مفاتيح قلم واستخدامها عند الكتابة، فهي ستكون فعالة لمساعدتك على جميع التطبيقات، لتضمن لك كتابة صحيحة وخالية من الأخطاء، ويمكنك الاطمئنان على خصوصية معلوماتك، لأن قلم لا يحفظ البيانات من لوحة المفاتيح.
 2- المستندات
من خلال المستندات الموجودة داخل تطبيق قلم، يمكنك إنشاء مستندات خاصة بك، والكتابة فيها أو نسخ نصوص خارجية بسهولة والبدء في تدقيقها داخل هذه المستندات، كما يمكنك نشرها إلى أي تطبيق آخر.
- كيفية عمل قلم
يتم تظليل الكلمات الخاطئة أو المقترح تحسينات لها، وعند الضغط على أيقونة قلم، ستعرض بطاقات لتصحيح الكلمات المقترحة بما يتناسب المحتوى الخاص بك. كما يمكنك تجاهل الخطأ بالضغط على زر "تجاهل" أو إضافتها إلى القاموس الشخصي بالضغط على "إضافة إلى القاموس".
• اللون الأحمر يدل على الأخطاء الإملائية.
• اللون الأزرق للأخطاء النحوية في النص.
• اللون الأصفر لاقتراحات تحسينات الصياغة.
• اللون البنفسجي لاقتراحات المعجم.
• اللون الرمادي لتصحيح علامات الترقيم.
للاستفادة من خدمات التشكيل وتوثيق النصوص القرآنية، كل ما عليك عمله هو تظليل النص الذي ترغب في توثيقه أو تشكيله ومن ثم الضغط على خيار "تشكيل" أو "توثيق".
سياسة الخصوصية : https://qalam.ai/privacy-policy
الشروط والأحكام : https://qalam.ai/terms-and-conditions

أكثر ما يميز لوحة المفاتيح قلم أنها بنيت باستخدام تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي لتساعد المستخدم على اكتشاف الأخطاء وتنقيحها أثناء الكتابة في التطبيقات التي تتيح للمستخدم كتابة النصوص باللغة العربية. كما تحسن نماذج تعلم الآلة وتطويرها، لنقدم للمستخدمين أكبر فائدة ممكنة من دمج المدقق العربي مع المدقق الآلي.

- كيفية عمل قلم
 
يتم تظليل الكلمات الخاطئة أو المقترح تحسينات لها، وعند الضغط على أيقونة قلم، ستعرض بطاقات لتصحيح الكلمات المقترحة بما يتناسب المحتوى الخاص بك. كما يمكنك تجاهل الخطأ بالضغط على زر "تجاهل" أو إضافتها إلى القاموس الشخصي بالضغط على "إضافة إلى القاموس".

bluejetty:00073788:ios.description:
LINES by TouringPlans will help you save time and money during your Walt Disney World trip. We created Lines to help you know where to go and what to do during your Disney vacation. No other app – even Disney’s official app – gives you as much unbiased information and time-tested data at your fingertips.
LINES features include:
· PARK RECOMMENDATIONS for the next 10 days.
· CROWD CALENDAR, so you know how busy each park will be for the next 10 days.
· Customized, step-by-step TOURING PLANS for each Disney park so you save time waiting in line for any attractions—or all attractions.
· REAL-TIME UPDATES to show you what to ride now, what to wait to ride, and even what attractions are offline (with an estimated return time).
· ACCURATE WAIT TIMES using predictive technology and crowd-sourced live data to let you know how long you really will wait in line, no matter what the posted time says.
· LIGHTNING LANE suggestions, to help you make choices to save you time.
· COMPLETE PARK SCHEDULES including operating hours, parades, shows, and more.
· SEARCHABLE MENUS WITH PRICES to help you find a Mickey Bar in EPCOT or the best use of a snack credit in Magic Kingdom. An invaluable help for people with allergies, dietary restrictions, or those looking for a favorite food.
· PLUS MUCH, MUCH MORE.
Our Disney trip planning tools have been featured by USA Today, The New York Times, Parents Magazine, AAA, major news networks, and newspapers, magazines, television shows, and radio shows. Since 1986, we’ve helped more than 3 million families plan their Walt Disney World Vacations.
Note: Some LINES features, such as full crowd calendar access and all attraction wait times require an in-app subscription purchase for access. Other LINES features, such as customized touring plans, menus, and Lines Chat are completely free. Your in-app subscription includes 365 days of access to TouringPlans.com, the internet’s most popular subscription-based site for Disney trip planning.
LINES by TouringPlans is not affiliated with or sponsored by the Walt Disney corporation or Walt Disney World.

**Introducing Sabr – A Guided Meditation App For Muslims**
Life can get tough at times. With the hustle and bustle of work, the variety of distractions, informational overload, and yes… the pandemic, finding time to reflect and slow down seems almost impossible.
While there are many guided meditation and mental health apps in the market, the need for an Islamic one is more important now than ever before.
**Inside The App**
1. Guided Meditation 
Researched backed guided meditation sessions through an Islamic Lens. We’ve worked with prominent Muslim therapists and professionals across the globe to curate this material, Alhamdulillah! 
(Examples include: “7 days of Anxiety)
2. Spiritually Uplifting Courses
Motivational and uplifting courses. We’ve worked with reputable Scholars and Professionals across the globe for this content. 
(Example: 1-hour courses on ‘Hope’ broken down into several audio snippets.)
3. Vocals (nasheeds)
Hours of peaceful, vocal-only background and ASMR tracks. We’ve worked with some of the world’s well-known and renowned Nasheed artists for this section, Alhamdulillah! 
Study, relax, and sleep better with the vocals section!
We hope you enjoy your experience on the Sabr App. You are now officially apart of the #SabrFamily
Please share any feedback, bugs, concerns, or wishlist items to info@Sabrapp.com

bluejetty:00064729:ios.summary:

Receive push message, check order, approve - with the new photoTAN push function, you can approve orders quickly and securely with just one click. With the photoTAN scan function, you still have the option o
bluejetty:00064729:ios.description:
Commerzbank's new photoTAN app.
Receive push message, check order, approve - with the new photoTAN push function, you can approve orders quickly and securely with just one click. With the photoTAN scan function, you still have the option of scanning a photoTAN graphic to generate a TAN.
It is now possible to fully legitimize yourself from the comfort of your own home with the VideoIdent app. With our new feature, the digital first activation, you can after the legitimation with VideoIdent in the next 3 hours easily and quickly activate the photoTAN app with a code that you receive by SMS. This means you no longer have to wait for the activation graphic
The photoTAN app is our most innovative security method. The app offers the highest possible security through a modern and convenient TAN procedure - for all customers who use Commerzbank's online and / or mobile banking.
#######################
Hard-/software checks of your device: At runtime, we check known, security-relevant attack vectors (e.g. rooted/jailbreak, malicious apps, etc.) To do this, we need your consent.
If you do not agree to do such a security checks, we kindly ask you not to install our photoTAN app and instead to use our reading device to use the online banking offer on the Internet (https://www.commerzbank.de/). You can also revoke your consent at any time for the future by uninstalling our photoTAN app from your device.
#######################
What do I need the photoTAN app for?
The photoTAN app is one of our security factors. The photoTAN is an important part of every login and transaction in your online and mobile banking. It is used to verify the order data you have entered and to generate the transaction number (TAN).
How does photoTAN-Push work?
The push function of our new photoTAN app is particularly convenient. As soon as a new order is available for you to approve, we send you a notification to your smartphone when you use photoTAN-Push. When you then open the photoTAN app, the order to be approved is displayed directly for you to check. If the data displayed is correct, you release the order with just one click.
How does photoTAN scan work?
After placing an order in Online Banking, a mosaic-like colorful graphic appears on the monitor. You scan this with the photoTAN app. A TAN is displayed immediately. To check, you then see the essential details of your order again in the app. If everything is correct, simply enter the TAN on the computer and the order is confirmed.
By the way: With our mobile banking, you can make transfers even faster and easier than on your computer. To do this, use the free Commerzbank banking app!
The advantages of the new photoTAN app at a glance:
• Security: Commerzbank's most innovative TAN procedure.
• Uncomplicated: You receive a notification on your smartphone when a new order is ready for approval.
• Fast: You can approve orders with just one click.
• Free of charge: The use of photoTAN is free of charge for you.
• Mobile banking: Quick order approvals via the banking app using the App2App function.
• Offline usability: If your smartphone is offline, you can continue to approve orders easily with the scan function.
For more information on the new photoTAN process, visit http://www.commerzbanking.de/phototan.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose your topic, audience personality, viewer count and arrival speed. AI comments respond to your speech, typed messages and optional camera snapshots. Use camera effects, pin questions and add background music.

KEEP THE CONVERSATION GOING

bluejetty:00140509:ios.description:
Richard Gray undergoes the trials in his memories to accept his past.
Play a new hidden object game, solve unique puzzles and dark mysteries!
_____________________________________________________________________
Will you manage to solve the mystery of Grim Tales 25: Light in Darkness? Test yourself in solving engaging puzzles, explore unusual locations and find out what trials await Richard and if he can change.
Richard Gray's soul finds itself in the astral world where he meets the Soul Guide. To have a chance at redeeming himself, Richard, tormented by guilt, must face challenges from his past and realize how he can become a better person.
Note that this is a free trial version of the hidden objects game.
You can get the full walkthrough by means of an in-app purchase.
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO RICHARD GRAY
Travel to the astral world, solve puzzles and explore item-hunting scenes to find out why Richard's soul came to this world and how he can get a second chance. An exciting plot that will be enjoyed by fans of hidden mysteries games and detective games.
COMPLETE THE TRIALS AND FIX THE ERRORS OF THE PAST
Richard faces challenges, each of which is linked to his past. He delves into his own dark memories and uses all his knowledge in a struggle to redeem himself. Will he have the determination to face the challenges and prove himself a better man? Find missing objects, artifacts, and hidden objects! Enjoy thrilling locations and complete mini-games in this puzzle adventure!
UNRAVEL THE GRIM SECRETS IN THE BONUS CHAPTER
Play as Anna Gray, who receives a disturbing message from her father Richard. She will face difficult choices and confront the dark mysteries of the past. Will Anna Gray learn what happened to her father?

bluejetty:00021675:ios.summary:
► Easy to Play, Fun to Manage
Ever dreamed of being surrounded by cute animals? In this fast-paced, addictive game, you’ll freely explore the world and build your own animal empire. Discover over 100 different animals, from common pets to
bluejetty:00021675:ios.description:
► Easy to Play, Fun to Manage
Ever dreamed of being surrounded by cute animals? In this fast-paced, addictive game, you’ll freely explore the world and build your own animal empire. Discover over 100 different animals, from common pets to exotic species found only in zoos. As the owner, you’ll manage pet shops and zoos, catering to customer and breeder demands. Purchase enclosures, upgrade facilities, and improve your skills—there’s always something to do. Dive into this thrilling casual game and start your animal search adventure!
► A Unique Experience: Animal Action & Kingdom Simulation
【Become the Animal King】Begin your journey by catching a hamster and opening your pet shop. As you level up, you’ll capture larger and rarer creatures. Manage your shop and hunt down animals—it’s hectic, but incredibly fun!
【Engaging Action】With simple yet innovative controls, chase down animals before they escape! Master thrilling moves like high jumps, zip lines, and parkour for an exhilarating gameplay experience.
【Build Your Animal Kingdom】Running a successful pet shop requires constant action. Set up enclosures, expand viewing areas, hire staff, and improve efficiency. As you upgrade your pet shop, customer satisfaction will soar! Don’t forget to stock your zoo too—when it gets crowded, enhance your facilities to boost your earnings. You might even attract VIP customers!
【Adventures Await】Travel the world and establish your Animal Land in various locations. From lush forests to sparkling seas, deserts, and safaris, different stages and animals await your discovery. Explore each world and create your unique animal kingdom. Occasionally, embark on high-speed adventures in your 4WD car through stunning landscapes.
【Keep Growing】To become the ultimate Animal King, continuous improvement is essential. Upgrade your speed and capture abilities! As your shop management improves, so will your level as the Animal King. Efficiency is key in capturing animals and running your store—so don’t forget to level up yourself!
【Over 100 Animals to Discover】
From dogs, cats, pigs, cows, and sheep to pandas, elephants, and giraffes—encounter over 100 different animals, including mythical creatures! Some will be challenging to catch, so bring your courage and skill!
【Complete the Animal Encyclopedia】
With endless content to enjoy, can you find and catch all the animals? Some are hard to find, and others are rare—complete your encyclopedia and become the true Animal King!
► Five-Star Fun
Looking for an original, easy-to-play game that offers hours of entertainment? This casual action-adventure and management simulation game blends exciting gameplay, pet shop management, zoo operations, and time management all in one.
Who will create the ultimate Animal Kingdom? It could be you! Download "Animal Search!" now and build your animal empire.

bluejetty:00149836:ios.description:
First Hope Bank is your personal financial advocate. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what you can do with First Hope Bank:
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Turn off your debit card if you've misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode or biometric on supported devices. 
Privacy & Security:
For your security, you must enable Mobile Banking Services from within Online Banking before you may use any of First Hope Bank's mobile features. 
First Hope Bank will not send unsolicited text or email messages containin urgent requests to contact the bank asking for personal information. Whenever communicating with the Bank by phone, only use official First Hope phone numbers published on your bank statement, the back of our debit card or on our website at www.firsthope.bank. 
There is no fee to download this app, however connectivity and usage rates may apply. Contact your wireless service provider for more details.

bluejetty:00093909:ios.description:
A missão do Grupo Evolua é tornar a vida em sociedade mais harmoniosa e sustentável, agregando valor ao seu patrimônio.
Comprometemo-nos com a qualidade e excelência em nossos serviços, sempre prezando pela transparência, inovação e agilidade.
Tanto pelo site do Grupo Evolua quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida e acima de tudo, de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora. 
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com o Grupo Evolua, a vida em condomínio é muito mais eficiente.
Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para grupoevolua@winker.com.br

Com o Grupo Evolua, a vida em condomínio é muito mais eficiente.
Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.

Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para grupoevolua@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00038885:ios.description:
하루 2분, 돈 벌면서 공부하는 언어 학습 앱 똑똑보카에서,
세상에서 가장 작은 시작을 꾸준한 습관으로 만들어요.
[똑똑보카 주요 기능]
1. 다양한 언어 코스를 공부해요!
- 영어, 일본어, 중국어, 한자, 국어 어휘, 성경, 상식까지! 하나의 앱에서 원하는 언어 모두 무료로 공부해요.
2. 공부하고 돈을 벌어요!
- 똑똑퀴즈를 풀고 캐시를 적립해요.
- 학습을 꾸준한 습관으로 만드는 습관미션, 짧은 시간에 학습을 완료하는 2분집중학습 등 다양한 방법으로 공부하면서 더 많은 캐시를 적립할 수 있어요.
3. 공부하고 모은 돈으로 기프티콘을 교환해요!
- 적립된 캐시는 네이버페이 포인트, 스타벅스 커피, 편의점 상품권 등 원하는 기포티콘으로 바로 교환할 수 있어요.
4. 짧은 시간에 많은 표현을 공부해요!
- 모든 학습 콘텐츠는 AI 데이터 분석을 통해 맞춤형 커리큘럼으로 구성돼있어요.
- 학습 지속률이 일반 언어 학습 앱에 비해 3.78배나 높아요. 하루 딱 2분만 해도 학습 효과를 높혀줄 수 있도록 구성했어요.
- 반복 노출이 중요한 언어 공부! 위젯을 통해 자주 노출 되니까 저절로 암기돼요.
5. 맞춤형 코스를 선택해요!
- 영어 : 생활영어에 필요한 영단어, 원어민 일상 회화 표현, 토익 및 공무원 준비생을 위한 시험 대비 영단어, 내신 영어 단어 등 다양한 주제로 공부할 수 있어요.
- 한자 : 한자능력검정시험, 생활 한자, 사자성어 등 내게 딱 맞는 주제를 선택할 수 있어요.
- 일본어 : 히라가나 가타카나 읽는 법부터 JLPT 급수별 단어, 생활 일본어도 선택할 수 있어요.
- 중국어 : HSK 급수별 단어, 난이도별 생활 중국어를 선택할 수 있어요.
- 국어 어휘 : 사자성어, 헷갈리는 어휘 표현 등 난이도별 국어 어휘를 선택하여 학습해요.
- 시사 상식 : 일상에 유용한 종합 상식부터, 경영/마케팅, 경제, 과학, 국제, 기술, 역사 등 원하는 분야 집중 상식을 선택할 수 있어요.
- 성경 : 원하는 장, 절의 말씀을 받아보세요.
더 이상 종이 단어장, 여러 가지 언어 학습 앱은 필요 없어요!
똑똑보카에서는 영어,한자,일본어,중국어,국어 어휘, 시사 상식, 성경까지! 모두 한 앱 안에서 끝낼 수 있어요.
언어 학습을 통해 자기계발부터 뇌 건강까지!
지금 바로 똑똑보카에서 시작해보세요.

bluejetty:00186261:ios.description:
ReadCube is the simplest way to read, manage and discover research literature. ReadCube on your iPhone and iPad are the perfect companions to the ReadCube web and desktop software, enabling you to access your papers anywhere – read on the go, organize your library, and annotate PDFs with notes and highlights.
Enhanced PDF:
• Tap-able inline citations, reference lists, and author names so you can quickly find cited articles and related information
• Supplements are automatically attached where available
• Fullscreen or double-page PDF viewing plus multi-touch zoom/navigation for an optimal reading experience
• Multi-color highlighting and note taking tools
Easily find new papers:
• Search the ReadCube databases within the app
• Quickly download new articles with a single tap when you’re on campus or with your institutional proxy
• Import directly from Safari, email attachments, and other apps
• In your preferred browser, use any search engine to find article PDFs
• Use the “Open In…” option from the browser or any app to add PDFs to your ReadCube library
• Metadata is automatically resolved - no more guessing with cryptic file names
Personalized Recommendations:
• Discover relevant new papers based on your library or lists – you’ll never miss another important paper again!
Stay organized:
• Create custom lists and sort articles into one or multiple lists
• Quickly search your entire library (and all annotations)
• Add any number of #tags to further customize your library organization
• Sync everything – papers, notes, highlights – between the ReadCube desktop and web apps or your other mobile devices
Simplify your research life – try ReadCube for free on your iPhone, iPad, and computer.
We love feedback from our users - please email support@readcube.com with any suggestions or issues. Thanks for using ReadCube!

bluejetty:00016494:ios.description:
Headbands is the charades party game that turns any get-together into a comedy show. Hold the phone to your forehead and guess the word.
A TOP 20 WORD & CARD GAME in the USA, Canada, UK, Australia, and many more countries, loved by players with 4.6 stars from 56,000+ ratings. Thank you!
HOW TO PLAY
Hold the phone to your forehead. Everyone else sees the word, but you don't. They act it out, describe it, sing it, or dance it while you guess. Got it? Tilt your head down for a new word. Stuck? Tilt up to pass. Racing the clock too stressful? Turn the timer off and play at your own pace.
MORE THAN GUESSING
Pick your challenge type: acting, dancing, singing, sketching, describing, and more. Every round is different: charades, drawing games, and karaoke chaos in one app.
FEATURES
• Game Center achievements & leaderboards: compete with friends and the world
• Create your own decks, or let AI build a custom deck for you in seconds
• Play with 2 players or a party of 100+
• Play remotely over FaceTime
• Record your gameplay and share the funniest moments
• Timer on or off – you decide
• Sounds & haptic feedback (vibration)
• New and updated decks added regularly
95+ DECKS, 5,500+ WORDS
The English edition offers 95+ decks with over 5,500 words and phrases. Headbands is fully localized into 8 languages (English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Polish, Czech, Slovak), each language with its own culturally adapted decks. Popular decks include:
• Act It Out
• Animals
• Movie Characters
• Songs from the 60s to the 00s
• And lots more!
Some decks are free; additional decks are available via in-app purchase.
PERFECT FOR EVERY OCCASION
Family game night, birthday parties, road trips, sleepovers, holidays, team-building icebreakers, or a spontaneous round over FaceTime. No board, no cards to lose, no setup: one phone (or a video call) is all you need.
If you're looking for the best charades app, a heads-up style guessing game, or a party game for friends and family, near or far, download Headbands today and start guessing!
