bluejetty:00121116:ios.description:
UNLIMITED MUSIC SOURCES
• Stream millions of tracks from Spotify, Beatport & SoundCloud Go+
• Access your tracks locally or via iCloud, Dropbox & Google Drive
• Import tracks in all major formats (mp3, mp4, aac, flac, wav, aiff, ogg) 
• Enjoy a carefully crafted selection of 20+ exclusive MIXVIBES tracks
• Get intelligent track suggestions in real time based on what you're playing 
• Organize your library by title, artist, album, bpm, key, rating or duration
• Create your own custom playlists and view your set history
• Use Smart Automix for smooth, uninterrupted sets
MIX & PERFORM LIVE
• Sync, loop, cue, and scratch with zero latency
• Professional 2-deck layout with responsive touch controls
• Shape your sound with 30+ pro-grade audio FX
• A powerful sampler with 40+ one-shots, 40+ loops from 10+ sample packs
• Customize your decks with full artworks or 26 color themes to match your style
• Add vinyl markers to enhance your dj scratch control
• Learn mixing basics with simple video tutorials
• Portrait mode support for easy one-handed mixing
• Zoomable waveforms for accurate beatmatching
• Hot cues, quantize mode, slip mode, and loop control
• Record your mix & share it with the world!
HIGH-QUALITY AUDIO ENGINE
• Ultra-precise BPM detection and key analysis for perfect mixes
• Change the tempo of a track without affecting its pitch using keylock
• Auto-sync to lock your beats instantly
• Auto-gain for seamless level matching
• Realistic vinyl scratching with inertia control
ADVANCED DJ TOOLS
• Full 3-band mixer with DJM-style EQ curves
• Loops from 1/32 to 32 beats with beat-locked timing
• Manual pitch range (4–100%) and pitch bend for tight control
• Record, import and trigger your own samples for live remixing
• Pre-cue tracks in your headphones using split mono or dual stereo outputs
• Isolate vocals, drums, or instruments with one tap
HARDWARE INTEGRATION
• Native support for popular MIDI controllers, including:
DDJ-FLX2, DDJ-FLX4, DJControl Mix, DJControl Mix Ultra, DJControl Starlight, DJControl Inpulse 200 MK2, DJControl Inpulse 300 MK2, DJControl Inpulse 500, U-Mix Control Pro
• USB audio interface and external mixer support for pro setups
• Ableton Link for tight sync with other apps and hardware
WHAT PROS SAY ABOUT CROSS DJ
"The best free DJ app" - Mixmag
"Quality app" - Digital DJ Tips
"Beautiful design & faster performance" - DJ TechTools
"Clean, simple, professional look & feel" - Best-dj-software.com
PREMIUM PLANS & PURCHASES
The optional PRO subscription unlocks all Cross DJ Pro features with a single subscription across iOS and Mac, including access to exclusive tracks, premium sample packs, and pro-grade FX.

bluejetty:00016615:ios.developer: Global Good Music Multimedia Co., Ltd.
bluejetty:00016615:ios.summary:
KaraDoReMi is an innovative song learning and karaoke mobile application using YouTube. Bring amazing song learning and karaoke experiences to users.
Innovative features include:
1. Using YouTube video to learn songs and singing performanc
bluejetty:00016615:ios.description:
KaraDoReMi is an innovative song learning and karaoke mobile application using YouTube. Bring amazing song learning and karaoke experiences to users.
Innovative features include:
1. Using YouTube video to learn songs and singing performance including pitch and singing skills such as portamento and vibrato can be evaluated in real time
2. Song learning by song structure: We analyze songs and present to you their structures such as verse, chorus, etc. to help you understand the constitution of a song. Learning by song structure makes you learning to sing a song more quickly and easily. You can also learn to sing only those structures that you are not good at repeatedly
3. In-depth singing performance analysis: Our unique and powerful scoring engine can accurately evaluate your singing performance. Our powerful singing analysis function combines line chart of scores by each line of song lyrics and graph of your vocal pitch and original singer's vocal pitch to help you quickly pinpoint your weakness of singing. And then you can practice those lines of song lyrics repeatedly by singing along with YouTube video
4. Vibrato Skill Challenge: Test your limits through our fun, gamified combo mode to precisely master professional techniques. Elevate your vocal control now, climb to the peak of the leaderboard, and earn your glory
5. Customize your training with Continuous Practice Songbook! Focus on specific song structures like ”Verse“ or ”Chorus“ with Autoplay for a seamless, SVIP-exclusive practice workflow.
Other key features include:
1. Global single song leaderboard: upload your proud recordings and show up your learning and singing results to the world
2. My Songbook: create your own songbooks. You can quickly pick one of your songbooks that best fits your mood, place, and special days to learn or sing
3. Editor's Choice: No idea what to sing? Our editors prepare various kinds of song lists such as Hot Songs From Tik Tok, Hits of the World, J-pop, K-pop, etc. to help you find songs to learn and sing
If you need any help or you want to sing and learn songs that are not on KaraDoReMi, please go to KaraDoReMi Facebook fan page https://www.facebook.com/karadoremi to private message us! (In App: My Profile -> Settings)
Terms of Use: https://legal.karadoremi.net/terms/terms.html

bluejetty:00022520:ios.description:
Retrouvez le meilleur de Pronosoft dans cette application et destinée aux parieurs qui souhaitent préparer leurs pronostics avec le maximum d'informations en main !
Nous vous proposons nos pronostics sur toutes les grilles Loto Sports®, Loto Foot®, Loto Rugby® et Loto Basket® (marques déposées de la FDJ®), ainsi que sur l'ensemble des matches de l'offre ParionsSport® (marque déposée de la FDJ®).
En plus de nos pronostics, vous apprécierez les historiques et classements de chaque équipe. Vous préparerez ainsi vos jeux (sous forme de Flashcodes de validation) de la meilleure des façons possible et vous pourrez suivre les résultats de vos pronos en temps réel (dans l'application ou par l'intermédiaire de notifications pushs).
Des bilans détaillés sur vos jeux (nombre de pronos, bénéfices, ROI) sont proposés avec des classifications par sport, compétition, type de pari... Ces bilans sont générés automatiquement et vous aideront à vous améliorer en vous dévoilant vos forces et vos faiblesses.
EXCLUSIF : rejoignez TeamProno, le 1er réseau social de parieurs directement intégré dans votre application de paris. Suivez les meilleurs parieurs de la communauté, partagez vos paris, réagissez aux pronostics proposés et appréciez les plus beaux tickets gagnants ! Déjà des milliers d'utilisateurs !
Top Tickets
- Chaque semaine, retrouvez les plus beaux tickets réalisés par nos membres
- Soumettez-nous vos tickets gagnants en vue d'une éventuelle publication
Section LS
- Pronostics, grilles officielles, pactoles
- Livescore, tous les buts en direct et estimations des rapports en temps réel (avec notifications push)
- Résultats et Rapports officiels
- Estimateur de rapports
- Répartition 1N2 des parieurs au concours
Section PS
- Liste des matches, cotes, évolution de cotes et pronostics avec analyses détaillées
- Météo prévisionnelle et diffusion chaîne télé
- Résultats (et scores) pour tous les paris 1N2
- Résultats en direct et notifications pushs à chaque changement de score
- Compositions probables, officielles, statistiques live et commentaires live
- Filtrage par sport (Football, Rugby, Basketball, Tennis...)
- Tri des matches par compétition ou par jour/horaire
- Choisissez vos matches favoris pour retrouver rapidement les cotes et résultats
- Retrouvez les pronostics du jour (Tickets Pronosoft)
Mentions Légales : https://appli.pronosoft.com/pronosoft/mentions_legales_appli.htm
RGPD : https://appli.pronosoft.com/pronosoft/rgpd_ios.htm

bluejetty:00129664:ios.summary: Al Mashhad is a television channel and an interactive digital platform that brings together the power of live broadcasting with the flexibility of modern digital media, with a strong focus on delivering news in a fast, accurate, and contemp
bluejetty:00129664:ios.description:
Al Mashhad is a television channel and an interactive digital platform that brings together the power of live broadcasting with the flexibility of modern digital media, with a strong focus on delivering news in a fast, accurate, and contemporary way. The app provides a unique experience through innovative short-form videos that combine information with entertainment, presenting major events in a simple, engaging, and quick format that fits the pace of daily life. This makes staying updated with the latest news easier, more accessible, and highly interactive.
تطبيق "المشهد" هو منصة إخبارية تجمع بين قوة البث التلفزيوني ومرونة الإعلام الرقمي، ليمنح المستخدم تجربة متكاملة في متابعة أخبار اليوم وأخبار العالم بأسلوب سريع، دقيق، ومواكب لكل جديد. من خلال التطبيق الإخباري يمكن للمستخدم الوصول بسهولة إلى محتوى متنوع يشمل السياسة والاقتصاد والفن والتكنولوجيا والرياضة، مع تجربة مشاهدة الفيديوهات القصيرة والمحتوى التفاعلي.
يقدّم التطبيق طريقة عصرية لمتابعة أخبار اليوم عبر فيديوهات قصيرة مبتكرة تجمع بين المعلومة والترفيه، وتساعد المستخدم على فهم أهم التطورات بسرعة ووضوح. كما يوفّر تغطية مستمرة للأخبار العاجلة مع تحديثات فورية تبقي المستخدم على اطلاع دائم بما يحدث محليًا وإقليميًا ودوليًا. ويجعل هذا التطبيق الإخباري متابعة الأخبار أكثر سهولة، خصوصًا لمن يبحث عن السرعة والدقة في آن واحد.
يوفّر تطبيق "المشهد" تغطية واسعة لأهم الملفات والأحداث، بداية من أخبار العالم والأخبار العاجلة، وصولًا إلى الأخبار العربية والمحلية التي تهم الجمهور يوميًا. ويشمل ذلك متابعة مستمرة لأهم الأخبار من بينها أخبار مصر وأخبار العراق وأخبار سوريا ضمن تغطية شاملة ترصد المستجدات السياسية والاقتصادية والاجتماعية والثقافية، مع تقديم المحتوى بطريقة واضحة ومباشرة تناسب اهتمامات المستخدم العربي.
ويعزّز تطبيق "المشهد" قيمة التجربة من خلال البرامج التحليلية والمحتوى الرقمي الذي يقدمه إعلاميون وخبراء وصنّاع محتوى، حيث يتم تناول القضايا المهمة بعمق ووضوح. كما يتيح التطبيق التفاعل مع الأخبار عبر وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، لتصبح متابعة الأخبار العاجلة أكثر حيوية وقربًا من المستخدم، مع أخبار المنوعات ضمن التغطية اليومية المستمرة.
مميزات تطبيق "المشهد":
تطبيق إخباري يجمع بين البث المباشر والمحتوى الرقمي
متابعة سريعة ودقيقة لأحدث الأخبار
تغطية شاملة ومستمرة لأخبار العالم
تحديثات لحظية لأهم الأخبار العاجلة
متابعة مخصصة لملفات مثل أخبار مصر وأخبار العراق وأخبار سوريا
فيديوهات قصيرة تجمع بين المعلومة والترفيه
محتوى سياسي واقتصادي وفني ورياضي وتقني
تجربة استخدام سهلة وسريعة تناسب جميع الفئات

وفي الجانب الرياضي، يوفّر تطبيق "المشهد" تغطية متكاملة لأهم البطولات والأندية، إلى جانب الأخبار الاقتصادية والفنية والتقنية، ما يجعله منصة شاملة لكل من يريد متابعة أخبار اليوم في مكان واحد. كما يتيح التطبيق للمستخدم تخصيص اهتماماته، سواء كان يفضّل أخبار العالم أو الأخبار المحلية أو الملفات المتخصصة، ليصل إلى المحتوى الذي يناسبه بسرعة أكبر.
يوفّر تطبيق "المشهد" تغطية شاملة ومستمرة لأهم الأخبار الرياضية التي تهم الجمهور العربي، مع متابعة يومية لأبرز البطولات المحلية والعالمية. ويمكن للمستخدم الوصول بسهولة إلى أخبار كرة القدم العالمية وآخر أخبار كرة القدم لحظة بلحظة، إلى جانب متابعة أخبار لاعبي كرة القدم وما يرتبط بهم من انتقالات، إصابات، تصريحات، وأبرز اللقطات داخل وخارج الملاعب. كما يقدّم التطبيق تغطية خاصة لأكبر الأندية العالمية مثل أخبار ريال مدريد وأخبار برشلونة وأخبار ليفربول، بالإضافة إلى متابعة قوية لمنافسات الدوري السعودي وما يشهده من تطورات مستمرة، مع محتوى مخصص حول أخبار الهلال وأخبار النصر وأخبار الاتحاد السعودي. ولمحبّي الكرة العربية، يوفّر التطبيق أيضًا متابعة دقيقة لأحداث الدوري المصري وأبرز مستجدات أخبار نادي الزمالك وأخبار الاهلي، ليبقى المستخدم قريبًا من كل مباراة، وكل خبر جديد، وكل لحظة حاسمة في عالم الرياضة.

يوفّر تطبيق "المشهد" تغطية شاملة ومستمرة لأهم الأخبار الرياضية التي تهم الجمهور العربي، مع متابعة يومية لأبرز البطولات المحلية والعالمية. ويمكن للمستخدم الوصول بسهولة إلى أخبار كرة القدم العالمية وآخر أخبار كرة القدم لحظة بلحظة، إلى جانب متابعة أخبار لاعبي كرة القدم وما يرتبط بهم من انتقالات، إصابات، تصريحات، وأبرز اللقطات داخل وخارج الملاعب. كما يقدّم التطبيق تغطية خاصة لأكبر الأندية العالمية مثل أخبار ريال مدريد وأخبار برشلونة وأخبار ليفربول، بالإضافة إلى متابعة قوية لمنافسات الدوري السعودي وما يشهده من تطورات مستمرة، مع محتوى مخصص حول أخبار الهلال وأخبار النصر وأخبار الاتحاد السعودي. ولمحبّي الكرة العربية، يوفّر التطبيق أيضًا متابعة دقيقة لأحداث الدوري المصري وأبرز مستجدات أخبار نادي الزمالك وأخبار الاهلي، ليبقى المستخدم قريبًا من كل مباراة، وكل خبر جديد، وكل لحظة حاسمة في عالم الرياضة.

bluejetty:00186790:ios.description:
Top-selling dictionary apps since 2008 • Every translation you need plus verb conjugations in all tenses • No internet connection required.
"For serious language students and translators who are looking for more precision." - The New York Times
Featured by Apple as "What's Hot" and "Staff Favorite"
"It is a very easy to use, tremendously helpful and valuable addition for learning the language and traveling. I have found it a pleasure to use and it has exceeded my expectations in every way and has not yet let me down in any way. A terrific app."
"I bought this dictionary in August 2010, and six months later in February 2011 I still use this Ultralingua dictionary daily. I am majoring in French and I find this dictionary very accurate and helpful. $19.99 may seem more than other French dictionaries out there, but this one is great because it doesn't require an Internet connection and it provides thousands of words. I highly recommend this dictionary."
Ultralingua makes apps for people who love languages. Our French-English dictionary has all the definitions and translations you need, along with extra features that help you get the most out of the dictionary.
The verb conjugation tool has complete conjugations for thousands of verbs in all standard forms, and the number translator converts numerals into French or English text instantly.
DICTIONARY:
• Over 80,000 entries with more than 125,000 translations
• Tap-and-hold any word or phrase and choose "Speak" from the popup menu to hear that word spoken using Apple's built-in text-to-speech feature.
• Noun genders
• Slang, technical language, and regional differences in spelling and usage
• Hundreds of usage notes about troublesome constructions
• Smart search finds results in case you misspell or mistype
• Search-as-you-go displays words and narrows your selection as you type
VERBS:
• Conjugations for thousands of French and English verbs
• Includes all standard tenses and forms
• Smart search finds root words and catches misspellings
• Must-have reference tool for any student or language professional
• Conjugate a verb from the dictionary results by tapping it
MORE:
• Translate numerals into French and English text with the number tool
• Language swapper button to switch from French-English to English-French
• Tap the history button to view the 50 most recent dictionary definitions, verb conjugations, and more in one place. Sort the list alphabetically or by date, and choose to clear the list completely or delete one entry at a time.
• No internet connection required
• Change your device settings to view the app display in English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, or German
This universal app will run on iPad, iPhone, and iPod touch, so you can purchase it once and load it onto all your devices. The iPad and iPhone/iPod touch versions look and behave differently to give you a great experience on every device you own. The interface will change, but you’ll always have the same outstanding language data and tools inside.
Dictionaries are available from Ultralingua for many languages, including combinations of English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, German, and more. See what else we have to offer by searching for Ultralingua in the App Store.

bluejetty:00076514:ios.description:
Make Memories and Meaningful Connections with 21 Questions!
Looking for a fun way to spark conversations, break the ice, and deepen relationships with your friends, family, or partner? 21 Questions is the card game app designed to bring people closer through thoughtful questions and conversation.
With over 15 unique decks, the app offers a wide range of questions and topics, from lighthearted fun to deep and introspective discussions. Whether you’re planning a road trip, a gathering, or a quiet night in, there’s a deck for every occasion.
Deck Highlights:
- Couples: Discover, laugh, and connect on a deeper level with your partner.
- Pregame: Get your group together and start the fun.
- Ice Breaker: Perfect for getting to know new friends or colleagues.
- Do You Know Me: Test how well your partner or friends truly know you.
- King’s Cup: Classic group game with fun challenges and rules.
- Would You Rather: Choose between tough, funny, or unexpected scenarios.
- Deep Convos: Go beyond the surface with thought-provoking and nostalgic questions.
- Controversial: Share opinions and start friendly debates.
- Me or You: Who’s more likely to? Let the conversation begin!
- Road Trip: Make long drives memorable with engaging questions.
- Name Game: A quick-fire round of creativity and laughs.
Why Choose 21 Questions?
- Versatile Entertainment: Ideal for gatherings, road trips, cozy nights in, or even team-building at work.
- Build Deeper Connections: Strengthen bonds with your loved ones or explore new perspectives.
- Fun for Everyone: From playful to thoughtful and nostalgic, there’s something for every group.
- Hours of Play: With such a wide variety of decks, you’ll never run out of things to talk about.
Whether you enjoy conversation games, thought-provoking questions, or friendly debates, 21 Questions has you covered.
Perfect For:
- Couples looking to strengthen their relationship
- Friends wanting to laugh and learn more about each other
- Family game nights that create lasting memories
- Road trips that turn every mile into a meaningful journey
Explore, laugh, and connect. With fun and thoughtful questions, every round of 21 Questions will leave you with memorable moments.
Ready to take your conversations to the next level? Download 21 Questions now!

Privacy Policy: https://21questions.app/privacy.html

Plan journeys, sharpish
Search for stations and find your way using the world’s fastest route planner
No internet? No problem
Maps and journey planning even work offline
Regular map updates
Auto-magic updates keep our maps always up-to-date and box fresh
Every step of the way
A step-by-step guide means you’ll never get lost again
Save your faves
From finding your way back home to taking the stress out of commuting and all the places in between. Your personal Shortcuts are never more than a swipe away
See the next trains
Departure Boards take the guesswork out of traveling. No more wasted time stuck on crowded platforms
Madrid Metro Premium features:
An ad-free experience
Proper VIP treatment, with no ads, ever
Priority support
Problem with the app? We’ll be there to help you out

bluejetty:00178069:ios.summary:

ASWB Tes
bluejetty:00178069:ios.description:
ASWB Test Prep 2026 is an exam preparation application that will help you pass the social work licensing examinations developed and maintained by the Association of Social Work Boards (ASWB) with high scores on your first attempt.
ASWB Test Prep 2026 will not only help you gain insight into the concepts associated with social work licensing exam preparation, but will also help you increase your confidence in passing the exam on your first attempt by practicing hundreds of exam-like questions.
You can currently use this app to prepare for your Bachelor of Social Work (BSW) Exam, The Master of Social Work (MSW) Exam and The Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) Exam.
### Pass the exam on the first try ###
In ASWB Test Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the scope of the official exam requirements. According to the exam requirements, you must master all subjects in order to successfully pass the ASWB exam. 
Specifically, the subjects include:
- Human Development, Diversity, and Behavior in the Environment
- AssessmentAssessment & Intervention Planning
- Interventions with Clients/Client Systems
- Professional Relationships, Values, and Ethics
To help you pass the exam, our exam experts have carefully analyzed and broken down the above subjects. You'll need to practice all 4 subjects that will help you pass the exam with confidence!
### Key Features ###
- Over 1000 practice questions with detailed answer explanations for each question
- Specialized practice by content area with the flexibility to switch between them at any time
- View analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the ASWB exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that every time you practice in ASWB Test Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam will increase, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions while hinting to yourself to do the same tomorrow. After you have developed good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high on not only the ASWB, but any other exam!
### Purchases, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://aswb.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://aswb.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html
Please let us know if you have any questions or comments about your use by emailing us at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 business days at the latest.

Prime is an easy and powerful way to play back all of your multitracks, loops and click tracks in worship  or rehearsal.


GENERAL FEATURES:
• Change the Key of any song
• Change the Tempo of any song
• Customize Song Arrangements (easy drag and drop)
• Unlimited Tracks Mixer: Adjust the volume, mute and solo
• Multi-Out: With iOS Compatible Audio Interfaces
• Auto-Pan: Click and Cues are panned LEFT, Instrument Tracks are panned RIGHT
• Preview songs in full stereo or panned
• Waveform: Displayed for each song
• Create and Save Setlists
• Add a Click Track Metronome to any setlist
• Click Sounds: Choose from 5 different metronome sounds
• Cue Voices: English, Spanish & Portuguese
• Dark theme option


PLAYBACK CONTROLS
• Song Sections: Let you see where in the song you are!
• Section Looping: Loop and repeat any section
• Infinite Loop: Loop a section 1 time or infinitely
• Section Jumping: Jump in time spontaneously to different sections of the song
• Jump Time: Choose when Section Jumping takes place (end of section, after 1 bar, after 2 bars)
• Transitions: Crossfade, Auto-Advance, Overlap and more!
• Set Start / End Times: Trim the beginning and end of a song
• Set Fade Out: Add a fade out to the end of a song
• Auto-Fade In and Out Button


MIDI INTEGRATION
• Map any MIDI controller to various app functions
• MIDI Integration with the Looptimus USB Controller
• Control master volume with a MIDI expression pedal
• Map individual songs sections and looping functions to a controller
• MIDI Out: Send Program Changes, Control Changes and Notes over MIDI Network to control Lyrics, Lighting and more!


PRIME CLOUD
• Import your own audio files with Prime Cloud
• Custom Section Markers: Add your own sections markers to content you upload
• Dynamic Cues: When you change the arrangement of a song, the cues follow you
• Sync and manage setlists between all your devices
• Save custom arrangements to your library
• Share setlists with team members

bluejetty:00141363:ios.summary:
Welcome to Zonder, the first real-world exploration game and digital travel companion!
Zonder lets players earn XP and level up for visiting over 100 million collectable locations like restaurants, shops, parks and landmarks in 150+ countr
bluejetty:00141363:ios.description:
Welcome to Zonder, the first real-world exploration game and digital travel companion!
Zonder lets players earn XP and level up for visiting over 100 million collectable locations like restaurants, shops, parks and landmarks in 150+ countries around the world. Build up your personal Travel Profile with every new country, city and place that you visit - and show off your travel experiences to your friends!
Get ready to turn traveling into a game.
A QUEST TO EXPLORE THE WORLD
Earn XP by visiting interesting locations in 100+ countries, whether it’s the Eiffel Tower or your favorite hole-in-a-wall restaurant. Level up in 9 unique location categories like Food, Nature and Culture to showcase your travel prowess!
You can collect places everywhere you go - It doesn’t matter if you’re going out in your hometown or traveling to a new continent!
Zonder also includes themed challenges - from earning points for supporting your hometown to seeing who has traveled the longest distance, we’re always adding new ways to explore our planet.
HOW TO PLAY
Zonder is a real-world exploration game. To start earning XP, all you have to do is go out and visit places. You can level up for visiting restaurants, bars, parks, museums and more!
The best part? Zonder automatically collects locations for you! With our accurate GPS tracker, there's no manual input needed - just leave your phone in your pocket to continue earning points and keeping track of your travels.
You can choose between playing by yourself and being proud of your accomplishments, or competing with our worldwide community of explorers, tourists and road trippers by visiting as many places as you can.
ALL-IN-ONE TRAVEL COMPANION
You can keep track of everywhere you’ve been with your personal Timeline and visualize your travel progress by building your Travel Profile with every new country, city and location you collect.
But Zonder doesn’t just help you remember the past. It also helps you find the best places to eat, visit, shop, drink and dance with uniquely curated tours for top-rated travel destinations and global cities.
YOUR QUEST IS OUR MISSION
Our mission is to make your travels as fun and exciting as possible by making Zonder the best travel game ever. And that’s what it’s designed to be: a game - not some location data seller.
Unlike many other apps, we won’t share your personal information or location data with anyone. Privacy is extremely important to us because we’re just as tired of having our data sold by companies as you are. Also, we believe that the greatest success comes from creating a genuinely exciting and well-made product, not addictive tactics or pay-to-win cash grabs.
HIGHLIGHTS
• Level up and showcase your experience in 9 different types of places, from Commerce to Knowledge to Nightlife!
• The perfect game for road trips, backpacking, vacation, ecotourism and more
• Find great things to do in 150+ countries!
• Use Zonder as a travel journal to save your best memories.
• Discover the best restaurants, tourist attractions, and scenic views in every city
• Compete with friends and other Explorers to explore more of the world!
• Share your experiences and recommend favorite locations to others
• Enter themed challenges like Support Your Hometown and City Trails
Don’t just travel. Collect the world.

bluejetty:00084713:ios.description:
12Go: Your Travel Companion
The 12Go app is your on-the-go travel agency, offering various means of transportation like trains, buses, boats, transfers, vans, taxis, and flights to your desired destination, both regionally and worldwide. We provide budget travel options in over 70,000 locations across more than 140 countries, including:
Destinations:
Thailand: Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Koh Samui, Koh Phangan, Koh Tao, Pattaya, Phuket, Surat Thani, Chiang Rai, Pai, Koh Phi Phi
Vietnam: Hanoi, Sapa, Ninh Binh, Ho Chi Minh City, Hai Phong, Hue, Da Lat, Ha Giang, Halong Bay
Philippines: Manila, Cebu, Bohol, Coron, El Nido, Baguio, Bicol, Siquijor
Indonesia: Bali, Gili Islands, Sanur, Nusa Penida, Nusa Lembongan, Lombok, Jakarta, Yogyakarta
Japan: Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, Hokkaido, Mount Fuji, Sapporo, Nagoya, Hiroshima
Cambodia: Phnom Penh, Kampot, Siem Reap, Sihanoukville, Koh Rong Samloem
Malaysia: Kuala Lumpur, Penang, Genting Highlands, Malacca, Langkawi, Pahang, Johor Bahru, Batam, Ipoh
Laos, Sri Lanka, Singapore, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Australia, Egypt, Morocco, and many others!
Access the Best Deals:
We partner with over 13,000 travel companies and operators, including Lomprayah, Greenbus, Techbus, Phantip 1970, Roong Reuang Coach, Prem Pracha, Songserm, Vietnam Railways, Indian Railways (IRCTC), Koh Tao Booking Center, Grouptour, Chaokoh Travel Center, Bangkok Busline, Bundhaya Speed Boat, Giant Ibis Transport, Semaya One, Sri Lanka Railways, Transport Co, AirAsia, Sombat Tour, Seatran Discovery, Montanatip, Virak Buntham Express, Eka Jaya, Shinkansen, and many more.
Easy Booking Process:
Select your origin, destination, departure date, return (if round trip), and number of passengers. Click "Find tickets".
Our search results will show you the "Best options" with the best and most popular travel deals. Below, you will find "Other options" sorted by type of transportation. Use filters to set your desired price range, arrival/departure time, stations, and operator.
Choose your preferred deal and click "Book now" to start the checkout process. Fill in your passenger information and select your preferred payment method. Once payment is complete, you will receive your booking confirmation and e-tickets shortly.
Other Services:
Our additional travel services include airport transfers, baggage upgrades, priority support, SMS trip notifications, rail passes, day trips, hotel bookings, and car rentals for most available destinations.
Payment Methods:
Pay via PayPal, credit/debit card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express AMEX), UnionPay, AliPay, bank transfer, QR payments (PromptPay), app wallet (TrueMoney), or your local payment method.
Customer Support:
We provide 24/7 multilingual online support, including live chat through your registered account on 12go.asia via the "Need help?" chat button. You can also ask questions within our app by providing your email and booking number or browse FAQ articles. With over 60,000 trusted reviews from our customers, we strive to be transparent and genuine, ensuring the best possible experience. We are always ready to help you find a fair deal!
Download 12Go now and start planning your next adventure!

bluejetty:00045853:ios.description:
Virginia DMV has officially launched the Virginia Mobile ID. Carrying your ID just got more convenient, more secure and much less stressful. You’ll love the peace of mind of always having your ID by your side.
Virginia Mobile ID is a digital option of a valid state-issued driver's license or ID card. It’s free to obtain and can be set up from anywhere. Your Virginia Mobile ID is a companion to your physical ID, and you’ll still need to carry a physical ID with you. In many cases, it can stay in your wallet, and your phone can do the work of verifying your identity. 
Advancing Virginia DMV's mission of "Always Driving Forward," Virginia Mobile ID is built for today’s digital world. After years of planning and testing, Virginia Mobile ID puts you in control—without compromising security or simplicity.
Key Benefits
Convenient:
• Always with you on your phone
• Fast, contactless and easy to use
• Set up in minutes, from anywhere
• Once downloaded, no cell signal needed
• Free, no cost to download or maintain
• Shows your REAL ID status
• Available soon on all digital wallets
Secure: 
• Built-in security features to keep your identity safe and prevent fraud
• You choose what information to share
• Your data is not stored, tracked or shared
• Unique encryption means screenshots are rejected
• Your phone stays in your hands
The more Virginians download and use Virginia Mobile ID, the more businesses and organizations will start accepting the technology. The future of Virginia Mobile ID is in your hands.

bluejetty:00018219:ios.summary: Paper Calc Office is an easy to use, large key, 4-function calculator tailored for the office environment. Use the powerful paper tape to review numbers you've entered, email, timestamp, put comments on any line, or bring a number from high
bluejetty:00018219:ios.description:
Paper Calc Office is an easy to use, large key, 4-function calculator tailored for the office environment. Use the powerful paper tape to review numbers you've entered, email, timestamp, put comments on any line, or bring a number from higher in the paper tape down into the current calculation.
=================
Selected by MagicSolver for Free App Magic of the day!
Selected by AppTurbo for Free "App of the Day" !
=================
Make the keys larger by sliding the LCD display up, or show more paper tape by moving the LCD display down. Two keyboards are included, or, make & save up to three of your own.
PaperCalc Office Features:
CALCULATOR MODE
=================
> Great general purpose office calculator
> Oversized +, -, x, /, = keys
> 3 display formats
. - fixed Point from 2-8 places
. - float
. - eng (power to the x3)
VIRTUAL PAPER TAPE
==================
> 250 lines of virtual paper tape
> Full-screen view of the paper tape on the right-side scroll page.
> Copy numbers or lines to the Apple clipboard
> Grab numbers from the tape to use in your current calculation
> Add comments to any line
> Double tap the calculator's LCD display to clear the paper tape.
PRINT & EMAIL
=============
> Print (requires iOS4.2 & an AirPrint printer) 
> Email an exact copy of the paper tape
EXTRAS
=======
> Move the calculator's LCD display to resize the keyboard.
> Create and save custom keyboard layouts to suit your personal needs.
> Key click sound (on/off)
> Hide rows of keys for extra paper tape space.
> Options are easy-to-access in the scroll-to-left view window.
> International number formatting (Settings -> General -> International -> Region Format -> select region)
Q & A:
=====
Q1. How does 'Office' differ from the other PaperCalc calculators?
A1. 'Office' has been designed as an easy to use chain calculator with basic math functions. The emphasis is on ease-of-use and an easy-to-follow paper trail of calculations performed.
Q2. How do I bring a number from the paper tape into my current calculation?
A2. Touch any line of the paper tape and select the number from the menu.
Q3. How can I quickly clear the paper tape?
A3. Make sure the option to 'Double Tap the LCD to Clear' is ON (see the right-side scroll page). Then just double-tap the LCD display to clear the paper tape (Office Full version only)
Q4. How do I use the '%' key?
A4. There are two ways to use the % key:
1. Obtain the % of a number:
- Press '200 % 5 ='
- Answer will be '10'
- PaperCalc took 5% of 200.
2. The % of a number is used in the operation on the number: 
- Press: '200 - 5 % ='
- Answer will be '190'
- PaperCalc subtracted 5% of 200 from 200
Q5. How do I customize the keyboard layout?
A5. Press the large "i" (info) key. Select "Edit Keyboard Layout". Then touch and move keys to change locations. Tap keys to change sizes. Save custom keyboard layouts and rename them for later use.
Q6. How do I hide the top row of keys for additional Paper Tape space?
A6. Just touch and move the Calculator's LCD display until the keyboard background flashes red. Release the LCD and the keys will remain hidden.
PURCHASE DETAILS
. Payment will be charged to your iTunes
 account at confirmation of purchase.
. This is a one-time purchase.
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
Your use of this application is governed by Interlocken Technology's Terms of Use (http://s354819480.onlinehome.us/InterlockenPrivacyPolicy/Interlocken%20Technology%20Privacy%20Policy.pdf) and Privacy Policy (http://s354819480.onlinehome.us/InterlockenPrivacyPolicy/InterlockenTechnologyTermsOfUse.pdf)

Ever thought about enhancing your podcast listening experience? This has been our obsession for the past two years – to develop a unique experience that competes with the world's most renowned applications. After countless experiments and numerous postponed deadlines, we proudly introduce Radio thmanyah.
We've been crafting podcasts at thmanyah since 2016, we understand the global market and the challenges podcast creators and listeners struggle with.
Believing that our capabilities extend beyond content creation alone, we ventured into tech to continue our journey of innovation and create the ultimate podcast listening experience. We hope you enjoy it as much as we do, Here’s a glance on Radio thmanyah’s key features:
- The Square: Tired of the same old top charts? Discover fresh, curated content in The Square, based on recommendations from your network. Or express your thoughts on any episode you've listened to.
- Import from Any App: We understand that migrating to a new app can be daunting. That's why we've streamlined the process of moving your library from any podcast app to Radio thmanyah.
- Listen Without Music: Catering to a widespread preference in our Arab region for music-free listening, We developed an AI model that separates music from any podcast episode worldwide, giving you the choice.
- Editorial picks: Our team of podcast enthusiasts is dedicated to curating playlists tailored to your interests, ensuring there's something interesting you can listen to at every part of your day.
- The Queue: Never miss a scheduled episode again. Just add it to your queue, and we'll ensure it's downloaded and ready for listening whenever you want.
- Bookmarks: Ever come across a podcast episode you're not sure about but still want to keep it handy? That's where the "Bookmarks" feature comes in. 
- Episode Comments: Hesitant about listening to an episode? You can check out user comments before diving in.
- Smart Auto-Downloads: Whether you're on a tight data plan or running low on device storage, we've got you covered. Optimize your downloads to conserve data, storage space, or none. And enjoy a seamless, smooth experience
- Over 4 Million Podcasts: Explore countless podcasts from around the globe, all in one place, with an experience tailored specifically for podcast enthusiasts.

If a business you frequent uses SpotOn, this is the app for you. Whether you're buying coffee, new kicks or an oil change, use the Spo
bluejetty:00156811:ios.description:
Go cardless with SpotOn Mobile for consumers. It's one little app that'll give you thousands of rewards.
If a business you frequent uses SpotOn, this is the app for you. Whether you're buying coffee, new kicks or an oil change, use the SpotOn app to find your new favorite local businesses. 
Never dig through your wallet for a loyalty card again. With the SpotOn app, just point your phone at the tablet when you check out to earn a Spot. You'll never miss out on Spots again! 
With SpotOn, you can do the following:
- Check-in, earn and redeem Spots towards discounts and free items at businesses you love
- Track your rewards progress at multiple locations, simultaneously
- Find new local businesses near you
- Get notified about new offers from your favorite businesses
- Read reviews from Yelp, Facebook, Google, and TripAdvisor, all in one place
- Easy sign in 
-------What's new?-------
We've updated the app to give it a whole new look. And, we added some cool new features.
Easy sign in: There's no need to remember a password or pin anymore! Just verify your email and we'll log you into the app so you can start earning rewards right away.
Reviews: Now you can learn about a business without leaving the app or going to multiple review sites. We'll show you reviews from Yelp, Trip Advisor, Google, and Facebook, all in one app. 
Faster check-ins: We added another, faster way to check in. Simply save your phone number to your customer profile and use it at the SpotOn tablet when you check in. 
Discovery: Find businesses near you by searching for category, location, or name. There's even a map so that you can see exactly where the business is located.

bluejetty:00167581:android.description:
Welcome to Waste Collector, the ultimate game where fun meets responsibility! In this engaging and addictive app, you take control of a waste-collecting truck, navigating through roads to gather waste. Every piece of waste you collect earns you points.
But Waste Collector is more than just a game—it's a mission. In every drive, you contribute to keeping the roads clean, emphasizing the importance of cleanliness in our everyday lives. By collecting waste, you’re not only earning points but also promoting a cleaner and greener planet.
Roads filled with waste are not only an eyesore but also a hazard to health and nature. Through Waste Collector, you get to experience the importance of waste management firsthand. Every piece of trash you pick up in the game symbolizes a real-world action that contributes to the well-being of our planet.
Join the mission to make the world a cleaner place. Download Waste Collector now and start your journey towards a cleaner, greener future—one road at a time!

Have fun and stimulate the brain with the smart games of Kid-E-Cats! Edujoy presents a collection of more than 15 fun games for children from 2 to 6 years old to work on different cognitive skills and stimulate creativity.

- Memorize elements and sequences
- Discriminate objects and find the intruder
- Compose music and melodies
- Classify objects by color and shape
- Visual acuity games
- Match words and colors
- Classic games like maze or dominoes
- Logical reasoning puzzles
- Sum of numbers

FEATURES
- Educational and interactive games
- Designs and characters from the tv series
- Fun animations and sounds
- Easy and intuitive interface for kids
- Stimulates imagination and creativity
- Helps stimulate fine motor skills
- Created in collaboration with experts in early childhood education
- Completely free game
ABOUT EDUJOY
Thank you very much for playing Edujoy games. We love creating fun and educational games for kids of all ages. If you have any questions or suggestions about Kid-E-Cats - Learning Games, you can contact us through the contact of the developer or our profiles on social networks:

• Dual Camera — record both front and back camera at the same time.

• Rearrange or remove video segments for a smooth, seamless video.
• Enjoy high quality video output.

• Add Accurate Subtitles: Use cutting-edge AI for a synchronized transcript of your videos. 
• Magic Jumpcuts: Automatically remove mute sections or gaps in your videos.
• Crop Tool: Size your videos to finger-tip perfection on many platforms.
• Manage Video Segments: Reorder or delete parts with user-friendly controls.

bluejetty:00069387:ios.summary: Welcome to my ‘Renault Radio Code’ app. This app is, and always will be, free. I strongly believe that you should be able to unlock and use your own personal radio without spending money on apps to tell you the code. If you like this app or
bluejetty:00069387:ios.description:
Welcome to my ‘Renault Radio Code’ app. This app is, and always will be, free. I strongly believe that you should be able to unlock and use your own personal radio without spending money on apps to tell you the code. If you like this app or appreciate that I am not charging you for this information, please consider leaving a review on the App Store to let others know that this is the real deal :)
To use this app you will firstly need the security code.
There are 2 ways to get this code:
Method 1
If your radio is still unlocked, press button 1 and 6 at the same time. This will display a code such as Q123.
Method 2
The code can be found on side or back of your radio. A special tool may be required. Ask at your local automobile parts supplier and follow the instructions carefully.
To find the code, you will need to remove the radio unit from the dashboard to locate the 4 digit code. This can be found before the word ‘Security’. For example, it might say ‘Q123-Security’. By entering that code into this app, it will generate your radio code.
Once you have reinstalled the radio back into the car, you will be asked a 4 number code to enable the radio.
Take the 4 numbers, that were generated in this app, and enter it. This will instantly unlock your radio.
There are 3 ways to enter your radio code:
Buttons
Press button 1 repeatedly to enter the 1st digit.
Press button 2 repeatedly to enter the 2nd digit.
Press button 3 repeatedly to enter the 3rd digit.
Press button 4 repeatedly to enter the 4th digit.
Press and hold button 5 or 6 for 10 seconds to confirm.
Stalk controls
Turn the dial to enter each number. 
Press the bottom button to move to next number.
Press and hold button to confirm.
Remote control
Press the  ¬ button to turn the dial to enter the numbers
Press and hold the button to confirm.
Note
This will only work in the following circumstances:
- You have not already entered a code too many times, locking you out.
- You enter the ‘Radio Code to enter’ code correctly into a Renault radio.
I will not be held responsible for the following (but not limited to) incidents:
- A code is entered incorrectly, causing a lockout/ bricking
- A code is entered in to a 3rd party radio, causing lockout/ bricking
- You don’t like the user interface of this app.
Happy repairing.

bluejetty:00042273:ios.description:
Make Dynamic Island (Live Activities), Home Screen, and Lock Screen widgets more useful and personal.
See network speed, health data, countdowns, delivery progress, to-dos, Pomodoro timers, weather, and more without repeatedly opening the app. You can also launch apps, websites, and Shortcuts from supported widgets.
The experience is completely ad-free. Selected features are available for free; membership unlocks more advanced widgets, Dynamic Island experiences, and personalization options. Availability varies by device, system version, and Apple's refresh policies.
【Key Highlights】
- Dynamic Island Enhancement: Hundreds of features to make your Dynamic Island truly useful.
- Free to Explore: Selected Home Screen widgets and Dynamic Island features are free; advanced styles and tools can be unlocked as needed.
- Three Unique Widget Styles: Fully transparent, liquid glass, and custom colors.
- Dynamic Data: Updates within Apple's system limits; actual frequency varies by feature, device state, and system scheduling.
- Pure Experience: Completely ad-free, focused on aesthetics and performance.
【Four Core Categories】
Dynamic Island & Geek Tools
- System Monitoring: View network speed, FPS, CPU usage, memory consumption, altitude, and current speed.
- Quick Launch: Open any app, webpage, or run shortcuts directly from Dynamic Island and home screen.
- Screen Time Tracking: Record unlock count and usage duration to help you better manage screen time.
Health & Fitness Companion
- Health Overview: View steps, heart rate, blood oxygen, HRV stress level, body temperature, and environmental noise.
- Activity Data: Running distance, floors climbed, walking speed, step length, and stand time.
- Water Reminder: Log water intake directly in Dynamic Island to build healthy habits.
Productivity & Time Management
- Worker's Best Friend: Precise "work-end countdown" to watch time pass and anticipate the moment you clock out.
- Important Moments: Deadlines, anniversaries, ticket-grab countdowns—never miss any critical milestone.
- Schedule Management: To-do lists, calendar, Pomodoro timer, and notes—all visible at a glance.
Lifestyle & Personalization
- Stock Market: View watchlist and index movements on your Home Screen and Dynamic Island.
- Digital Pet: Adopt an adorable pet in Dynamic Island to accompany you every day.
- Trending Topics & Weather: View trending lists and weather forecasts at a glance.
【Developer Promise】
We are committed to creating the best widget app for iOS!
Continuous updates, high performance, and dedication to exploring every potential of Dynamic Island and home screen widgets.
【Important Notice】
Features that depend on location, such as speed, altitude, or local weather, may require background location access. You can change permissions in Settings at any time; continued location use may increase battery consumption. iOS controls widget and Live Activity refresh timing, so second-by-second updates can't be guaranteed.
【Contact Us】
For any suggestions or feedback, feel free to contact us: xuewei_app@163.com

bluejetty:00159358:ios.name: Meru Health
bluejetty:00159358:ios.summary:
Meru Health is mental health care with continuous support from a licensed therapist, via both video calls and unlimited in-app chat. Mental health doesn't wait for the calendar - neither should your mental health care.
Download today to bo
bluejetty:00159358:ios.description:
Meru Health is mental health care with continuous support from a licensed therapist, via both video calls and unlimited in-app chat. Mental health doesn't wait for the calendar - neither should your mental health care.
Download today to book a call with a therapist and see for yourself.
Continuous care
When you begin the Meru Health program, your licensed Meru Health therapist is available via both scheduled face-to-face video sessions and unlimited, asynchronous chat. It's support built around your life, not someone else's schedule.
Coaching option
The continuous-care model applies to both Meru Health's 12-week therapy program and our 8-week coaching option (see below), which is supported by certified behavioral health coaches. No one wouldn't like to feel better. For some, Meru Health coaching is the best way to achieve that.
Connecting the mind and the body
Mental health isn't just mental. Nutrition, sleep, exercise, and even simple breath directly impact your mental health. With a wearable heart rate sensor and guided breathing exercises, you can see this connection in action and practice relaxation skills.
The Meru Health App
The Meru Health app enhances your care experience with guided, evidence-based lessons and activities that you can do on your own or with support of your therapist or coach.
In-network Insurance Coverage
Meru Health is covered by several health insurance providers and is a free employee benefit with some employers. Cost depends on individual plans, copays, and deductibles. But even the 12-week program is far cheaper than the average cost of 12 weeks of traditional therapy.
Our team will connect with your health plan to determine your cost share, if any.
Proven Outcomes
After program completion, 73% of Meru participants show clinically significant improvement, and 59% are in remission from symptoms of depression or anxiety. This exceeds the 12-week outcomes of traditional approaches to mental health care.
The 12-Week Treatment Program
1. Up to four face-to-face therapy sessions, via video call, plus unlimited support via in-app chat—all with a licensed therapist who will be with you for the duration of the program.
2. Guided in-app lessons and activities to help you recognize your emotions, move past negative thoughts, improve relationships, and the role of sleep and nutrition in mental health.
3. A wearable heart rate sensor that, along with guided breathing practices, helps you see and calm your body's physical response to stress. The mind and the body talk to each other. Meru Health's heart rate variability (HRV) breathing exercises help you listen in. The sensor is a consumer fitness product, used here for relaxation and stress education. The app does not provide a diagnosis based on its readings.
4. Anonymous support and connection from a community of fellow Meru Health participants.
The 8-Week Coaching Program
1. Two face-to-face video sessions with your certified coach, plus unlimited support via in-app chat.
2. Guided in-app activities and lessons to help you develop skills for reducing stress, increasing resilience, and unlocking your best self.
3. Weekly workshops to dive deeper into skills and practices and help lock in the changes you seek.
Participants are reminded to seek a doctor's advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00035360:ios.description:
My buddies and I, after working all day, always would say we looked like Trolls when we were done our shift. Dirty and grubby with messed up hair; it looked like we should be living under a bridge.
Then the Internet came along and made a "Troll" someone that sits behind a keyboard with Cheeto fingers talking smack. We wanted to go against the grain and bring back the Troll that is as tough as nails and never quits.
It’s ok if you don’t want to be a lawyer, dentist or some other type of cube-monkey job. Trades can be very rewarding, pay well and at the end of the day you can stand back and say, “I built that.” 
There are a lot of hard-working men and women in the trades right now, but they are not being replaced fast enough with skilled young people. It’s time to change the mindset that being in the trades is less important than a doctor or lawyer. Support and encourage blue collar jobs; don’t steer our young people away from them.
Download our app today to gear up!

bluejetty:00016784:ios.name: Monster Truck Games! Go Racing
bluejetty:00016784:ios.summary: Drive into excitement and fun with the Monster Truck Games Racing app! If you dig monster truck rally’s and love the stunts the trucks and motorcycles do then you’ll love exploring and enjoy this cool app. With over 30 activities and game
bluejetty:00016784:ios.description:
Drive into excitement and fun with the Monster Truck Games Racing app! If you dig monster truck rally’s and love the stunts the trucks and motorcycles do then you’ll love exploring and enjoy this cool app. With over 30 activities and games you will get to really experience what it feels like to be in a Monster truck jam! This super fun app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play. 
Monster Truck and Motorcycle Driving Games
Come to the Rally and have a blast driving in different creative exciting worlds! And the best part is you can drive a monster truck or motorcycle in each world, and they do different cool things. For example the Monster truck in space can jump over rocks, and the Firetruck Motorcycle can shoot water and put out fires! It’s engaging fun and with every game having unique features it’s a whole new exciting experience for each one. 
Tap Animations
Little fingers love to tap, tap, tap, and these cool Monster truck and Motorcycle tap animations will delight and engage all Monster truck rally fans! With the Tap Animations your little ones will get to make the trucks and motorcycles do the stunts as fast or as slow as they want while hearing a funky tune play. Tapping the screen will take them to the next frame so they are similar to the old comic flip books because the faster you tap the faster the truck or motorcycle does the stunt! It’s engrossing for little ones to see and control the animation and it makes them feel like they are doing the cool stunts themselves! It’s super monster truck rally fun. 
Monster Truck and Motorcycle Puzzle Games
Adding even more fun to the Monster Truck Games Racing app is the puzzle games! Using the same themes as the driving worlds the puzzles delve them further into those worlds by adding different elements that belong to that theme and letting them play with them. With three games for each theme they will get to see loads of dinosaurs, spaceships, police puppies, and of course candy! It's a unique way to have fun with each world and will help their creativity abound.
It’s time to go to the Monster truck rally and have a blast driving, making animations, playing with puzzles and matching. Let your little ones drive into fun and let their imaginations and creativity grow with the Monster Truck Games Racing app!

New to crochet or knitting? Yarn AI makes it easy to begin, explore, and grow your skills—step by step. Whether you’re picking up a hook for the first time or trying to finish your first scarf, this app is your personal crafting guide.

Found a stitch online or in a book? Snap a picture and Yarn AI will help you identify it and recreate it on your own.
Beginner Friendly Pattern Assistant

Smart Suggestions from AI
Looking for inspiration? Get personalized pattern ideas based on your experience level and style. AI can also spot common mistakes and offer quick fixes.
Organize Your Yarn Stash
Keep a record of your yarn collection, from color to weight, so you're always ready to start your next project.
On-Demand Help
Unsure about a term or technique? Ask the built-in AI coach and get instant guidance in simple, beginner-friendly language.
Who It's For:
Complete Beginners – Get clear steps and support without needing to Google every term.
Hobby Makers – Try new stitches, follow curated patterns, and explore crafting games.
Busy Creators – Stay organized and productive with tools that simplify your workflow.
Why Use Yarn AI?
Learn at your own pace with stress-free tools
Discover and try new designs that fit your skill level
Keep everything—from stitches to stash—in one place

bluejetty:00141260:ios.description:
Dominate Every Word Game with Wordfinder by WordTips!
Wordfinder by WordTips is your ultimate companion for Scrabble, Words With Friends, Crosswords, Wordle, New York Times Games like Connections, Crossplay, Capture, Pips, The Crossword, Mini, Midi, Spelling Bee, Letter Boxed, Strands and more. Instantly find the best-scoring words and anagrams, crossword solver, crossword clues, daily hints, and full puzzle solutions. All in one easy-to-use app!
Go Beyond Guessing. Solve Every Puzzle.
Key Features:
- Crossword Solver: Search over 6 million crossword clues to quickly solve even the trickiest crossword puzzles. Just type in your clue and get instant suggestions.
- NYT Games: Wordle, Crossplay, Capture, Pips, Connections, Connections Sport Edition, Strands, Spelling Bee, crossword Mini, Midi crossword and The Crossword.
- Instant Word Search: Quickly discover high-scoring words for Scrabble, Words With Friends, NYT Crossplay, and NYT Capture from your letters using our word finder and anagram solver.
- Daily Puzzle Solutions: Hints and answers for NYT Wordle, Crossplay, Capture, Pips, Connections, Connections Sport Edition, Strands, Spelling Bee, Contexto, Bracket City, Crossword, Crossword Mini, Midi, Blossom, Conexo, Contexto and Betweenle.
- WT Games: Play our Mini Crossword, WordQuest, and more word games directly in the app.
- Advanced Filters: Sort by word length, score, or specific letter patterns.
- Favorites: Save your go-to solvers and games for quick access.
- Official Dictionaries: Supports Scrabble US, Scrabble UK, and Words With Friends dictionaries.
Why Wordfinder by WordTips?
- Fast & Reliable: Get instant results for every game.
- Beginner to Pro: Built for everyone, from casual solvers to word game champions.
- Fun & Multifunctional: Perfect for competition, vocabulary training, or just solving that one stubborn clue.
More Than Just a Word Game Helper:
Wordfinder by WordTips makes word games enjoyable and rewarding, whether you're tackling challenging puzzles, improving your vocabulary, or settling friendly disputes.
Join thousands who use Wordfinder by WordTips every day to sharpen their word skills and dominate puzzles. Whether you're chasing a Spelling Bee Queen Bee, crushing it in NYT Crossplay, or finishing a tricky Letter Boxed, we've got you covered.
Take Your Word Games to the Next Level!
Download Wordfinder by WordTips now and join thousands worldwide who are enhancing their skills and learning with word games.

Privacy Policy:

Backup recordings automatically to your iCloud drive or Google Drive.

Tempo, Pitch, Gain, Noise reduction, Background music

Text to speech support for 38 countries with 54 voices.

Transcribe English speech to text.

Now you can create and manage a sustainable farm of your very own. Tend to crops; raise animals; and craft goods to trade, sell and donate in your local community all the while managing the three pillars of sustainability -- environment, economic and social.

The game may not function properly if you do not have the newest version installed or if you are using an unsupported device. bluejetty:00146018:ios.name: OctoApp for OctoPrint/Klipper
bluejetty:00146018:ios.summary:
OctoApp is build with iOS in mind and is completely optimized for being used on a iPhone or iPad. The app supports OctoPrint and Klipper (Moonraker, Mainsail and Fluidd), Bambu Lab and Elegoo printers.
The UI is structured into three works
bluejetty:00146018:ios.description:
OctoApp is build with iOS in mind and is completely optimized for being used on a iPhone or iPad. The app supports OctoPrint and Klipper (Moonraker, Mainsail and Fluidd), Bambu Lab and Elegoo printers.
The UI is structured into three workspaces: Connect, Prepare, Print. The Connect workspace helps you get your printer connected to OctoPrint and as soon as a printer is available OctoApp will move to the Prepare workspace. Here you can get ready for your next print! Heat your hotend, swap filament or level the bed. When you are ready and start your print, OctoApp shows the Print workspace where you can control and tune your print! 
This concepts allows for a simple and fast UI while not sacrificing on features! 
OctoApp already offers you:
+ Easy print preparation
+ Control your print
+ Full file access and management
+ Full terminal access
+ Flow rate, Feed rate and fan controls
+ Webcam support (also muticam support)
+ Dark mode
+ High performance
+ Notifications about your print and filament
+ Gcode Viewer
+ Support for multiple printers
+ Many power control plugins like PSU Control or IKEA Tradfri
+ Automatic lights
+ PrintTimeGenius support
+ Support for many of your favourite plugins, like ArcWelder or SpoolManager
+ Remote connection with supported plugin or manual setup, the app switches automatically
+ OctoEverywhere integration
+ Obico integration
+ Works with VPNs, HTTPS and Basic Auth
+ And much, much more!
There is a new feature update roughly 4-8 weeks! Let me know what you are missing!
Important notice for remote connections: The app does not provide required servers. You can either set something up yourself and provide the app with a URL reachable over the internet or use a plugin like OctoEverywhere, The Spaghetti Detective or ngrok.
---
OctoApp is made for and compatible with but not officially associated with OctoPrint.
OctoPrint is a registered trademark. Learn more at octoprint.org
OctoApp is not associated with Obico, Bambu Lab, OctoEverywhere, Elegoo or other services integrated
---
https://octoapp.eu/terms/

bluejetty:00040735:ios.description:
A cute, ad-free, and enjoyable learning experience is waiting for you in the Renshuu community! The free version is unlimited: there’s no timer before you are forced to pay!
- A path for every learning style and every goal -
Whether you are getting started with the alphabets or have been studying for years, jump in exactly where you belong! Don’t waste time going through what you already know. 
Renshuu maintains learning paths for most textbooks, the JLPT, Kanji Kentei, and for those who just want to learn. You can also carve out your own path! Our community has over 10,000 user-made lessons for even more focused learning.
- Cute, relaxing, and fun -
Our mascot Kao-chan is here to let you enjoy learning Japanese, whether it’s through collectible coins every time you quiz, a character that evolves as you learn, manga pages that you unlock, or hundreds of hand-made illustrations. 
Additionally, we have both single and multiplayer games to help you keep your learning and reviewing fresh! 
- Personal service - 
We are just a two-person company - and we don’t use chat bots. That means that every question you have gets an answer directly from us. 
- Rich, in-depth materials -
> Vocabulary: over 15,000 native-recorded audio files, 17,000 hand-picked images, and 160,000 example sentences make understanding vocabulary a breeze. Our growing library of accent/pitch data can even help you with accent reduction.
> Kanji: 12,000+ kanji, with no limits on what you can study! Over 2,000 colorful mnemonics help you to understand and retain the meanings.
> Grammar: Over 800 different expressions, each complete with native-written model sentences, construction diagrams, audio, and over 7,500 hand-made quiz questions. 
> Sentences: Thousands of sentences complete with audio, divided by theme and difficulty levels.
- A superior quiz system designed around Japanese -
Our SRS-for-Japanese system doesn’t treat Japanese materials like flashcards to be memorized, and breaks every item down into individual components so you can understand, and not just memorize. Mastery schedules keep you studying only what you need to, pushing weaker materials to the front for you to focus on.
Dozens of different question styles keep things fresh, while a flexible input system (multiple choice, typing, or writing) lets you answer the way that you want to.
- Customizable down to the last character - 
Renshuu doesn’t believe that there is a single way of studying that everyone should adhere to. Our expansive settings and customizations let you adjust the learning environment to what works best for you.
End user license agreement can be viewed here: https://www.renshuu.org/eula

bluejetty:00144950:ios.description:
Clap Detector - Find My Phone helps you locate your lost phone in seconds. Lost it on the couch, under a pillow, or somewhere in a messy room? Clap once or whistle, and your phone rings instantly, even on silent. No more wasting time searching every corner of the house.
KEY FEATURES
Clap or Whistle to Find Phone
Clap your hands or whistle, and your phone answers back with a loud alarm - perfect for when it's buried in a bag, lost between couch cushions, or left in another room.
DTMP - Don't Touch My Phone
Set an alarm that triggers the moment someone touches, lifts, or moves your phone without your permission. Great for cafés, offices, shared spaces, or anywhere you step away for a minute.
WTMP - Who Touched My Phone
Want to know who tried to unlock your phone while you were away? WTMP quietly captures a photo the moment an unauthorized unlock attempt is made, so you're never left guessing.
Charger Guard
Charging in a public place or shared space? Get an instant alert the moment your charger is unplugged, so your phone — and your charger — stay exactly where you left them.
Custom Alarm Sounds
Choose the alarm tone that's easiest for you to hear and recognize among the noise.
Built for the Whole World
Fully localized in 33+ languages, so wherever you are, Clap Detector speaks your language.
Whether you're constantly misplacing your phone at home, worried about theft in public, or just want peace of mind while charging in a shared space, Clap Detector is the anti-theft phone finder built for real, everyday situations.
Subscriptions: 
You can choose between subscription options that closely match your needs. 
* Monthly / $4.99
* Lifetime / $19.99
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
By using the app, we confirm that you accept our terms of use & privacy policy

bluejetty:00183680:ios.description:
RBC Launch™ is a new space for our clients to be the first to use our newest and most innovative banking features and have a say in how they should work for you. Try some of the new features like:
Email transfers to the US
Send money to friends and family in the US just like you do in Canada! All you need is a name, email and phone number to start a transfer. 
Avion Rewards Pay
With the new Avion Rewards Pay card, seamlessly use your Avion Rewards points for purchases in person or online wherever Visa is accepted. Enjoy the flexibility to pay with points whenever you shop, making every transaction more rewarding.
Shopping by RBC
A personalized shopping companion and a new way to search, shop and save.
InStore Offers
Unlock cash back at your favorite nearby stores with the new InStore Offers when you turn on location sharing and notifications.
Browser Extension
Never miss a deal with your ultimate shopping companion added to the browser. Access offers, coupons, and autofill at checkout on popular retail sites.
RBC Pay
Enable the browser extension, and let us fill in your contact information, shipping address, and preferred payment details at checkout automatically.
Cash Back Deals
A new way to earn cash back in your RBC account when shopping on your mobile device at your favourite participating merchants by using a Safari browser extension.
Payback with Points
Redeem your Avion Rewards points towards a recent Apple Pay transaction and receive a statement credit for the transaction.
Here’s how we keep you safe:
SECURITY
Rest easy knowing that you’re protected from unauthorized transactions** in the RBC Launch app by the RBC Digital Banking Security Guarantee.
PRIVACY
The RBC Launch app might need to access device services for certain features, like your contacts so you can send money to a friend. For a full list of the features, check out http://www.rbcroyalbank.com/mobile/permissions/wallet-iOS.html
For help removing the RBC Launch app from your device, there are instructions at http://www.rbcroyalbank.com/mobile/permissions/wallet-iOS.html
You can get more information about RBC digital channel privacy at https://www.rbc.com/privacysecurity/ca/online-privacy.html
Contact information for RBC Royal Bank® is available at https://www.rbcroyalbank.com/customer-service/mailing-addresses/index.html
LEGAL
When you select to install the RBC Launch app, you’re consenting to any future updates or upgrades. Depending on your device, operating system or user-initiated settings, these might be automatically installed. You’re able to withdraw your consent by uninstalling the RBC Launch app from your device.
If you download the RBC Launch app, you must review, and are subject to, the Legal Terms of Use found by clicking the Legal link on www.rbc.com, as well as the Electronic Access Agreement, as applicable.
* The RBC Launch app is operated by Royal Bank of Canada.
** For a definition of an unauthorized transaction and for full details regarding the protections and limitations of the RBC Online Security Guarantee, please see your account and/or online agreements with the applicable entity. bluejetty:00121267:ios.description:
Take full control.
Test your piloting skills and handle the most critical flight conditions known to man.
Cope with emergencies and incidents inspired by real life scenarios in a climactic adrenaline rush.
Start each engine individually, navigate between the equipment dashboard panels and be ready to solve over 5,000 possible situations in order to reach the highest pilot ranking.
The simulator includes 36 missions to accomplish, 216 challenges to pass, cartography and worldwide navigation with over 500 accurate airports replicas as well as real time weather conditions.
Features:
- 36 missions (6 included + 30 available for purchase)
- 216 challenges 6 of which in global competitions (18 included + 198 available for purchase)
- 20 HD airports (4 included + 16 available for purchase)
- Fast landing mode with global competition and 5 fault levels.
- Instrument Landing System, ILS
- Speed autopilot, Route, Altitude and Vertical speed - Primary Flight Display
- Navigation Display
- Weather Radar for managing Microburst, Ice and wind
- Advanced engine system with ignition, faults and fire safety
- Fuel management with weight balancing, Jettison and real consumption
- Landing gears management with manual unlocking system
- Full control of the rudder, flaps, reversers and spoilers
- APU management
- Worldwide navigation with 548 airports and 1107 usable runways, real or customizable weather conditions (available for purchase)
- Cartography with over 8000 waypoints (VOR, NDB, TACAN, DME, GPS, FIX)
- Automatic Flight Planning Configuration
- Cinema replay system
- 3D virtual cockpit with integrated instrumentation
- SRTM30 Plus real terrestrial elevation 
- MODIS VCF real coastline 
- OpenWeatherMap real-time weather conditions

bluejetty:00095197:ios.description:
The environment is rapidly deteriorating, and resources are becoming increasingly scarce. In a struggle for survival, creatures engage in fierce battles. As a single-celled organism, you will control a mysterious magic sphere to hunt monsters, collect cool and mysterious creature parts, and gradually evolve into a powerful super organism to rule the entire island!
【Idle Progress, Easy Loot 】
Immerse yourself in the fun of idle games, with auto-battle always there to assist you. There's no need to fight every battle yourself—just sit back and enjoy powerful equipment drops and the thrill of fast-paced evolution!
【Free Evolution, Endless Customization】
Evolve from a primitive creature into complex lifeforms-Peas, Spiders, or even the mighty Octopus! Choose your preferred evolutionary path as you acquire unique skills and the characteristics of many different creatures. Create your own unique creature design!
【Gather Exotic Fruit, Build Your Home】
As one of many alien tribes, you'll collect strange plants and seeds, study biotechnology, train fruit pets for battle, collect the relics of ancient gods, and create a comfy home!
【Tribal Bonfire, Easy Socializing】
Join a tribe, collaborate with other players, share adventures, challenge powerful bosses together, seize loot, and become a member of the strongest tribe!
Join this amazing survival adventure now!

Experience the magic of anime ai art like never before with the AI Anime Generator. Download now and unleash the power of AI generator to create the anime art of your dreams!

bluejetty:00040157:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00040157:ios.description:
Vibrate+ Pro can help you relieve stress and induce feelings of relaxation. It is also very simple and easy to use!
- APP FEATURES -
11 uniquely designed vibration patterns included. Provide a soothing effect in just 30 seconds. Help improve sleep quality. Vibrate+ Pro helps people fall asleep 50% faster.
Functions:
+ Constant fluctuations
+ Set tactile strength and speed
+ Choose from over 11 different vibration patterns
+ Easy to use power on/off button
+ Simple and convenient user interface
+ Relax and de-stress after a long day
+ Help with pain in the neck or other muscles
- POWER LEVELS -
Vibrate+ Pro is the new powerful vibrator app on the market. We have three strength settings:
Soft: perfect for meditation. Meditation with our app is a simple practice accessible to everyone that can reduce stress and increase peace of mind.
- Medium: The app will help you if you have a more sedentary job. Just put your phone behind you and you'll focus on what's really important.
- Hard: ideal for people involved in sports. You can massage the muscles that have worked the hardest to improve blood circulation in the body and reduce the buildup of lactic acid.
- PREMIUM ACCESS -
Premium access will unlock all the different vibration patterns and strength levels, as well as all future updates. You can enjoy the app without ads. For a small one-time price, you will fully understand what makes this vibrating app so unique and effective. Also please support our small family business :D
- Doesn't vibrate? -
if it doesn't vibrate, "Vibration" and "System hapticity" should be enabled in your device's audio settings. Settings -> Sounds and tactile sensations.
* Please note: This app only works on the iPhone (iPad and iPod Touch do not have an internal vibrator).
